**Activity Points** is one of the gamification tools on your social network to encourage members to have more interaction in the community. With this app, you reward members by giving "virtual points" for each of their activities.

The activity point system can be thought of as a website currency, it can be used in many different ways to manage your users. Users can earn points by doing various actions on your network, and then spend points or purchase items, subscriptions... It also makes things easier for users to manage their point balance with several options and criteria.

In terms of management, the app gives Admin control to adjust member points on each activity, along with several user group settings and point settings. You can also configure the conversion rate to convert the activity points to actual rewards such as real money.

There are many ways to use this system efficiently, such as promoting some active users to be a moderator of the site, giving "real" awards back to some active users, or to users whose points are over a threshold, etc.

Additionally, with no more boundaries or limits from the Core system, the Activity Points app enables developers to take advantage of the pointing system and use it to develop many features related to Activity Points.

###### **Key Features**

###### **Users can:**

  * View the overall point balance with info on how many points users have earned, bought, received, spent & sent.
  * Review the activity points during a specific time period.
  * Have a detailed guide on how to earn points for each activity.
  * Purchase Activity Point packages with Payment Gateways or [E-Wallet](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/e-wallet/).
  * Use activity points to purchase listing items and pay for subscription plans.
  * Easily track point transaction histories and package transactions.
  * Send requests to convert points to cash in [E-Wallet](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/e-wallet/) Balance.
  * Monitor the status of conversion requests.

###### **Admin can configure to:**

  * Show/hide details of activity points to users.
  * Adjust the conversion rate for all available currencies.
  * Add new and Manage point packages.
  * Review all transactions using Activity points.
  * Review Activity Point statistics info of each user, such as their current activity points & total earn/received/bought/spent/sent with the option to adjust points and view their transaction.
  * Allow users to use Activity Points to purchase items.
  * Allow users to purchase Activity Point packages.
  * Allow users of specific roles to use the "Send/Minus Activity Points" function.
  * Adjust the maximum points and period that specific roles can send.
  * Manage how many points users of specific roles can receive for a particular activity.
  * Define conversion rate to convert activity points to cash in the [E-Wallet](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/e-wallet/) Balance
  * Charge fee rate (%) when converting activity points to cash.
  * Manage Conversion requests.
  * Automatically approve conversion requests of users of specific roles.

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**
  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to AdminCP > App Settings, searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

###### **Features integrated with Apple Pay**

  * Purchase packages of Activity points
  * Purchase Subscription
  * Supported payment processor(s): Stripe

_According to current support from Apple, Apple Pay can be used on the**Safari** browser._

###### **Benefits with Apple Pay**

**Simple Setup, Effortless Transactions**

Setting up Apple Pay on our product is a breeze. No need to enter card details repeatedly; with just a few clicks, you can authorize payments instantly.

**Swift, Contactless Payments**

With Apple Pay, completing transactions is as simple as holding your device near the supported payment terminal and authenticating with Face ID or Touch ID. Within seconds, your payment is processed, providing a smooth and convenient experience.

**Enhanced Security for Peace of Mind**

Your security is our top priority. When you use Apple Pay, your actual card information is never shared with merchants. Instead, a unique token is used for each transaction, safeguarding your sensitive data from potential threats. With the added layers of biometric authentication, you can rest assured that only you can authorize payments.

###### **Set up Authorize payment gateway**

  * **Create the Authorize account**
    * Go to the authorize.net page to create an account: <https://developer.authorize.net/hello_world/sandbox.html>
    * The Sandbox currency is the Merchant Currency on ACP
    * Sign-in the account at : <https://sandbox.authorize.net/>****

  * **Configure Keys**
    * On Authorize.Net site, log into your account and go to Account > API Credentials & Keys
      * Check on New Transaction Key > Submit to create Transaction Key
      * Check on New Signature Key > Submit to create a Signature Key
      * Open the Webhooks page > Add Endpoint:
        * Input the Endpoint URL given from AdminCP > App Settings > Payment > Authorize.Net > Edit into the Endpoint URL field
        * Change the status to _Active_
        * Select _All Event_ checkbox
    * Configure **API Login ID** , **Transaction Key** and **Signature Key** obtained above to corresponding fields in the AdminCP > App Settings > Payment > Authorize.Net > Edit page

  * **Configure processor currency:**
    * Go to Account > Processor on the Authorize.net page
    * Copy the currency code (e.g: USD) and paste it to the Merchant Currency field on the AdminCP > App Settings > Payment > Authorize.Net > Edit page

  * **Configure Live mode for the Authorize :**
    * Go to Account > Test Mode on the Authorize.net page
    * Turn on Live toggle

###### Setup Guide

To set up payment with CCBill, you need to contact the CCBill Merchant Support team to support account setup as below:

  * Generate the Encryption Key.
  * Create the FlexForm with the Dynamic Price option.
  * Set up the Data Link Services Suite for Subscriptions, for example, for canceling recurring transactions.
  * Set up minimum and maximum initial prices for your account.
  * Set up the minimum and maximum of recurring prices and recurring periods for your account.
  * Set up your expected currencies.
  * Set up Webhook as below
    * Required Events: _NewSaleSuccess_ , _Cancellation, Expiration, RenewalSuccess, RenewalFailure_.
    * Support 2 data formats: _URL Encoded_ and **JSON**.
    * Use the recommended event versions:
      * NewSaleSuccess: 6
      * Cancellation: 1
      * Expiration: 1
      * RenewalSuccess: 5
      * RenewalFailure: 3

The **ChatPlus** app of our social networking software revolutionizes the way users connect and communicate with one another. With its user-friendly interface and robust functionality, our ChatPlus app provides a seamless and immersive messaging experience for individuals and groups alike, including support for audio and video chat, indicators for read and typing status, as well as additional features like Pin Message and React to Messages.

###### **Real-time Messaging**

Users can engage in real-time conversations with their friends, family, and fellow network members. Messages are delivered instantly, allowing for dynamic and fluid communication. Whether it's a quick exchange or a lengthy discussion, our Chat feature ensures that users can connect with others in a timely manner.

###### **Private and Group Chats**

Users have the flexibility to engage in both private and group conversations. Private chats enable one-on-one communication, ensuring privacy and confidentiality. Group chats facilitate discussions among multiple individuals, fostering collaboration and community-building. Users can easily create, join, and manage groups based on their interests, affiliations, or shared goals.

###### **Audio and Video Chat**

Our Chat feature goes beyond text-based messaging by offering seamless audio and video chat capabilities. Users can initiate voice or video calls with their contacts directly within the platform. Whether it's a quick voice message, a face-to-face conversation, or even a group video conference, our software enables users to connect in a more personal and immersive manner.

###### **Indicators for Read and Typing**

To enhance the messaging experience, our Chat feature includes indicators for read and typing status. Users can see when their messages have been read by their contacts, providing clarity on the status of their communication. Additionally, when someone is typing a message, a "typing" indicator is displayed, letting users know that a response is on the way. These indicators promote transparency and enable users to gauge the responsiveness of their conversations.

###### **Pin Message**

Our Chat feature allows users to pin important messages within their conversations. By pinning a message, users can easily access and refer back to crucial information, reminders, or any content they want to highlight. This feature is especially useful for storing important links, addresses, or event details, ensuring that they remain easily accessible within the chat thread.

###### **React to Messages**

Users can express their reactions to messages through a range of emojis or custom reactions. With this feature, users can simply click on a reaction to convey their emotions, opinions, or appreciation without having to type a response. Reacting to messages adds an interactive and expressive element to the conversation, making it more engaging and enjoyable for participants.

###### **Multimedia Sharing**

In addition to audio and video chat, our Chat feature allows users to share a wide range of multimedia content. Users can send photos, videos, audio clips, and documents, enriching their conversations and making them more engaging. This feature enhances the storytelling aspect of communication, enabling users to express themselves creatively and share moments with others.

###### **Emojis**

To add fun and expressiveness to conversations, our Chat feature offers a rich collection of emojis. Users can choose from a diverse range of emoticons to convey their emotions, reactions, and personal style. This feature enhances the overall user experience and adds an element of visual communication to conversations.

###### **Message History and Search**

Our ChatPlus feature ensures that users can easily access their message history. Conversations are securely stored and readily available for users to review, reference, and reminisce. Moreover, the search functionality allows users to quickly find specific messages or keywords within their chat history, enabling efficient navigation and retrieval of information.

###### **Notifications and Presence Indicators**

Users stay connected and informed through real-time notifications. They receive alerts when new messages arrive or when audio/video calls are initiated, ensuring that they never miss important conversations or updates. Additionally, presence indicatorsshow users' online/offline status, indicating their availability to chat, which helps facilitate timely communication and coordination.

###### **Secure and Privacy-Enhanced**

The ChatPlus app prioritizes user privacy and employs robust encryption protocols to safeguard messages and protect user data. This creates a secure environment for private conversations, instilling confidence and trust in the platform.

###### **Archive Chat**

ChatPlus includes the ability to archive chats. Users can archive conversations that they no longer actively engage in, but still want to keep for future reference. This helps in organizing the chat list and decluttering the active chat interface, while still allowing users to access archived conversations whenever needed. Archived chats can be easily retrieved, ensuring that important messages and information are always within reach.

###### **System Requirements**

ChatPlus server requires to be installed on a dedicated server or VPS using Linux OS (such as Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian, etc) with Docker. And, generally, the more powerful server is, the more users Chatplus can handle.

###### Mobile apps

Mobile apps need to be rebuilt to enable the ChatPlus. You can open a Support ticket in [Client Area](https://clients.phpfox.com/) to build your mobile apps with ChatPlus feature.

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

If you have already purchased the app licenses on the [Appstore](https://appstore.phpfox.com/).

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**

If you have not purchased the app licenses.

  * Let's log into**AdminCP > Apps > Find More**
  * Search and then view the app you would like to purchase.
  * You can click on the Purchase button to process payment via PayPal.
  * Once payment is made successfully, the app license will automatically be added and associated with your MetaFox license. You will verify your purchase in the **AdminCP > Apps > Purchased**.

**Installation**

  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to AdminCP > App Settings, searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

**Metafox Documents** is a robust and scalable document management and collaboration platform designed for seamless organization and management of your folders and documents. Upload, organize, and share documents effortlessly while integrating with Groups and Pages for enhanced collaboration. With role-based permissions, real-time interaction, and cross-device accessibility, it offers a streamlined way to manage files within personal and shared spaces. Metafox Documents ensures secure, efficient, and structured document management for teams, communities, or individuals.

**FOR USERS:**

  * Upload and organize documents using structured folders and nested subfolders for efficient content management—whether in **MyDrive** , or within a specific **Group** or **Page**.
  * Assign categories and tags to documents to enable streamlined classification, filtering, and quick retrieval.
  * Leverage social features by sharing documents across the MetaFox platform, with built-in support for **likes** and **comments** to foster collaboration and engagement.

**FOR ADMINISTRATORS******

  * Manage and assign user permissions for creating documents and folders, approving submissions, liking, and saving documents.
  * The system supports up to 5 levels of nested subfolders. Administrators can define the maximum number of direct subfolders allowed under each parent folder to maintain a well-structured organization.
  * Create and manage document categories to ensure consistent classification across the platform.
  * Manage all documents created by users across the site, with full administrative access and control.

###### **Key Features:**

  * **Seamless Integration:** Directly share and collaborate on documents within Groups and Pages.
  * **Advanced Search & Filtering:** Quickly locate documents using tags, categories, author, and custom sorting.
  * **Role-Based Permissions:** Control who can view, edit, and manage documents.
  * **Real-Time Collaboration:** Like, comment, and share files with members instantly.
  * **MyDrive & Shared Spaces:** Personal storage plus dedicated drive space for Groups and Pages.
  * **Privacy & Access Control:** Define who can access documents (public, private, community, or friends).
  * **Approval Workflow:** Enable document approvals before sharing within Groups and Pages.
  * **Cross-Device Access:** Manage and access files from both mobile and desktop devices.

###### **User Features******

**1\. Folder Management******

  * Users can create folders and subfolders to organize documents.
  * The number of subfolders allowed within each folder is limited and defined by administrators in the AdminCP.

**2\. Document Management******

  * Upload documents to:
    * A specific folder or subfolder in **MyDrive** or the **root folder** of MyDrive
    * A specific **Group** or **Page******
  * Edit or delete documents (if the user has permission).
  * Browse and access documents that the user has permission to view.

**3\. Navigation & Views******

  * Quick access to categorized document views:
    * **All Documents** – View all accessible documents.
    * **My Documents** – View documents uploaded by the user.
    * **Friends’ Documents** – View documents shared by friends.
    * **Pending Documents** – View documents awaiting approval.
  * **MyDrive** view displays all personal folders and uploaded documents.

**4\. Document Review******

  * Preview documents directly on the platform (PDF format supported).
  * Download documents directly from the platform.

**5\. Search & Filter: **Search for documents by: Author, Categories and other available filters…

**6\. Social & Engagement Features******

  * Like, comment on, share, and report documents to engage or flag content.
  * Highlight documents through **sponsorship** or **featuring** options.

**7\. Download Support******

  * Users can download documents for offline access, if permitted.

###### **Admin Features******

**1\. Category Management******

  * Create, edit, and delete document categories.
  * Reorder categories using drag-and-drop functionality.

**2\. Permission Management******

  * Assign permissions based on user roles, including the ability to:
    * Create folders
    * Upload documents
    * Browse and view documents
    * Approve documents
    * Share, comment on, and report documents

**3\. Settings******

  * Set a default category for newly created documents.
  * Define the maximum allowed upload file size.
  * Specify the maximum number of direct subfolders allowed under each parent folder.

**4\. Document Management******

  * View and manage all documents uploaded across the platform.
  * Search documents by title, author, status, and other criteria.
  * Delete documents when necessary.
  * Mark documents as **sponsored** or **featured** to highlight them.
  * Review and approve documents submitted by users.

###### **Notes**

Almost all app features support the MetaFox mobile apps. Please contact us or phpFox to rebuild your mobile apps to enable Documents.

The groundbreaking **E-Wallet** feature, designed to enhance your experience on MetaFox while offering you opportunities for financial growth. With E-Wallet, you can now seamlessly engage with our community and generate income while enjoying a secure and efficient payment system.

  * All payments initiated by users within the community will be routed directly to the E-Wallet account configured in the AdminCP. This streamlines payment processing, ensuring that funds are securely and promptly received.
  * User accounts will reflect the paid amount after deducting the payment transaction/commission fee if having. The actual amount processed will be based on USD (United States Dollar) after being converted using the latest currency conversion rates. This ensures that users have a clear view of their earnings and expenditures.
  * Users can manage their finances effortlessly within the E-Wallet section. This includes checking their current balance, reviewing transaction history, sending funds, and monitoring withdrawal requests.
  * Admins play a vital role in the E-Wallet system by managing user withdrawal requests. Upon receiving a withdrawal request, Admins have the authority to approve it. Once approved, the Admin will be redirected to PayPal to complete the payment processing.

###### **Key Features**

  * Seamlessly integrated with payment procedures. All payments received will be added to users' balances in E-Wallet.
  * Users can send requests to withdraw money from the E-Wallet. After admin approves withdrawal requests in AdminCP, money will be transferred to a chosen user payment account.
  * Easily track detailed transactions, overview of E-Wallet balance, and withdrawal requests.
  * The E-Wallet balance of sellers can be updated for a received amount when others pay for their listing items.
  * Buyers can use money in E-Wallet to buy [listing items](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/marketplace/), pay for [subscription plans](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/subscriptions/), and purchase [activity point](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/activity-points/) packages conveniently.
  * Admin can configure a number of pending days that received money can be withdrawn since the payment date.
  * Allow admin to charge withdrawal fee (in percent) on each withdrawal request.
  * Admin can set up Exchange rates for multiple currencies in either manual way or auto-sync way.

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**
  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to AdminCP > App Settings, searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

How to let people know and invite them to the party that you host? How to let people know about something new you just invented? Events app is the answer to these questions. With **Event** app, you can create your own event by specifying time and venue of the event, along with images and event description. You can send invites to certain people or just leave it open for public so anyone can join in it. For the invited people, they have a choice to deny, consider or attend the event. All the events are well organized into categories and easily referenced using search and filters.

###### **Key Features**

  * Browse events that the viewer has permission to view
  * Can search events by keyword, categories and some other criteria
  * Can set event privacy and manage posts in events
  * Quick navigations: All Events, MyHosting Events, Friends' Events, Past Events, Event Invites
  * Event has info of a title, created date, statistics of views and likes, event host, view number of events, availability option (Attending, Maybe Attend, Not Attending), venue/location of the event (With Google map illustration), Start time/End time, Banner photo, List of users for each availability, and category of the event.
  * Owner and moderators can manage events such as edit / delete / sponsor my event/ sponsor in feed
  * Moderators can manage invitations with mass actions
  * Support like, share, comment on events.
  * Suggest events that are related or similar to the event being viewed
  * Manage event privacy, restrict viewers
  * Support search event on map
  * Set up pagination style, time format of events.
  * Admin can configure Permission settings for each role in AdminCP
  * Admin can manage categories
  * Before deleting a category, admin can select another category to move all existing events of that category.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) are an essential feature for any website, especially when you receive a high volume of emails from users—be they potential customers, bloggers, commenters, or casual visitors.
In many cases, the questions you're asked tend to follow similar patterns. Without an FAQ section, this often leads to spending time crafting the same response multiple times. By anticipating common queries and providing clear, concise answers in one centralized place, you not only save time but also enhance the user experience and reduce communication delays.

This plugin is a highly profitable and time-saving solution for your website. It allows you to create and manage a list of the most commonly asked questions from users—whether they’re customers, bloggers, or general visitors.
Instead of responding manually to repeated inquiries via email, you can simply direct users to your organized FAQ section. In many cases, visitors may even find the answers themselves while browsing, reducing your support workload and enhancing user satisfaction.
By addressing frequent queries proactively, this plugin streamlines communication and helps you focus on more meaningful interactions.

Empower Users with Instant Answers — and Drive Better Conversions. Delays in getting answers can hold back your users from making timely decisions—whether it's purchasing, signing up, or exploring your offerings. In many cases, those delays result in lost opportunities, as users may leave your site entirely or require follow-up outreach to re-engage them.
By integrating an FAQ system, you equip your website with instant clarity. Users can find accurate information from start to finish—without waiting for replies. This not only improves user experience but also boosts trust and encourages faster action.

In today’s fast-paced world, users rarely have the time or patience to sift through lengthy content. That’s why our FAQ plugin is designed to deliver information in a quick, accessible, and visually engaging way.

#### **Key Features**

##### **Group FAQs by categories**

FAQs can be grouped of categories for their easy navigation and listing on your website. Users would be able to find their required information in categorical display.

##### **Visibility Privacy for Each FAQ**

Each FAQ can be made visible based on the Member Level, Network and Profile Type of the member who view it.

##### **Allow People to Rate**

Your users can give rating on the FAQs on your website. You can choose to display the FAQs on your website based on the rating, so that people can read most rated FAQs first.

##### **Allow People to Comment, Like and Share**

Your users can Comment and Like on individual FAQ thereby enabling your users to express their thoughts and liking for an FAQ. This will help other people visiting the same FAQ on your website.

##### **Tag Keywords for Better Searching**

You can add tags to FAQs which will help your users to easily and quickly search the questions of their interest.

##### **Simple and Clear View Page for FAQs**

This plugin provides very simple and clear view page for the FAQs on your website which is appropriate to display the information very neatly and easily readable.

#### **Support**

If you face any problem with our app then feel free to contact us at: [app@echoit.in](mailto:app@echoit.in)

We will resolve your issues within 24 hours (Mon to Fri). We will also welcome your valuable suggestions. So that we can implement them in our future releases.

###### **For USERS**

  * Additionally, users can browse and select service packages with detailed descriptions and pricing and receive email and in-app notifications about invoice due dates.

###### **For ADMINISTRATORS**

  * The dashboard offers an overview of total earnings, quick access to managing invoices, packages, and transactions, along with system alerts and notifications.
  * Admin can view and manage all user invoices, create, edit, and delete invoices, track payment statuses, and generate reports on invoice activities.
  * Admin can also create, edit, and delete service packages, set pricing and duration for each package, and manage special promotions and discounts.
  * Furthermore, admin can view and manage all transactions, monitor payment gateway integrations, process refunds, and maintain a transaction history with reporting capabilities.

###### **User Features**

  1. **Dashboard**
     * Overview of featured items
     * Quick access to invoice management
  2. **Item Management**
     * Submit items to be featured
     * Track the status of submitted items
  3. **Invoice Management**
     * View and download invoices
     * Payment history
     * Outstanding payments
     * Payment methods (credit card, PayPal, etc.)
  4. **Package Selection**
     * Browse and select packages for featuring items
     * Detailed package descriptions and pricing
  5. **Notifications**
     * Email and in-app notifications for invoice due dates

###### **Admin Features**

  1. **Dashboard**
     * Overview of total earnings
     * Quick access to manage invoices, packages, and transactions
     * System alerts and notifications
  2. **Invoice Management**
     * View and manage all user invoices
     * Create, edit, and delete invoices
     * Track payment statuses
     * Generate reports on invoice activities
  3. **Package Management**
     * Create, edit, and delete featured packages
     * Set pricing and duration for each featured package
     * Special promotions and discount management
  4. **Transaction Management**
     * View and manage all transactions
     * Track payment gateway integrations
     * Refund processing
     * Transaction history and reporting

Playing online games with your friends can be a fantastic way to bond and have fun together. You can also make your website more engaging and attract more visitors.

This online game plugin offers a unique combination of interactive games, quizzes, and glossaries that can be played and even created by users based on their member level. The plugin supports HTML and HTML5 games, allowing users to upload games from other third-party websites. With a separate admin panel, you can customize and manage settings to suit your needs. This is a great way to stay engaged, learn new things, and have a good time online!

The ability to support HTML and HTML5 games, as well as allow users to upload games from other third-party websites, will definitely appeal to a wide range of users. The addition of a member level system, allowing users to create and play games based on their level, adds an extra layer of engagement and customization. The admin panel also provides valuable control over the plugin's settings, making it a great tool for website administrators.

To add a new game to the platform, users need to copy the HTML game URL from the respective game site and paste it into the "Game URL" field on the Add New Game page.

Enabling users to create games across different categories on the website can greatly enhance user engagement and encourage creativity within the community.

  * [ ![](https://phpfox-store.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2024/12/23041551/Get-Started-AdminCP-Add-Todo-1024x475.png) ](https://phpfox-store.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2024/12/23041551/Get-Started-AdminCP-Add-Todo.png)

The **Get Started** app is designed to help **MetaFox community owners** introduce their platform to new users in a **simple** , **engaging** , and **effective** way on both web and mobile apps.

Serving as a **guided onboarding tool** , this app highlights the core features of your community while creating a smooth and memorable first-time experience. Whether you run a niche group, fan hub, or professional network… the Get Started app ensures your users feel right at home.

###### **Key Benefits**

**Introduce New Users**

Greet members with a warm welcome and provide a brief overview of your community's mission, purpose, and the value they’ll receive by being part of it.

**Highlight Core Features & Guide Onboarding Flow**

Take new users through essential onboarding steps with a dynamic checklist after signup. This guide will help them complete key tasks like uploading a profile photo, joining groups, and navigating the main sections of your platform.

**Boost Early Engagement**

A smooth and engaging onboarding experience motivates users to stay active, return often, and interact with others, ensuring they get the most out of your community from the start.

###### **For users:**

  * Upon their first login after signing up, users will receive a welcome message from the site owner along with a to-do list of tasks designed to help them become familiar with the community.
  * Users can navigate through the to-do list step-by-step (using "Next" and "Previous" buttons), ensuring they fully understand each task and what the site owner expects for them to get acclimated to the community.
  * On subsequent visits to the Getting Started board, completed tasks will be marked as "read," allowing users to quickly jump to the tasks they haven’t reviewed yet.
  * Users have the flexibility to close the to-do list at any time, providing them with full control over their onboarding experience.

###### **For admins:**

  * **Enable the Getting Started App**
Admins have the option to enable the **Getting Started** app, allowing the Getting Started board along with the to-do lists to be displayed to users on the frontend. This feature can be disabled by the admin when creating the to-do list.
  * **Manage To-Do Lists******
    * Admins can easily create and manage to-do lists for both the web and mobile apps, with full support for multiple languages.
    * Admins have the ability to **edit** or **delete** specific to-do lists as needed.
    * When creating a to-do list, admins can upload photos in either the **Description Section** or the **Photo Section** :
      * **Description Section:** Photos uploaded here will appear inline with the text description.
      * **Photo Section:** Photos added in this section will be displayed in a slide format. Users can navigate through the images by clicking "Next" and "Previous." The photo section will be positioned directly below the description section.

**Group** app offers a space for users who share common interests on a certain things. The app allows users to come together to organize, express objectives, discuss issues, post photos and share related content to their interests.

###### **Key Features**

\- Browse and search groups by category, sub-category and keyword
\- Quick navigation: Create group, My Group, All Group, Friend's groups, Joined Groups, Group invites
\- See groups marked "Featured" and see "Popular" groups based on the total of group members
\- Can change group name & category, group description, group photo, group permission (Includes group privacy and member permissions on actions such as posting, who can view group posts...)

\- Assign a unique URL for group
\- Members can be promoted to group moderator or group admin
\- Support many group sections on Group Profile page which can be accessed using the navigation bar. Functionalities on these group sections are provided and followed the settings of corresponding apps.
\- Support group privacies
\- Support time settings for invites, length of group names, privacy...
\- Admin can configure Permission settings for each user role
\- Admin can manage categories/sub-categories as well as the total number of items in each category
\- Group owners can set up Membership Questions, Group Rules
\- All the items and content created in the group will only be circulated in the group

The **Invitation** feature within our social network software enables users to invite friends, acquaintances, and contacts to join the social network community. This feature simplifies the process of expanding one's network, fostering connections, and building a vibrant community of like-minded individuals.

###### **Benefits**

  * **Network Expansion** : The Invitation feature makes it easy for users to expand their social network by inviting friends, acquaintances, and contacts to join the community. This increases the diversity of connections and enhances opportunities for meaningful interactions and collaborations.
  * **Personalized Outreach** : By allowing users to send personalized invitations, the feature enables users to make a compelling case for joining the social network. Personalized invitations have a higher chance of resonating with recipients and generating positive responses.
  * **Streamlined Invitation Process** : The Invitation feature simplifies the invitation process by providing multiple channels and contact import capabilities. Users can invite their contacts through their preferred communication method, eliminating friction and making it convenient for both the inviter and the invitee.
  * **Increased Engagement** : As users invite their contacts to join the social network, the Invitation feature promotes increased engagement within the community. More active users lead to a richer and more vibrant social network experience for all members.
  * **Community Growth** : The Invitation feature plays a vital role in community growth by encouraging users to invite others. Incentives and rewards further incentivize users to actively participate in the invitation process, contributing to the expansion and vitality of the social network community.

###### **Key Features:**

  * Invite multiple people via emails or phone numbers
  * Compose invitation messages
  * Resend invitations
  * Check duplicate invitations
  * Automatically be friend with invited user
  * Adjust the invitation link's expiration date

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**
  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to AdminCP > App Settings, searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

Live Video lets users instantly share their moments through live videos and connect with their audience from anywhere. Whether you want to host talk sessions, webinars, live events, or showcase your products/services, Live **Streaming** has got you covered. This solution comes equipped with features like notifications for new live videos, real-time reactions, comments, and stickers for the best community engagement. Expand your reach and boost your views through live videos!

###### **Benefits**

  * **Real-Time Interaction** : Live streaming enables users to connect with their audience in real-time, fostering engagement, immediate feedback, and genuine interactions.
  * **Audience Expansion** : By broadcasting live content within the social network platform, users can reach a wider audience, expand their network, and attract viewers who share similar interests or passions.
  * **Event Coverage and Promotion** : Live streaming provides a platform for users to promote and cover events, enhancing event visibility, engagement, and providing virtual access to attendees or followers who couldn't physically attend.
  * **Talent and Skill Showcasing** : Users can showcase their talents, skills, or expertise through live streaming, allowing them to demonstrate their abilities and build a following within the social network community.
  * **Knowledge Sharing and Q &A Sessions**: Live streaming offers opportunities for users to share knowledge, conduct live discussions, and host interactive Q&A sessions, promoting learning, collaboration, and engagement.

###### **Key Features**

  * Live streaming from PC or mobile apps
  * Chat and comments throughout the live streams
  * Reactions on live streams
  * Watch all the live-streaming videos again

###### **Infrastructure Requirements**

To operate the Live Streaming solution, on top of a one-time payment for this solution, you will need to pay a monthly fee for infrastructure and external services such as storage, video live encoding and streaming. With **Marketplace** , users can easily upload listings and products to sell, transforming your community into a social marketplace. From unique handmade crafts and merchandise to one-of-a-kind digital products, Marketplace empowers your users to easily buy and sell. Ready to kickstart your e-commerce business and cash in on your community? Get phpFox's Marketplace app today, and let the buying and selling begin!

###### **Feature List**

**Users can:**

  * Browse, search, or filter listing items in All Listings, My Listings, Friends' Listings, Expired Listings, and Pending Listings pages. Specially, Featured and Popular listing items will be shown on the Marketplace Home page.
  * Search listings with many filter and sorting options.
  * Purchase a listing via active payment gateways or with activity points or money in E-Wallet.
  * Manage invoices in the Bought Invoices page

**Sellers can:**

  * Add listing items with detailed descriptions, photos, attachments, locations they want to sell on Marketplace.
  * A listing item can have multiple prices in different currencies.
  * Configure privacy of their listing items and mark them as "Sold" automatically after they are purchased.
  * Manage own listing items in My Listings page
  * Invite friends to see and purchase a listing
  * Track who have recently viewed their listings in the History page
  * Manage invoices in the Sold Invoices page

**AdminCP supports**

  * Configure permissions for roles on Marketplace
  * Manage categories
  * Configure default category
  * Define number of days in prior to the expiring day to notify the listing owners
  * Define number of days to expire listings.

###### What's New?

Updated the apps to the latest version.

#### [![](https://phpfox-store.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2024/12/24164805/buy_now_banner-1024x309.png)](https://echoit.in/app-purchase/?app=Wishes)

#### Monetize Wishes

Elevate your MetaFox site with our upgraded Monetized Wishes plugin, designed to boost engagement and revenue. Users can easily create and share wishes, while admins gain the tools to set pricing and track invoices efficiently. This update not only enhances user interaction but also streamlines the purchasing process, making it easier than ever to generate income from wish-sharing on your platform.

* * *

#### Key Features

##### Ultimate Wish Management System

  * Create, categorize, and share wishes easily.
  * Attach photos to wishes for better presentation.
  * Tagging system for improved searchability.
  * Mobile-responsive design for all devices.

##### Monetization Features

  * **Admin Pricing Control:** Admins can set the price for sharing wishes and determine the number of times a wish can be shared after purchase.
  * **Free & Paid Wishes:** Admins can decide whether all wishes should be free or if certain wishes require payment.
  * **User Payments:** Users must pay the set amount before sending a wish.
  * **E-Wallet & Gateways:** Payments integrated with MetaFox's standard gateways and e-wallet balances.

##### Invoices & Purchase Tracking

  * **Admin Invoice Management:** Admins can view all invoices related to wish purchases.
  * **User Purchase History:** Users can track purchased wishes under "My Wishes" in the "Purchased Wishes" tab.
  * **Invoice Details:** Users can see the number of times they have shared a wish and the remaining shares available.

##### Enhanced Social Interaction

  * **Send Personalized Wishes:** Users can send wishes to friends, which appear on profile feeds and notifications.
  * **Received Wishes:** Users have a dedicated "Received Wishes" section with notifications and profile visibility.

##### Organizational Tools

  * **Category Management:** Admins can create and manage wish categories from the backend.
  * **Tagging System:** Improve discoverability by adding relevant tags to wishes.
  * **Photo Attachments:** Users can add images to enhance their wishes.

##### Category

This feature allows users to effectively organize their wishes by selecting relevant categories, enhancing discoverability for others. Additionally, the admin has the capability to create and manage these categories through the website's backend, ensuring that the available options remain relevant and up-to-date.

##### Tags

Utilizing relevant tags related to the concept and idea of a wish can significantly enhance its visibility and searchability, allowing users to find content more easily and effectively engage with similar topics. This practice not only organizes information but also improves the overall user experience by connecting wishes with like-minded content.

##### Photo

Selecting an appropriate photo to accompany one's wishes enhances the overall impact of the message, making it not only more meaningful and appealing but also engaging for readers. A well-chosen image can evoke emotions, clarify ideas, and attract attention, thereby enriching the reader's experience and providing a visual context that complements the written content.

* * *

#### Highlights

##### Admin Features

  * The admin can set the price for sending each wish and define the maximum number of times a user can send a wish after purchasing it.
  * The admin can choose whether all wishes are free or require payment.
  * The admin can view all invoices related to user payments for sending wishes, including transaction statuses, in the admin panel.

##### User Features

  * Users can create wish listings, but the price and number of shares allowed are automatically set based on the admin’s settings.
  * Users must pay the specified amount before sending a wish to their friends.
  * Users can view their purchased wishes on the "Purchased Wishes" page under the "My Wishes" tab.
  * Users can access their purchased wish invoices on the "Bought Invoices" page, where they can track the number of times they have shared a wish and the remaining shares available as per the invoice.
  * Users can see their purchased or received wishes on their profile page.

* * *

  * **Tagging System:** Improve discoverability by adding relevant tags to wishes.
  * **Photo Attachments:** Users can add images to enhance their wishes.

##### Category

This feature allows users to effectively organize their wishes by selecting relevant categories, enhancing discoverability for others. Additionally, the admin has the capability to create and manage these categories through the website's backend, ensuring that the available options remain relevant and up-to-date.

##### Tags

Utilizing relevant tags related to the concept and idea of a wish can significantly enhance its visibility and searchability, allowing users to find content more easily and effectively engage with similar topics. This practice not only organizes information but also improves the overall user experience by connecting wishes with like-minded content.

##### Photo

Selecting an appropriate photo to accompany one's wishes enhances the overall impact of the message, making it not only more meaningful and appealing but also engaging for readers. A well-chosen image can evoke emotions, clarify ideas, and attract attention, thereby enriching the reader's experience and providing a visual context that complements the written content.

* * *

#### Highlights

##### Admin Features

  * The admin can set the price for sending each wish and define the maximum number of times a user can send a wish after purchasing it.
  * The admin can choose whether all wishes are free or require payment.
  * The admin can view all invoices related to user payments for sending wishes, including transaction statuses, in the admin panel.

##### User Features

  * Users can create wish listings, but the price and number of shares allowed are automatically set based on the admin’s settings.
  * Users must pay the specified amount before sending a wish to their friends.
  * Users can view their purchased wishes on the "Purchased Wishes" page under the "My Wishes" tab.
  * Users can access their purchased wish invoices on the "Bought Invoices" page, where they can track the number of times they have shared a wish and the remaining shares available as per the invoice.
  * Users can see their purchased or received wishes on their profile page.

The **Page** is the place for your users to specifically create public profiles such as businesses, brands, organizations, public figures, and other causes. Pages do not gain friends but fans or followers who choose to LIKE that specific Page.

###### **Key Features**

  * Browse pages that the viewer has permission to view
  * Support Quick Navigation: All Pages, My Pages, Friends' Pages, Liked Pages, Page Invites
  * Support change page name & category, page description, page photo, page permission (Includes page privacy and member permissions on actions such as posting, who can view page posts...)
  * Invite users to pages via messenger or email (Can add a custom personal message to the invitation)
  * Assign a unique URL for page
  * Members can be promoted to page admin
  * Owner and moderators can manage pages such as edit / delete / sponsor
  * Moderators can use some specific mass actions on multiple selected items at once
  * Can search pages by keyword, categories, and some other criteria
  * Page's owners have the ability to configure all things on their pages, such as setting the permission for users to perform some actions on pages, adjusting the information of pages, adding more widgets to present their pages better, deleting contents posted by their users if they're not suitable for their businesses, and so on.
  * Users can claim a page if they see that this is the page for their businesses. All claims will be sent to the admin to accept/deny them. Once admin accepts a claim, its owner will be the owner of the corresponding page
  * Support many settings in AdminCP
  * Admin can configure Permission settings in AdminCP
  * Support manage categories in AdminCP
  * Before deleting a category, admin can select another category to move all existing pages of that category

**Photo** are the most essential section of all social network communities. Hence, we not only provide you with the photo app as a core feature of phpFox but also include many trending actions to make it more attractive. Your members can upload photos to a public gallery or to their own set of photo albums. While uploading photos, your members can decide the privacy level of who can view their photos online.

###### **Key Features**

\- Browse photos that the viewer has permission to view
\- Filter photos by menu: All Photos, My Photos, Friends' Photos, All Albums, My Albums
\- Moderators can use mass actions to feature / un-feature / delete some selected items
\- Search photos by keyword, filter photos by some criteria
\- Classify photos by categories
\- Support like, comment, share, report on photos
\- View photo detail and its information
\- Owner and moderators can manage photo
\- Can view all photos of the album
\- Manage privacy for photos and albums, restrict audience who can view photos/albums
\- Support SEO meta keywords and SEO meta description
\- Can configure Permission settings for each role
\- Admin can add, edit, delete, reorder categories
\- When deleting a category, admin can select another category to move all existing photos
\- Can configure the responsive size, number of photos in each block

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**
  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to AdminCP > App Settings, searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

  * Browse polls that viewer has permission to view
  * Support quick navigations: All Polls, My Polls, Friends' Polls
  * Can search polls by keyword, categories and some other criteria
  * Each poll has title, owner name, some lines of statistics of votes
  * Owner and moderators can manage poll as edit / delete
  * Moderators can use mass actions on multiple selected items
  * Users can view poll content, vote, view result of poll, vote again, comment, share, report
  * Support AddThis to share the poll into other networks
  * Manage privacy for polls to restrict who can see polls
  * Support time settings
  * Admin can configure Permission settings for each user role in AdminCP
  * Can manage categories in AdminCP
  * Before deleting a category, admin can select another category to move all existing polls of that category.

This powerful plugin integrates a robust Property App into your website, offering a seamless experience for property sales, rentals, and leases. With features tailored for agents, owners, and a built-in mortgage calculator, this app is designed to make property management more efficient and user-friendly.

#### **Key Features**

##### **Mobile Responsive**

App design is fully mobile responsive for any device!

##### **Sale / Lease Property**

Users to post residential or commercial property listings as a seller, including important details such as contact information, amenities, prices, and category. This provides potential buyers with a comprehensive overview of the property, making it easier for them to find properties that meet their needs and budget. Additionally, the platform can also include features such as high-quality photos and maps to help buyers visualize the property and its location.

##### **Location-based Listing**

By enabling users to create property listings based on specific locations, the platform enhances visibility and reach, attracting a broader target audience. This localization strategy not only caters to potential buyers or renters looking for properties in particular areas but also allows sellers and landlords to better connect with interested parties, ultimately boosting engagement and sales opportunities.

##### **Rent Property**

Users to post residential or commercial rental property listings, including important details such as contact information, amenities, prices, and category. This provides potential buyers with a comprehensive overview of the property, making it easier for them to find properties that meet their needs and budget. Additionally, the platform can also include features such as high-quality photos and maps to help buyers visualize the property and its location.

##### **Advanced Search Filter**

Search for properties that fit your needs using our advanced filter options. Quickly narrow down your search by selecting specific criteria such as property deal type, property owner type, sort, location, price range, and more. Our advanced filters allow you to drill down to the most relevant properties for your search, making it easier to find your perfect match.

##### **Agents, Owners and Interior Designer**

User can post a property listing as an Agent, Property Owner and Interior Designer. As the Property Owner, user may list their own property directly and as an Interior Designer, showcasing their design work on a property they have designed or worked on.

##### **Mortgage Calculator**

Here is a simple mortgage calculator that can help you estimate your monthly mortgage payments. Please note that this is a basic calculator and does not take into account additional costs such as property taxes, insurance, and maintenance.

Questions and Answers play a crucial role in businesses, e-commerce platforms, and online communities by enabling users to ask queries and receive immediate responses not only from website administrators but also from fellow users. This interactive feature fosters a collaborative environment where users can seek help on a wide range of topics, including site-specific questions, general issues, coding problems, or inquiries related to particular locations like countries or cities, enhancing user engagement and overall site value.

The Question & Answer plugin is a highly powerful and robust tool designed to enhance your MetaFox site by allowing users to ask questions and receive answers, thereby creating a comprehensive Q&A system. It provides flexibility to tailor question and answer features to your website's needs or specific ideas, fostering better user engagement, knowledge sharing, and community interaction across your platform.

#### **Key Features**

##### **Is It Helpful?**

Adding an "Is It Helpful?" feature allows users to provide valuable feedback on answers, helping to identify which responses effectively solve problems and improve the overall quality of the Q&A system. This user-driven validation encourages more accurate and helpful answers, fosters community trust, and enhances the platform’s reliability by highlighting the most useful solutions for other users seeking assistance.

##### **2 Question Types – Descriptive Text & Poll**

Users are allowed to ask Questions in two different ways on your website. It can be:
1\. Textual Descriptive Type Question
2\. Poll Type Question

##### **Voting on Questions & Answers**

You can allow your users to submit their votes for the Questions and their Answers on your website.

##### **Unlimited Questions**

Users can create Unlimited Questions, Submit Answers, Search and Filter, Edit or Delete questions by their Categories and Tags on your website.

##### **Categories**

Categories can be displayed in Square view on your website with their icons or images. These icons and images are uploaded from the admin panel for each category.

##### **Advanced Search**

This plugin provides you the Advanced searching option for the Questions your users have created on your website.

##### **Featured / Sponsored Questions**

To easily display featured or sponsored badges that identify the best questions according to specific requirements, you can implement a straightforward badge system within your platform's interface.

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**
  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to AdminCP > App Settings, searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

**Reactions** is a crucial feature for every social network and online community, comparable to popular platforms like Facebook and Instagram. It amplifies user engagement and expression by providing a diverse set of interactive reactions for users to respond to posts, comments, and messages. This feature goes beyond simple likes and offers a range of emotive reactions that enable users to express their feelings, opinions, and sentiments in a more nuanced and personalized manner.

###### **Benefits**

  * **Enhanced Expression** : The Reactions feature expands the range of user expression beyond a simple "like" button. Users can choose from a selection of reactions to convey a broader spectrum of emotions, opinions, and sentiments, enabling more nuanced and personalized engagement.
  * **Increased Engagement** : The availability of multiple reaction options promotes increased user engagement. Users can easily and quickly respond to content in a way that resonates with them, encouraging active participation and dialogue within the social network.
  * **Improved Communication** : Reactions provide additional channels for communication and understanding. Users can express empathy, support, humor, or other sentiments through their reactions, fostering clearer and more meaningful communication within the social network community.
  * **Social Validation** : The display of reaction counts provides social validation and feedback on the impact of content. Users can see how their posts and comments are received, fostering a sense of connection and recognition within the social network.
  * **Customization and Personalization** : The option to personalize reactions allows users to align their digital expressions with their individual style and preferences. This feature adds a personal touch to interactions and enhances the sense of identity within the social network.

### SMS <a id="appstore-pages-apps-sms"></a>

**Path:** `appstore/pages/apps/sms.md`  ·  **Source:** <https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/sms/>

![SMS](https://phpfox-store.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2022/11/28075427/icon-SMS.png)

##### SMS

[Apps](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps) / [Spam & Security](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/?category=spam-security), [Ultilities](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/?category=user-tools) · [phpFox](https://appstore.phpfox.com/expert/phpFox/)

**SMS** has become a SHOULD-Have feature on every social network site for a variety of reasons. First, SMS verification can help protect user accounts from hackers by providing an extra layer of security. With an SMS verification system, users will be required to enter a security code sent to their mobile phone before accessing their account. This means that even if a hacker has access to the user's password, they won't be able to log into the account without the code. Second, SMS verification can help social network sites to protect user data by verifying the identity of users. By verifying users' identities, sites can ensure that user data is only accessible by the rightful owner. Finally, SMS verification can help social network sites to prevent spam and other malicious activity. By verifying users' identities, sites can more easily identify and block malicious users and bots.

**From Matches to Memories**

Your next great connection could be just a click away.
Discover meaningful connections with ease. Whether you're searching for companionship, romance, or lifelong love, our platform adapts to your preferences to deliver tailored matches.
Meet your ideal partner, no more endless swiping. Let our platform bring the right people to you.

###### Key Features

**User Verification**

  * Profile linked to Metafox, minimizing fake accounts

**Matchmaking Method – Suggestion list:**

  * Use a simple approach that applies the OR method to combine all search conditions and generate the Suggestion list.
  * This algorithm will continue to be enhanced to improve the match suggestion method in next versions.

**Privacy Controls**

  * Private matching
  * Limited privacy controls; profiles are public
  * Take a break
  * Delete Account

**Chat Features**

  * Built-in text messaging within the app.
  * Basic text chat with GIF support, photo and attachment sharing.

**Dating Goals**

  * Allows users to specify their intentions (e.g., casual, serious relationship)

**Profile Customization**

  * Limited customization, with some personality questions
  * Multiple photos and short bios

**Safety Features**

  * Block/report features, and private messaging only after mutual interest

**Paid Features**

  * Free to use, no monetized features

**Cross-Cultural Features**

  * Basic text chat; no translation tools

**Custom Dating Experience**

  * Emphasis on random matches based on location and preferences

Almost all app features support the MetaFox mobile apps. Please contact us or phpFox to rebuild your mobile apps to enable Social Dating.

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

If you have already purchased the app licenses on the [Appstore](https://appstore.phpfox.com/).

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**

If you have not purchased the app licenses.

  * Let's log into**AdminCP > Apps > Find More**
  * Search and then view the app you would like to purchase.
  * You can click on the Purchase button to process payment via PayPal.
  * Once payment is made successfully, the app license will automatically be added and associated with your MetaFox license. You will verify your purchase in the **AdminCP > Apps > Purchased**.

**Installation**

  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to **AdminCP** > **App Settings** , searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

##### Installation Guide

You can refer to the general guide to install apps [here](https://docs.phpfox.com/display/MFMAN/Install+and+Uninstall+apps).

If the content of Home page has been modified with Layout Editor, you will need to take the following steps to manually add the Social Invitation block into the Home page after installing the app within AdminCP successfully

  * Go to the Home page
  * Enable  _**Layout Editor**_ mode in the top-right dropdown User Menu. Then choose  _**Edit Page Content**_ option
  * Click on the **Plus** icon on the right _**subside**_ section to add a block into this area, as we would like Social Invitation block to display on the right panel of this page.
  * On the **Add Block** form, search _Social Invitation_ and click **Add Block** button
  * Save Changes and Publish Layout on the Layout Editor form. You will need to confirm the rebuild the web to apply the block.

Once the web is built and updated successfully, the **_Social Invitation_** block will display on the Home page.

**SocialEngine Exporter** is a FREE app that exports data from SocialEngine to MetaFox. Yes, you got it right! Moving to MetaFox from SocialEngine can't be easier without the help of this app. You don't need to worry about losing data on your current SocialEngine site. Get it now and enjoy the functionalities of MetaFox!

###### Notices

  * MUST back up fully the MetaFox site before importing data.
  * Since the data importation may take many minutes to complete, please increase the PHP parameter of the server timeout (most servers have a default PHP max_execution_time of 30 seconds).
  * While data is being exported, DO NOT refresh or close the browser tab.

##### Feature List

  * Export data from SocialEngine to import all MetaFox sites
  * Support SocialEngine 6.5.x - 6.6.x
  * Support SocialEngine sites that do not adjust the database of the core script
  * Core modules/data will be imported into MetaFox:
    * Users and their friendships
    * Feeds and their likes, comments, shares
    * Likes, comments, shares on items
    * Notifications
    * Blogs
    * Albums and photos
    * Classified listings
    * Polls
    * Videos
    * Music
    * Events
    * Forum
    * Groups
    * Messages
    * Settings which are the same functionality as the ones on MetaFox
    * Member-level settings with the same functionality as the ones on MetaFox
    * Announcements
    * Mail
    * CDN
  * Some types of feed will be imported
    * Create new Blog
    * Post new Status
    * Change profile photo
    * Create new Event
    * Create a new Topic (forum)
    * Reply a topic
    * Two users became friends
    * Create a new classified (listing)
    * Shared a Photo
    * Shared an album photo
    * User is tagged in a photo
    * Shared a Video
    * Created a Poll
    * Comment on groups
    * Shared a Link
  * Exclusion
    * Chat
    * Ads
    * Translation
    * Custom fields
    * Subscription plans
    * Member levels
  * Some notices:
    * If a group does not have a category on the SocialEngine site, after importing, its category on MetaFox will be the first category.
    * The system does not import notifications.
    * The system will not import duplicate users. That means if user A already exists on both the SocialEngine site and the MetaFox site, the system only imports data of A from the SocialEngine site to the MetaFox site.

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**
  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to AdminCP > App Settings, searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

**Stories** on MetaFox is an innovative feature enabling users to share dynamic moments through captivating photos/videos and texts that disappear after 24 hours. Individuals can choose their audience with customizable privacy controls, maintaining a personalized sharing experience. The responsive design ensures a seamless experience across devices, and cross-platform integration enables the sharing of Stories beyond the MetaFox community. Explore a diverse Stories feed, connect with creators, and bring your MetaFox experience to life through visual storytelling.

###### **Key Features**

  * Explore the diverse world of community members' stories with user-friendly browsing features.
  * Interact seamlessly with stories by playing, pausing, muting/unmuting, reporting, sending messages to story owners, reacting, and copying shareable links.
  * Navigate through stories effortlessly using convenient arrow icons to browse previous and next stories.
  * Unleash creativity by crafting stories with either text or photos/videos, offering a spectrum of customization options.
    * Text Stories allow style modifications, background image selection, and text color adjustments.
    * Photo/Video Stories supports local machine uploads along with story preview functionality.
    * Set privacy preferences, choose from default options (Community, Friends) or Custom settings (select specific people to share the story with).
    * Define story expiration time.
  * Empower users to manage their stories, receive notifications for reactions or replies, and view a comprehensive list of story viewers.
  * Admin capabilities include adding and managing multiple background collections for Text Stories, granting various permissions (view, delete, comment, etc.) to specific user roles, and configuring the display style of stories on the Home page.

###### Installation Guide

You can refer to the general guide for installing apps [here](https://docs.phpfox.com/display/MFMAN/Install+and+Uninstall+apps).

If the content of the Home page has been modified with Layout Editor, you will need to take the following steps to manually add the Story Listing block to the Home page after successfully installing the app within AdminCP.

  * Go to the Home page
  * Enable _**Layout Editor**_ mode in the top-right dropdown User Menu. Then, choose the _**Edit Page Content**_ option.
  * Click on the **Plus** icon in the main section to add a block to this area. We want the Stories block to be displayed on the Main panel of this page.
  * On the **Add Block** form, search _Story Listing Block_ and click the **Add Block** button.
  * Save Changes and Publish the Layout on the Layout Editor form. To apply the block, you will need to confirm the rebuild of the web.

Once the web is built and updated successfully, the Stories block will display on the Home page.

  * [ ![](https://phpfox-store.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/06/30050811/stripe_edit_key-1024x500.png) ](https://phpfox-store.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2023/06/30050811/stripe_edit_key.png)

Stripe payment gateway app helps to extend more capacity to make payments on your MetaFox site. As Stripe's official information, Stripe supports 135+ currencies and makes it easy to make payments.

Supported currencies: AUD, BRL, CAD, CZK, DKK, EUR, HKD, ILS, MXN, NZD, NOK, PHP, PLN, GBP, RUB, SGD, SEK, CHF, THB, USD.

Currently, Stripe payment gateway app supports MetaFox core apps:

  * Subscriptions
  * Activity point packages
  * And Sponsors.

In addition, the billing cycle option is also compatible with recurring payment mechanisms on core subscriptions. This helps the payment flexibility and will help to reduce the number of subscriptions dropped in the middle.

With the integration of Stripe, a leading global payment processor, we offers a secure, reliable, and scalable payment solution on MetaFox. Unlock a wide range of payment methods, including credit cards, digital wallets, and local payment options, to cater to your customers' diverse preferences and increase conversion rates.

###### Key Features:

  1. **Streamlined Checkout Experience** : Provide your customers with a smooth and user-friendly checkout process, ensuring a hassle-free payment experience. The intuitive interface guides users through the payment process, reducing cart abandonment and maximizing sales.
  2. **Secure Payment Processing** : Safeguard sensitive customer data with Stripe's advanced security measures, including secure tokenization and PCI compliance. Rest assured that every transaction is protected, maintaining the trust and confidence of your customers.
  3. **Subscription Management** : Effortlessly manage recurring billing and subscriptions with ease. Set up subscription plans, offer trial periods, and handle upgrades or cancellations seamlessly, empowering you to monetize your services and drive predictable revenue.
  4. **Multi-Currency Support** : Expand your global reach by accepting payments in multiple currencies. With Stripe's robust currency support, you can effortlessly transact with customers from around the world, enhancing your international business capabilities.

by[YouNet Social](https://appstore.phpfox.com/expert/younet/)

###### **Installation Guide**

This guide aims to assist you in installing apps in your MetaFox site's AdminCP. Ensure that you have administrative access to the MetaFox site.

###### **Purchase**

If you have already purchased the app licenses on the [Appstore](https://appstore.phpfox.com/).

  * Let's log into **AdminCP** > **Apps** > **Purchased**

If you have not purchased the app licenses.

  * Let's log into**AdminCP > Apps > Find More**
  * Search and then view the app you would like to purchase.
  * You can click on the Purchase button to process payment via PayPal.
  * Once payment is made successfully, the app license will automatically be added and associated with your MetaFox license. You will verify your purchase in the **AdminCP > Apps > Purchased**.

###### **Installation**

  * Now, click on the app you want to install.
  * Click on the Install/Reinstall button to start installing the app. Wait for the installation to complete.
  * During the installation, the site will send a build request to the MetaFox Build service to build a front-end web with the new app. Thus, the app may take a few minutes to display on the front end.
  * After installing successfully, you can reload the AdminCP and start configuring the app as needed by going to AdminCP > App Settings, searching for the newly installed app, and accessing its settings.

###### **Set up Stripe payment gateway**

  * Register your [Stripe account](https://dashboard.stripe.com/register) if you haven't got one.
  * **Configure Keys**
    * Sign in the Stripe account
    * Click on Developers on the top corner to open the Developers mode
    * Open API Keys tab, copy the Publishable Key / Secret key
    * Go to MetaFox AdminCP > App Settings > Payment > Stripe > Edit, paste these keys to the corresponding fields.
  * **Configure Webhook**
    * Back to the Stripe site, open Webhooks tab
    * Click on _**Add an Endpoint**_ button
    * On the Endpoint URL field, we have two options:
      * If your site has configured API Route Prefix, then Url will be _https://domain/prefix/stripe/notify_
      * If your site has used default API Route Prefix, then Url will be _https://domain/api/v1/stripe/notify_
    * Click on _**Select events**_ to add events that you want to use, we have two options:
      * Select “Select all events” checkbox to use add all events.
      * Select events which we suggestion for you because they are truly necessary:
        * _**customer.subscription.created**_ : Occurs whenever a customer is signed up for a new plan.
        * _**customer.subscription.updated**_ : Occurs whenever a subscription changes (e.g., switching fr om one plan to another, or changing the status fr om trial to active).
        * _**customer.subscription.deleted**_ : Occurs whenever a customer’s subscription ends.
        * _**invoice.payment_succeeded**_ : Occurs whenever an invoice payment attempt succeeds.
        * _**checkout.session.completed**_ : Occurs when a Checkout Session has been successfully completed.
    * Finally, click on **Add events** button to finish.
  * **Activate Stripe gateway**
    * Go to MetaFox ACP > App Settings > Payment and enable the Stripe gateway to use.
