[Getting Started](/getting-started/ "Getting Started")Update MetaFox

#### Update MetaFox

MetaFox site can be updated easily and quickly in 2 ways:

  * Update in AdminCP 
  * Update manually



Before updating MetaFox site, please create full backup first so you can restore your site if having any problems during the Product Update process. MetaFox already supports **Backup** feature in **AdminCP** > **Maintenance** > **Backup**

Assume that you already back up your site successfully. Now, we can go ahead to update MetaFox site.

##### Update in AdminCP

In AdminCP > Site status, there will be a Update link if new version is available for your site to upgrade.

![Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.13.48.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.13.48.9583e9b1.png)

Click on the Update link to go to the **Update Wizard**

![Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.16.24.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.16.24.3479a424.png)

Assume to you have created backup, click the **Continue** button to move to the next step to select apps to update

![Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.16.50.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.16.50.8ce6a1d8.png)

In the **Application** step, you can select apps you would like to upgrade along with MetaFox Core at this time. Select All to update all apps. Then click the **Continue** button to start updating

![Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.17.08.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.17.08.71bf9284.png)

New MetaFox package and apps will be downloaded and updated on your site. It will take a few minutes to complete the updating.

![Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.29.29.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-06-19 at 18.29.29.9cf081c6.png)

##### Update manually

In this way, you will need to download the latest MetaFox package in Client Area and upload source on your server.

Then, go to the MetaFox Installation Wizard at URL: _**yourdomain.com/install/**_ to start updating MetaFox. _Note: you need to replace the yourdomain.com with the actual domain of your MetaFox site._

At the 1st **Prepare** step, you are recommended to back up your site before proceeding the Product Update.

![Screen Shot 2023-02-16 at 11.18.10.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-02-16 at 11.18.10.a839a5e5.png)

Once your MetaFox is backed up, you can click on **Continue** button to start updating the MetaFox site.

![Screen Shot 2023-02-16 at 11.18.20.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-02-16 at 11.18.20.993db347.png)

After the Product Update process will automatically go through all the necessary steps to upgrade your site and rebuild the frontend (web). The site will be inaccessible during the Product Update process and launched after completed.

![Screen Shot 2023-02-16 at 11.39.50.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-02-16 at 11.39.50.a2f30fe2.png)

[Manage Community](/manage-community/ "Manage Community")[Manage users](/manage-community/manage-users/ "Manage users")Assign users to certain roles

#### Assign users to certain roles

This article will show you how to find and change the user’s role. This assumes you are already logged in as the Admin user and are logged into **the AdminCP**.

On the slide of the **Menu** bar, go to **Members** , then select **Browse**

You will be redirected to the **Browser** page and can see the user list. Click on the **Gear** icon of the user you want to update role and choose **Edit** option.

![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 09.07.52.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 09.07.52.9b7a0d4a.png)

From the **Role** section, choose the specific user group that want to move the user to. 

![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 09.09.09.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 09.09.09.4a1376de.png)

Then, you can click the button **Save Changes** to update the user with the selected role.

  * Configure permissions within App Settings



[Question? Give us feedback →](https://clients.phpfox.com/submitticket.php?step=2&deptid=1)

[Manage Community](/manage-community/ "Manage Community")[Manage users](/manage-community/manage-users/ "Manage users")Configure Role Permissions

#### Configure Role Permissions

This section serves as your detailed guide to customizing and fine-tuning role-based access control within the MetaFox product. This manual empowers administrators and users with elevated privileges to effectively manage and define permissions associated with various roles, ensuring a secure and tailored user experience.

Let’s start by logging into your MetaFox site with the Admin user. Then go to AdminCP Dashboard > Members > Permissions

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 15.02.31.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 15.02.31.02e0fa6b.png)

Select the **Role** you would like to configure permissions and the **App Name** to filter its available permissions. In the screenshot below, we will configure the permissions of Registered Users on the Blog app.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 15.05.05.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 15.05.05.a2fd88de.png)

You can toggle the option of certain permission to enable or disable that permission on the chosen user role.

Click the **Save Changes** button to apply your configuration.

###### Configure permissions within App Settings

In the other way, some apps, such as Events, Blogs, etc., may support configuring permission directly within their App Settings area for convenience.

For example, you can configure the permissions of the Blog app by going to **AdminCP** > **App Settings** > **Blog** > **Permissions**

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 15.12.14.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 15.12.14.ff2e27c6.png)

That’s all.

[Create user roles](/manage-community/manage-users/create-user-roles/ "Create user roles")[Assign users to certain roles](/manage-community/manage-users/assign-users-to-certain-roles/ "Assign users to certain roles")

[Manage Community](/manage-community/ "Manage Community")[Manage users](/manage-community/manage-users/ "Manage users")Create user roles

#### Create user roles

This guide will walk you through steps to create user roles in MetaFox. Let’s go.

Log into your MetaFox site with Admin user. Then go to **AdminCP Dashboard >** **Members** > **Roles** and click the **Add New Role** link on the top-right corner to create a new role.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 14.44.26.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 14.44.26.a407ca6d.png)

In the Create New Role form, fill in the role name and choose an existing role to copy permissions of that role to the new one. It will save you much time to set up role permissions 

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 14.49.09.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 14.49.09.63b4ddbe.png)

Then, click the **Create** button.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 14.54.41.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 14.54.41.912d15d8.png)

That’s it. You just completed the procedure of Role creation. You can go ahead to , as well as associated with this role.

On This Page

  * In this post, we show you where you can take a closer look at the traffic stats you can quickly view on your website, the numbers that show how your site is doing. 



[Question? Give us feedback →](https://clients.phpfox.com/submitticket.php?step=2&deptid=1)

[Manage Community](/manage-community/ "Manage Community")View site statistics

#### View site statistics

###### In this post, we show you where you can take a closer look at the traffic stats you can quickly view on your website, the numbers that show how your site is doing. 

  * Select the **Dashboard** tab in Admin CP. Here you’ll see a overview of the general information needed to know. 



![image2022-12-13_16-47-34.png](/_next/static/media/image2022-12-13_16-47-34.bf5b9b0a.png)

  * You can find your total number of **users, blogs, pages** … depending on the type of app you choose, you can also view the statistics graph in **Daily** and **Weekly**.



![image2022-12-13_17-2-34.png](/_next/static/media/image2022-12-13_17-2-34.6857d857.png)

![image2022-12-13_17-3-1.png](/_next/static/media/image2022-12-13_17-3-1.a40498e9.png)

On the right, you’ll see the **in-depth stats** of your site including the **Today Statistics** and **Site Statistics.** Click on **the View more** button for more apps to view.

![image2022-12-13_17-7-17.png](/_next/static/media/image2022-12-13_17-7-17.5222f6f3.png) ![image2022-12-13_17-8-3.png](/_next/static/media/image2022-12-13_17-8-3.76b1a7b9.png)

Scrolling down a little bit, you find the following information:

  * Latest ACP Logins: 
  * New and Updates: Admin can stay updated on new blogs here
  * Site Status: here you can find the status of your license, the expiration of your support plan, and the site version. 



![image2022-12-13_17-12-34.png](/_next/static/media/image2022-12-13_17-12-34.fab4f489.png)

[Question? Give us feedback →](https://clients.phpfox.com/submitticket.php?step=2&deptid=1)

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.0.2

#### MetaFox 5.0.2

##### **What’s new**

New Features / Improvements

  * UI/UX Improvements on all apps
    * Navigation: add breadcrumbs, counts , etc. 
    * Content display: straightforward phrases, number format, page layout, feed items, icons, etc.
  * Chat/ChatPlus
    * Improve display of replies to messages having photo and text
  * Photos
    * Update feed items of new albums of Page/Group
    * Remove the “Can download images” permission
  * Groups
    * Send a notification to the group’s owner after members edit and re-submit their declined posts.
    * Don’t show the “Add new item” button for guests
    * Remove the accept/decline option on the group listing page when users are invited to become admin/ moderator.
  * Quizzes
    * Users can view the list of people who answered this question when clicking on the number of total plays
    * Remove the Delete button on the “This quiz is in pending state” section
  * Polls
    * Support CAPTCHA challenge when submitting a new poll
  * Comments
    * Hide ‘Remove Preview’ option for Guests
    * Hide sort comment section after users delete comments
  * Forums
    * Add bottom pagination in Forum Details and Thread Details page
    * Sticky threads are displayed in Forum and Subforums only. Not display sticky threads on Forum Home
    * Support “Can reply all threads?” permission
    * Set the default Sort option with the last replies
    * Users can search wiki threads
    * Support Forum description
    * Remove “Display on Wiki” option when creating a new thread on Page/Group
  * Marketplace
    * Listings displayed on the History page are ordered by latest, based on the time of the first visit.
  * SEO
    * Support generating Sitemap for SEO
    * Support preview info when sharing items on Social network, such as Facebook, Twitter
  * Notification
    * Support web push notification on browsers
  * Saved Items
    * Support actions of View Member list and Leave Collection 
  * Events
    * Event owner cannot invite hosts if the “Can edit own events” permission is turned off
    * Improve navigation flow when users view on map in the Event detail
  * Others
    * Have “Show your location” button when users view content on map
    * Admin can edit members’ usernames
    * Admin can configure the site that how long the notification will be automatically refreshed
    * Add more permissions for apps, such as forum, events, etc. in AdminCP
    * Able to filter users having “Not approved” status
    * Support Manage Categories and Auto responder for Contact form
    * Hide “Invite people to come” on items that have “Only me” privacy
    * Improve workflow when admin edits the user’s info in AdminCP
    * Create Feed items of new announcements for Super Admin and users who have permission to view



And, many bugs found have been resolved.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.10

#### MetaFox 5.1.10

**Release Date: May 22, 2024**

##### **Core and App Updates**

###### Featured Items (NEW)

###### User Features

  1. **Dashboard**

     * Overview of featured items
     * Quick access to invoice management
  2. **Item Management**

     * Submit items to be featured
     * Track status of submitted items
  3. **Invoice Management**

     * View and download invoices
     * Payment history
     * Outstanding payments
     * Payment methods (credit card, PayPal, etc.)
  4. **Package Selection**

     * Browse and select packages for featuring items
     * Detailed package descriptions and pricing
  5. **Notifications**

     * Email and in-app notifications for invoice due dates



###### Admin Features

  1. **Dashboard**

     * Overview of total earnings
     * Quick access to manage invoices, packages, and transactions
     * System alerts and notifications
  2. **Invoice Management**

     * View and manage all user invoices
     * Create, edit, and delete invoices
     * Track payment statuses
     * Generate reports on invoice activities
  3. **Package Management**

     * Create, edit, and delete featured packages
     * Set pricing, duration for each featured package
     * Special promotions and discounts management
  4. **Transaction Management**

     * View and manage all transactions
     * Track payment gateway integrations
     * Refund processing
     * Transaction history and reporting



###### Core

  * UI/UX Improvements

    * On User Profile when switching tabs or showing user details
    * When editing items that belong to deactivated categories
  * Custom Fields

  * Enable validation on the Text field with regex rules.

  * Support sortable options for Multiple Selection field

  * Able to control role-based field visibilities.

  * AdminCP - Storage: Add setting to control file deletion upon removing related entities.




###### Feed

  * Support translation on posts with Google Translate
  * Administrators can delete feeds and all of its related items.
  * Support new permission to control “How many posts per day that user can post?”
  * Support Setting to control maximum characters for Post Status
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * The layout on the Feed Type’s table
    * Change the Title on the Edit Post screen on mobile apps
    * Space between the keyboard and icon bar when sharing the feed



###### Pages

  * Integrate with the Featured Items app
  * Users can input an “External Link” when creating a page.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * AdminCP - Manage Custom/Section fields: Add “Add Custom Field”/ “Add Section” link to the manage page.
    * Change the label on the Manage Group screen on mobile app.
    * Hide profile/cover photo on page detail after the admin deletes the photo.
  * Users can upload a profile picture for the page when creating it.



###### Groups

  * Integrate with the Featured Items app
  * Manage Group:
    * Allow group administrators to view the history of Membership Requests.
    * Support Membership Requests on mobile apps
  * Allow non-registered users to access secret groups via invitation links.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * On workflow of sharing an item link from a Closed/Secret group to the discussion in the same group.
    * Add a confirmation message before saving the group privacy setting.
    * The success message when users invite friends to join the group.
    * Change the label on the Manage Group screen on mobile app.
    * AdminCP - Manage Custom/Section fields: Add “Add Custom Field”/ “Add Section” link to the manage page
  * Add “Who can view members?” permission to control who can view the group members.



###### Comments

  * Support translation on comments/replies with Google Translate
  * UI/UX Improvements 
    * Mobile app - Add the background per comment when viewing the comment/reply listing.
    * Mobile app - The comment screen when there is no comment display.



###### Social Connect

  * Update for compatibility with Core v5.1.10



###### Blog

  * Support removing storage files after deleting the Blog.
  * Integrate with the Featured Items app.



###### Events

  * Integrate with the Featured Items app
  * Support exporting events to ICS file
  * Support importing events to Mobile Calendar
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Remove the text “Commenting on this post has been turned off.” below the event feed.
    * Display the Name Page/Group on the Event detail when the user role has no permission to view the Page/Group
    * AdminCP: Enable event ordering by default for ongoing and upcoming events.



###### Stories

  * UI/UX improvements
    * For the progress bar when viewing the video story.
    * The video story layout when waiting for processing.
    * The layout of the text story when viewing the detail.
    * Add the pointer on the Create Text Story page on mobile apps.
    * The line below the header on the story detail page.
  * Improve performance
  * Support parsing hyperlinks in the content when creating a new story on mobile apps.



###### Friends

  * Optimize performance of Friend Suggestion.
  * Minor UI/UX Improvements.



###### E-Wallet

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * AdminCP - The text on the Exchange Rates page.
    * The message when there are no currencies to withdraw.
  * Support users can define the minimum withdrawal for each currency.



###### Site Background

  * Update for compatibility with Core v5.1.10



###### Status Background

  * AdminCP - Admin can configure text color (black / white) for individual background photo.



###### Sticker

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Add the message when the Recent tab is empty



###### Search

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Automatically focus the cursor on search text box when opening the Global Search.



###### Marketplace

  * Support Manage Invoices in AdminCP
  * Integrate with the Featured Items app
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * AdminCP - The workflow when users view the order details on ACP.
    * AdminCP - Phrases for an invoice detail page.
    * Mobile apps - The “To” field when searching for the Sold/Bought Invoices screen.



###### Photos

  * UI/UX Improvements 
    * When adding photos to the album
    * Remove the black background on the Photo/Video on the Photo Album
    * The layout on the Photo Block
    * Add the pending icon in the pending video on the photo album
  * Mobile apps - Support editing video after uploading them to the album photo
  * Integrate with the Featured Items app



###### Video

  * Integrate with the Featured Items app
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Layout for the Videos block when the video does not title
    * Hide the dot on “Remove from Saved list” on the saved video.
    * The loading page when users cancel the “Add New Video” page on the page, group, or user profile.
    * Remove a space on the notification when follower users upload a video.



###### Live Video

  * Integrate with the Featured Items app.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * The workflow when viewing the live video detail page.
    * The loading screen on create live video page.



###### Music

  * Integrate with the Featured Items app.
  * Support removing storage files after deleting music songs or albums.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Layout on “Your Playlist” block.



###### Poll

  * Integrate with the Featured Items app.
  * Support removing storage files after deleting polls.



###### Reactions

  * Support creating reactions using GIF files.



###### Hashtag

  * UI/UX Improvement on the hashtag when viewing the edit history popup (Post, Comment,..)



###### Advertise

  * AdminCP - Improve the workflow when users view the order details on ACP.



###### Invitation

  * Add a new setting to control whether invited users can be approved automatically after registration.



###### Subscription

  * Mobile apps - Support “View Packages” on Register Form like Web version.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * AdminCP - Update the empty description when there is no result to show on the Manage Subscription page.



###### Activity Points

  * UI/UX Improvements

    * Phrase when Admin revoked user’s point

    * Mobile apps - Hide the submit button on the Conversion Request screen when users do not have points.

    * Mobile apps - Disable the Activity Point option on the Payment Gateway popup when users do not have enough points to pay.

    * The notification when admins give 1 point to a user.

    * The warning message when adjusting the member point.

    * The notification when users receive 1 point from other users.




###### Quizzes

  * Integrate with the Featured Items app.
  * Support removing storage files after deleting quizzes.



###### Saved Items

  * Support removing storage files after deleting saved items.
  * Updates for Compatibility with MetaFox 5.1.10



###### Chat

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Add the tooltip on the listing header for the New Conversation button
    * The Settings form in AdmiCP.



###### Chatplus

  * Apply Firebase settings from Firebase app
  * UI/UX Improvements on layout of action sheet, typing icon, video player on mobile app.



###### Forum

  * UI/UX Improvements on the layout of dropdown in Search thread form.
  * Updates for Compatibility with MetaFox 5.1.10

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.11

#### MetaFox 5.1.11

**Release Date: June 26th, 2024**

###### Core 

  * Admin can define custom error messages for different contexts.
  * UI/UX Improvements on Web
    * Layout for Text Displaying on Presets of Editor Mode, Navigation.
    * Pagination on the Members page
    * Layout when viewing the feedback on the Cancel Members page.
    * Layout of Manage notification setting section when editing user
    * Unify the UX of the ‘Add New’ menu actions in AdminCP.
    * Description of the “Verify After Changing Phone Number” setting.
    * Description of some Quota Control’s settings.
    * Manage Reports - Hide the search form when there are no reported items.
    * Manage Members: Rephrase “Pending Verification Email / Phone Number” as “Unverified Email / Phone Number”
    * Users can input a number to modify the photo scale on CK Editor.
    * Login Popup - Add a link to the registration page and social login buttons.
    * Keep the current page(URL) when logging in to AdminCP instead of redirecting to the Dashboard
  * AdminCP
    * Manage Members:
      * Able to filter members by registration date and country.
      * Display the total count of search results.
      * Update the URL on the address bar with search parameters when searching.
      * Hide the Ban User option on the Super Admin.
    * Notify users having administrative privileges to approve members when new pending members are awaiting approval.
    * User Settings: revise the “User Role Filter Excludes” setting to control whether users of a specific role can be searched.
    * Custom Fields - The admin can reorder the Basic Information section
  * Improve the query performance when checking for blocked user relations.
  * Add Payment Settings group menu in Account Settings
  * Improve Payment app for third-party gateways
    * Support rules and request validation for 3party gateways in all payment apps
    * Support multiple-step payment form.
  * Can search Members by applicable custom fields upon choosing a specific role.
  * Show item’s category on the Item Detail page even though the category has been disabled.
  * Support opt-in for using email and SMS services on the Registration form
    * Add a new setting to control whether the opt-in agreement should be shown in the registration process.
    * Users will still receive email/SMS for Email Welcome, Verification Code , Authentication Code even though they don’t check this opt-in during Registration.
  * Remove default MetaFox Favicon for Fresh Site Installation
  * Account Setting - Notifications
    * Add a setting that allows users to control the entire notification channel.
    * Add the SMS Notifications page
  * Mobile Apps
    * The admin can configure menu items of the Account Settings menu in AdminCP.
    * Use logo configured in AdminCP on the Login screen.
    * Show No Internet page when device is offline
    * Add the option “Copy Link Profile” on the User Profile
    * Support grid layout for app menu and account settings menu
    * Users can unselect the current State/City on the Edit Profile Info page.
    * Add the search field when viewing the gender (I am) drop-down.
  * Fix bugs



###### Page

  * Page admins can manage the scheduled posts on the Page.
  * Fix bugs



###### Advertise

  * AdminCP - Add a setting to control whether users will be asked to purchase sponsorship after creating an item.
  * Mobile apps - Support the Create New Ad and Edit Ad screens
  * UI/UX Improvement on the breadcrumb when viewing the transaction detail in AdminCP



###### Event

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Replace the Start time with End Time on the Past event
    * Enhance the RSVP workflow by replacing the default “Not Interested” option with a grayed-out Interested button.
    * Hide the Discussion tab and the Composer post on event when a user can moderate event, but they don’t have permissions to start/view the discussion
  * Mobile apps - Hide the option “Generate Invite Link” on the private event
  * Fix bugs



###### Follow

  * Optimize performance as the follower database grows larger over time.



###### Friends

  * Friend Requests: Update phrase when there are no requests displayed
  * Fix bugs



###### Groups

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Discussions: Improve the layout for the Photos block
    * Remove redundant space characters on the notification that the user updates the cover photo of the group
  * Show item preview when sharing an item from a Closed/Secret group to the comment section in the same group.
  * Send notifications to group moderators when there are new member requests.
  * Fix bugs



###### Newsletter

  * Improve compatibility with v5.1.11.



###### Stories

  * Not allow to upload a video story if video services (Mux, FFMPEG) are unavailable.
  * AdminCP: Add a new setting to control the duration of the video story.
  * Fix bugs



###### Announcement

  * Admin can select multiple genders and locations when configuring announcements.
  * Fix bugs



###### Activity Points

  * Update for Compatibility with version 5.1.11.



###### Photos

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Theme Default - Apply round corners on photos in the listing page and detail album.
    * Update the default title of the avatar added during registration.
  * Fix bugs



###### ChatPlus

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Conversation listing when viewing it on the header menu.
    * Layout when editing Group Name on All Messages screen.
    * Phrases on the action menu of conversation.
  * Fix bugs



###### Marketplace

  * Users can reorder photos when adding/editing the listing.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Reorder the currency fields on the Add New Listing page.
    * Update the time format between the Invoice Listing and the Invoice Detail pages.
    * Update the placeholder text in the search field.
  * Fix bugs



###### Subscriptions

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * The breadcrumb when viewing the transaction detail in AdminCP
    * Subscription - Layout on the recurring package.
  * Fix bugs



###### EWallet

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Add more spaces between items in the Insights page
    * Add a line below the “Available” block to distinguish it from others.



###### Featured Items

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * On the Items/ Invoices page, disable future days for the date picker of the From/To field, only allowing the user can search data to the current date.
    * On the Items/ Invoices page, increase the padding above the Search filters.
    * Font size for the column name on some pages.
  * Mobile Apps:
    * Mobile Flatten - Support search by Time for the Items/Invoices page
    * Mobile Flatten - Items: Improve the layout of the package name and the Items/Invoices page.
  * Fix bugs



###### Forums

  * Hide the attachment file on the Quote Post form



###### Live Videos

  * UI/UX Improvement on the live video detail page after users reload the page or edit the video.



###### Music

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Layout on the Navigation menu.
    * Hover state of the music bar.
    * Layout for the song title on Album detail page.
  * Fix bugs



###### Polls

  * Integrate with Featured Items app.
  * UI/UX Improvements on the Navigation menu.
  * Fix bugs



###### Quizzes

  * Integrate with Featured Items app.
  * UI/UX Improvements on the Navigation menu.
  * Fix bugs



###### PayPal

  * Support the payment process with multiple steps.



###### Reactions

  * Fix bugs



###### Status Background

  * Fix bugs



###### Forum

  * Fix bugs



###### Saved Items

  * Fix bugs



###### Feed

  * Fix bugs



###### Comment

  * Fix bugs

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.12

#### MetaFox 5.1.12

**Release Date: July 30th, 2024**

###### Core 

  * Mobile apps - Update to SDK 34 to comply new target API requirement on Android 14
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web
      * Members - Improve UI of the Date Custom field
      * Account Settings - The Current Password field should be hidden the first time users register via the Social Connect app and set their passwords.
      * On the long setting forms in AdminCP, apply fixed position of the Submit buttons 
      * Refresh the breadcrumb automatically after the forum thread is changed.
      * User Profile - Adjust the locate of the search bar to the right side to sync with other pages on the Tablet layout
      * Not show required label on fields of country city
      * Cancel Account: Update the warning message on the Password field
      * On the Registration form, trim spaces before triggering email validation when handling email input
    * AdminCP
      * Menus - Hide menu items if associated apps are deactivated.
    * Mobile Apps
      * Move the settings option to the header view for better accessibility.
      * Update the phrase of the “Videos and Photos” setting.
      * Update the “Videos and Photos” text to “Video Settings” on the Account Settings page.
  * Socialite - Add a new setting to control whether the system should prompt users to set their passwords for the first time they register via the Socialite app.
  * Custom Fields:
    * Administrators can duplicate custom fields.
    * Add a new custom field component to enable users to enter URLs.
    * Not allow similar names of fields and sections to avoid overlapping issues when translating their labels.
  * Mail Settings: the email signature can be translatable into multiple languages.
  * Security Enhancement for MIME Proofing
  * SEO Improvements: Support canonical tags
  * Editor Mode: Support admin can config show/hide Icon menu on Header (Mobile Responsive)
  * Ordering items by “Recent” will be based on the creation date rather than by the item IDs.
  * Registration: Only send Pending approval user notifications to administrators after users verify their accounts.
  * Performance Improvements
    * Improve loading speed on frontend web by reducing chunk size.
    * Scan & refactor code that calls command cache:reset under a loop that might cause performance issues.
    * Optimize the performance of the cleanup notification jobs.
  * MFA: the email/SMS authentication should only be shown if the email and SMS channels have been configured accordingly.
  * Change user password:
    * Open a new page to suggest users log out of other devices after changing password.
    * Show the warning message if using an invalid password before showing the “Logout Other Devices” popup.
  * Fix bugs



###### Page

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile app:
      * Show “Landing Page” field on the Edit Page Info.
      * Adjust the padding of thumbnail for better displaying when sharing the page on Mobile Flatten app
    * Frontend Web:
      * On the Page Details, move the External Link to the About block.

      * Update the header page from “Page About” to “About page”

  * Page Photo: Support page admin can select the photo from the page when creating/editing the photo album
  * Fix bugs



###### Advertise

  * UI/UX Improvements for Advertise block
  * Fix bugs



###### Event

  * UI/UX Improvements on Mobile apps - Add a line between the post and description.
  * Fix bugs



###### Follow

  * Define specific notification types to control the follower notification based on the entity types/context.
  * Optimize performance as the follower database grows more significant over time.
  * Fix bugs



###### Friends

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Apply the same popup layout for “Add New List” and “Edit Friend List”.
    * On the Mutual Friends popup - Improve the layout when friends’ names are too long
  * Display info of “Mutual Friends” on the Friend Requests
  * Fix bugs



###### Groups

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile apps:
      * Manage Group - Add the “Landing Page” setting
    * Improve phrases in the option list.
    * Group Browse - Hide the redundant dot on the group item when user cannot view the group type.
  * Fix bugs



###### Comment

  * UI Improvement on the Pending Comments page
  * Fix bug



###### Social Connect

  * In Invite Only mode, users are required to enter the invite code when signing up with social accounts.
  * Fix bugs



###### SMS

  * Use the new 3rd library for the phone number validator.



###### Stories

  * Hide the “Created Story” notification after the story has ended.
  * Fix bugs



###### Announcement

  * Fix bugs



###### Activity Points

  * UI/UX Improvement
    * Hide the “Point Packages” page when the “Allow member to purchase Activity Points?” setting is turned off.
  * Fix bugs



###### Photos

  * When updating profile cover, not allow users to use warning photos.
  * Fix bugs



###### Chat

  * UI/UX Improvements for reply message in the conversation when clicking on it
  * Add the Permission page to manage the Chat app
  * Fix bugs



###### ChatPlus

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Web
      * Add a dot to the member card on the Recent Active page to display the user’s current status.
      * Hide the Attachment button when editing the message.
    * Mobile apps
      * Improve the file icon when the file name is too long.
      * Support users to back to the previous screen when users use the Back button on the device (Android).
      * Improve the background for the selected reaction on the reaction icon dialog.
  * Fix bugs



###### Marketplace

  * Fix bugs



###### Subscriptions

  * UI/UX Improvements for the title on the Edit package form
  * Fix bugs



###### EWallet

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve layout for the Insights page
    * Add the description below a currency on the Select Balance popup.
  * Fix bugs



###### Video

  * Add a setting for control the timeout of processing video job.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the video status when users act on the video detail page.
    * Improve the Menu app on the search result page when opening the first time.
    * Have the progress bar when users upload a video from the device.
  * Fix bugs



###### Status Background

  * Allow administrators to select text color (black / white) for individual background photo.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the pointer when creating/editing the background feed.
    * bold the text when creating and editing the status background feed.
  * Fix bugs



###### Feed

  * Enable selecting different sort orders for the activity feeds either by recent comments or recent posts.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Show a friendly error message when configuring an invalid Google Translate API key. 
    * Layout of feed item of new registration
  * Fix bugs



###### Invitations

  * Add the Reset button on the All Invitations page.
  * Fix bugs



###### Blog

  * Fix bugs



###### Reactions

  * Fix bugs



###### Search

  * Fix bugs



###### Newsletter

  * Fix bug

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.13

#### MetaFox 5.1.13

**Release Date** : Sep 10th, 2024

###### Core 

  * Mobile apps 

    * Upgrade Facebook SDK
  * UI/UX Improvements

    * Frontend Web
      * Localization - Support detecting language based on the browser setting.
      * Login with MFA
        * User will be back to the original page after logging in using MFA.
        * First authentication option should be automatically selected by default.
      * Unify the icon style across the platform using the outlined variant.
      * Sign-In - Improve the layout of the Social Login button
      * Scroll to the top of the Homepage when the user is on the Homepage and clicks on Home menu or Site logo
      * Authenticator page - Hide Create account link
    * AdminCP
      * Localization - Countries:
        * Make Fips Code, Geonames Code optional when creating/editing states.
        * Add action to add new items to the Options menu.
      * Members/Inactive: Support auto-compete on City field.
      * SEO
        * Improve Apps filter in SEO settings manage page
        * Improve SEO manage settings page
      * Schedule Jobs - Add the Settings page with detailed cron commands
      * Point Settings - Users can input the integer starting with 0 in the Point Settings
      * Mobile Services/Smart Banner - Moving Google/Apple ID Settings from Admob page to the Smart Banner page
      * Email Inactive Members - Improve the UI/UX for processing inactive email.
      * Health Check: improve the process of checking the queue worker state.
      * Install / Reinstall App - Display popup whenever the installation process is successful
      * Login with MFA - Admin will be redirected to AdminCP via the AdminCP Login form
      * Storage: hide storage configurations unless they are properly configured.
    * Mobile Apps
      * Remove the redundant line on the profile page (Android).
      * Improve the Featured/Sponsored label on the feed item.
      * Settings: Improve the layout for the action sheet header when viewing some setting pages
      * Improve phrase for the Privacy menu
  * Support Progressive Web App on Chrome

  * Support settings to require users in specific roles to enable MFA.

  * SEO - Support descriptive URLs.

  * Toggle Site: support WYSIWYG editor for Offline Message

  * Site Statistic: Add a new page to manage Site Statistics.

  * Notification: Allow administrators to disable notifications for the entire app.

  * Brute-force Protection: improve the brute-force workflow.

  * Performance Improvement - Not to reset the global cache when performing specific actions

  * AdminCP Site Settings - Support translating some components on the Site Settings page.

  * Email Inactive Members: Process inactive email in batch to avoid being marked as spam

  * Flatten Theme - Move background default to asset

  * Support environment variable to control site backups.

  * Installation Wizard: Improve validation for database version

  * Smart Banner: Support setting to allow administrators to reposition the Smart Banner.

  * Fix bugs




###### Stories

  * Allow a user to mute stories from other users.
  * Support users to view archived stories that are created on the same date.
  * Support user can add multiple text on the story
  * Apply permission settings of the Reaction app to the stories
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve phrase for the Story Archive page
    * Improve text for the Story Archive menu on mobile layout
    * Improve layout for the Comment section on the story
  * Fix bugs



###### Saved Items

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Change the phrases of the “Remove from Saved list” option and the Add Friends popup.
    * Improve the Save button status on the Add Collection popup after clicking.
    * Add the “maximum number of characters” description when editing the collection.
  * Fix bugs



###### Stickers

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the sticker file type on the listing page in the mobile browser layout.
    * Improve the order of the sticker collection on the All Stickers/ My Stickers tab for the web browser and mobile app.
  * Fix bugs



###### Page

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Apps - Add labels on the post and comment of Admin and Moderator users.
    * Add the Featured/Sponsored icon on the Page feed.
    * Update layout on the pending page.
    * My Claim Page: Update the success message when the user cancels the claim request
  * Fix bugs



###### Advertise

  * Fix bugs

  * UI/UX Improvements

    * Hide the Edit/Delete option when the users have not permission 
    * Hide the Edit action on the Completed Ads
  * Manage Sponsorship - Users can filter sponsorship created in Feed




###### Event

  * Support slugs in event URL
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Flatten - Add the “Going” option on the “Interested” button
    * Mobile App - Improve the layout of the Action list on the Event
    * Hide the Sort Feeds action when users cannot view the Discussions tab
  * Fix bugs



###### Quiz

  * Support slugs in quiz URL
  * Fix bugs



###### Poll

  * Support slugs in poll URL
  * UI/UX Improvements - Improve the notification after the poll is approved.
  * Fix bugs



###### Follow

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.13



###### Friends

  * Performance: optimize the performance of Friend Suggestions query.
  * UI/UX Improvements:
    * User Profile - Add the sub-tab “Mutual Friends” on the Friends tab
    * User profiles - Add total of Friends, Requests, Following, Follower request on the title of tabs
    * AdminCP - Focus on the Settings page when users access the Friends app



###### Groups

  * Group Members: Able to sort group members by name or joined date.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Change layout of custom fields on the Search Group page
    * The member count is based on the “Who can view members?” permission, regardless of the group privacy.
    * Change the phrase from “Publish Date” to “Created At”.
    * The group cover photo has the same size as the listing cover and detail.
    * Manage Example Group Rules - Add the message when users deactivate/activate an Example Group Rules.
    * Mobile Apps
      * Add the Admin/Moderator label on the post and comment
      * Centralize the selected sub-tab on the Search Members page
  * Fix bugs



###### Live Videos

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the Live Videos block on the Home Feed page.
    * Improve the pointer when replying to the comment on the live video.
  * Fix bugs



###### Comment

  * Mobile Apps - When edit history, add the hyperlink on the mentioned user/group/page 
  * Fix bugs



###### Social Connect

  * Fix bugs



###### Music

  * Support slugs in music URL
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the line color between the menu list and the Saved Playlists section.
    * Improve the layout of the song/music album/playlist item.
  * Fix bugs



###### SMS

  * Fix bugs



###### Announcement

  * Hide the number of views on the announcement listing and detail pages.



###### Hashtag

  * Updates for compatibilities with Core v5.1.13.



###### Activity Points

  * AdminCP - Improve performance on the Manage Packages page when the Google and Apple payment methods are inactivated.
  * Fix bugs



###### Photos

  * Support slugs in photo detail URL.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the background on the suggestion list when tagging a user in a photo.
    * Improve the action click when tagging a user in the photo.
    * Improve page title when editing media on the composer post in the mobile app.
  * Fix bugs



###### Chat

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the order in the bubble conversation section.
    * Improve the text when users reply to themselves.
  * Fix bugs



###### ChatGPT Bot

  * Allows Admin to select number of days to apply for permission “Limit messages with Chat Bot”.
  * Change permission “Limit the length of returned messages” to “Limit the length of returned tokens”.



###### ChatPlus

  * Allow users to view another profile from the Reacted by popup.
  * Add the warning message on AdminCP Dashboard when having new version of ChatPlus server.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve phrases.
    * The pointer automatically displays on the text field when opening the conversation.
    * Display progress bar per file when sending many files simultaneously (Videos, audio,…).
    * Add the “Edited” icon on the edited message.
    * Improve the file name when viewing the Files tab.
    * Improve playback rate for audio message.
    * Mobile Apps
      * Allow users to choose playback speeds like 1x, 1.5x, and 2x.
      * Improve the layout when viewing the reaction list per icon.
  * Fix bugs



###### Marketplace

  * Support setting to show/hide Short description when creating/editing Listing.
  * Support slugs in listing URL.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Apps - Support users in reordering photos when adding/editing the listing.
    * Move Sold/Expired label to same position with Sponsor/Feature Label
  * Fix bugs



###### Subscriptions

  * Manage Reasons: Define the search filters in Manage Reasons page.
  * AdminCP - Improve performance on the Manage Packages and Manage Subscriptions page when the Google and Apple payment methods are inactivated.
  * Manage Comparison: enable drag and drop feature to enable administrators to reorder the comparisons.
  * Fix bugs



###### EWallet

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the currency when users convert their points to the currency.
    * Improve the layout for the Transactions page.
    * Mobile Apps - Improve the layout for the Transactions listing page.
    * Update phases on the Deny Request form.



###### Video

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the video progress bar layout when users hover over it.
    * Support opening the video detail page from the feed when clicking on it.
    * Mobile Apps - Improve the video layout when editing the post (has only 1 video).
  * Fix bugs



###### Newsletter

  * Support to send test newsletter.
  * Support to select the SMS channel when creating a new newsletter.
  * Fix bugs



###### Site Background

  * Improve the warning message when user drop and drag the photo to upload
  * Fix bugs



###### Status Background

  * Updates for compatibilities with Core 5.1.13



###### Feed

  * Improve the feed layout when users remove tags.
  * Fix bugs



###### Blog

  * Support slugs in blog URL
  * Fix bugs



###### Reactions

  * Updates for compatibilities with Core 5.1.13
  * Improve performances.
  * Fix bugs



###### Search

  * Improve the scrolling position of the page in the mobile browser when users navigate tabs.



###### Forum

  * Fix bugs



###### Featured Items

  * Fix bugs

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.14

#### MetaFox 5.1.14

**Release Date** : Nov 10th, 2024

###### Core 

  * SEO: Admin can control bot indexing and configure canonical URL for specific pages
  * Improve performance on Frontend web 
  * GDPR Cookie Privacy: Administrators can change the URL to the cookie policy page.
  * Custom Field - Support multiple languages for Multiple Select option
  * SEO: Support descriptive URLs in all apps
  * Regex Rules - Apply the Setting “Display Name Regex Rule” for Group/Page
  * Support config Light/Dark mode for As Guest user
  * Currencies - Support administrators to list users who are using a specific currency.
  * Notification
    * Admin can check whether a notification type channel can be enabled/disabled based on the type configurations
    * Suppress notifications from being sent to banned users.
    * Suppress emails / SMS messages from being sent to unverified emails / phone numbers.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web
      * Improve slider form field
      * On the Search Result, improve layout for click icon when hovering on the Reset link.
      * When dragging a photo to reorder photo items on the Create/Edit page, the photo of this position must be pushed to the next position.
      * When users open the Check-in modal / Location field on Composer post/ Marketplace/ Event, the suggested location list will be displayed based on the current location.
      * Improve the warning message for Multi-Factor Authentication, SignIn, Registration Settings, etc.
      * MFA - Users should be navigated directly to the authentication code step if only one authentication method is available.
      * Add the Follow/Unfollow actions on the “Profile Popup Viewer”
      * Support spell check on Chrome default (Feed Post Editor )
      * Hide Uploading Image file on Text Editor for Guest Users
      * Check-In - Improve the layout on the scroll bar on Dark Mode.
    * AdminCP
      * Members
        * Hide the city drop when no country is selected.
        * The city dropdown now supports automatic completion.
        * Fix the expanded field after searching. They only collapse when clicking on the “View less” link.
        * Update success message when admin approve the user
        * Change the ordering on the Cancelled Members
      * Dashboard - Add Pending Reports metric under Site Statistics.
      * Report Items: the ‘Process Report’ action is relabeled as ‘Mark as Processed’
    * Mobile Apps
      * After changing password and logging out, users are required to log in again when tappping on the saved profile.
      * Support Deep links with multiple domains. 
      * Improve the layout of Mutual Friends pop-up
  * Mobile apps 
    * Support iPhone 16 device
  * Fix bugs



###### Event

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web:
      * Manage Hosts - Improve layout when user name is too long
      * Hide the “View on map” action on the event on Group/Page
      * Enhance the RSVP workflow by reworking the default “Not Interested” option.
    * Mobile app - View Event on Map - Display the loading icon instead of the “No events are found” message when users filter event
  * Fix bugs



###### Marketplace

  * Support Commission Fee
  * Fix bugs



###### Friends

  * All Friends - Support Sort default on the All Friends
  * Support birthday block on Side Slot



###### Groups

  * Group Invites: Invitations via link can be listed under the Group Invites page.
  * Support Announcement block on mobile layout
  * UI/UX Imrprovements
    * Mobile apps:
      * Group Membership Request - Add a submit button below the Answer Group Question form.
      * Change the phrase from “Publish Date” to “Created At”.
    * Frontend Web:
      * Release the associated vanity group URL right after a group is deleted.
      * Load the cover section once when users switch between tabs.
      * Membership Question/Group Rules - Keep the Create/Edit form opened when users click outside it.
      * Mute Members - Hide the Submit button when users mute member on group.
      * Notification - Delete all “New Group Member Notifications” from moderator/admin when member has been approved/cancelled.
  * Fix bugs



###### Pages

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web
      * Update layout on the pending page
      * Release the associated vanity group URL right after a page is deleted.
      * Load the cover section once when users switch between tabs.
      * Improve the alert popup when the owner reassigns the owner without admins on the page.
      * Make the total likes of Page clickable
    * Mobile
      * Improve the alignment on the page info
  * Fix bugs



###### Social Connect

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14.
  * Fix bugs



###### SMS

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14.
  * Fix bugs



###### Twilio

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14.
  * Fix bugs



###### Newsletter

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14.
  * Fix bugs



###### Captcha

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14.



###### Stories

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web
      * Improve line border on avatar users when they have the story
      * Improve layout for click icon when hovering on the Muted link
    * [Mobile] - Improve the layout of the story that containing a link.
    * AdminCP
      * Add a configuration for administrators to define the available story lifespan options.
      * Manage Collection: Disable the ‘Active’ toggle on the only active collection.
  * Fix bugs



###### Photos

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web
      * Improve layout for the friend tag suggestion list
      * Add Take photo/video function on the Android device when uploading media item on mobile layout.
      * Improve layout of the photo’s author info when it is too long
      * Photo on Group/Page - Improve the layout when the owner’s photo is too long
    * Mobile app
      * Hide some actions ‘View Avatar/ Cover’ on User Profile/Page/Group when the permission to view photo is disabled
      * Make the author’s name bold on the photo/album detail
  * Fix bugs



###### Reactions

  * UI/UX Improvement
    * Improve layout for the reaction image when viewing on the feed
  * Fix bugs



###### Status Background

  * UI/UX Improvement
    * Improve the clickable area on the status background.
  * Fix bugs



###### Stickers

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14.



###### Videos

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Video Processing - Users should be informed whenever the video processing is failed.
    * Frontend Web
      * Improve the default icon on the Videos tab (Page/Group/Profile) when no videos are displayed.
      * Improve The breadcrumb icon on the video detail page.
    * Mobile app
      * Improve the space between the Reaction and Comment icons on the video detail screen.
  * Fix bugs
  * Compatible with Quota Control app



###### Apple Pay

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14



###### Google Pay

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14



###### Blogs

  * Compatible with Quota Control app



###### Chat

  * Improve the search result page when no conversations are found. 



###### ChatPlus

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web
      * Remove list of current group members on adding member popup
      * Pointer will be automatically focused on the Compose box when opening the minimize conversation.
      * Some improvements on UI related to text color, preview image size, action icon.
      * Improve the notification of the last message on the conversation listing page
  * Fix bugs



###### ChatGPT BOT

  * Enhance chatbot responses and behavior



###### Forums

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the UX when editing threads that belong to the sub-forum once the deactivated parent forum
  * Fix bugs



###### Music

  * Compatible with Quota Control app
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web
      * Add the “Turn on repeat one” feature on the Music Album/ Playlist on mobile layout.
      * Improve layout for the music song/album when viewing from user profile on mobile layout.
      * Improve the size of the Cover Photo field on the Add New Music Album form.
      * Improve the warning message when users upload an invalid number of songs.
    * Mobile apps
      * Allow users to open the music album from the song details that belong to the album.
  * Fix bugs



###### Polls

  * [Mobile] Improve the close time format for the poll details.
  * Compatible with Quota Control app
  * Fix bugs



###### Quizzes

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14
  * Fix bugs



###### Saved Items

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.14
  * Fix bugs

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.15

#### MetaFox 5.1.15

**Release Date** : Dec 2nd, 2024

###### New Feature - Strengthened Security with Change File Checksum Verification

Checksum verification ensures the integrity and authenticity of your MetaFox files. With this feature, administrators can:  
• Detect unauthorized changes to core files, configurations, or scripts.  
• Maintain a secure and consistent deployment environment.  
• Quickly identify modifications that could compromise security or lead to functionality issues.

![Screenshot 2024-12-02 at 11.44.39.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-12-02 at 11.44.39.97781714.png)

This enhancement is particularly valuable in guarding against potential threats, such as malware injections or unauthorized updates, giving you peace of mind that your MetaFox installation remains secure and reliable.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.16

#### MetaFox 5.1.16

**Release Date** : Jan 1st, 2025

###### Getting Started (New App)

We’ve crafted a welcoming and engaging **Getting Started** experience that’s secure, responsive, and perfect for users on any device effortlessly. Our “Getting Started” process is built for simplicity, speed, and scalability, designed to provide a seamless onboarding experience.

  * Allow Admin to manage To-do List in AdminCP.
  * Show first-time members a list of what should be done after signing up.



###### Core

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * SEO
    * Support Structured data markup for Google Search
    * Change attribute of Meta OG tag from name to property
    * Improve the description below the Title field when editing a page.
    * Display the property list supporting each page.
    * Update the phrase for some specific page when editing.
  * Support banning users with IPs and Emails
  * Upgrade TikTok SDK
  * Support new permission to download attachments in apps
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Apps
      * Layout of Feed detail on Android.
      * When recording video, not reset the record time when switching camera
      * Improve the way push notifications are displayed when the app is running in the foreground state.
      * Improve the loading icon when waiting to validate the social account.
      * Move to the top when clicking on the “Overview” tab on the profile page.
      * Improve creation time on items.
      * Improve the layout of the suggestion locations of Google Map.
      * Remove the loading icon after canceling the “Logout Other Devices” popup.
      * Update Password - Remove the Logout Other Devices pop-up after user inputs password.
    * Web
      * New UI for Like-Share-Comment
      * Basic Information - Change the ordering on the Location field
      * Improve loading on the profile page of Page/Group/User when having a custom tab.
      * Improve behavior for the tooltip on the button/icon when user takes action on it.
      * Change the layout header to the same as a mobile app on the mobile web.
      * Improve the behavior of scrolling to the top when changing the page.
      * Apply same “Report” icon on the photo detail as Feed item.
      * Add the Featured icon on the user’s feed.
      * Display the Scroll bar when loading the activity posts.
      * Improve the item border on the attachment file.
      * Update the default group cover photo on the Shortcut section.
      * Basic Information - Change the Address icon on the Basic Information block.
      * Update the message when users sign up for the account with the banned email.
      * Improve the position of the Save/Cancel button on the Custom Privacy popup.
      * Show the date time detail when the user hovers on the creation time on the item detail.
      * Notifications - Hide the notification related to the post Link when the Feed app has been inactivated.
    * AdminCP:
      * Site Statistic: add a new metric to count daily/weekly active users.
      * Improve “Require Basic Field” setting in Registration Settings page
      * Support validating and testing SMS after configuring Twillo settings in AdminCP
      * Custom fields - Display the options on the Selection field by Keyword
      * Flood Control: the counter ignores system generated items when validating users’ capacities.
      * Browse Members: improve the label of the Display Name search box to enhance clarity.
      * Appearances: rename the footer menus to enhance clarity.
      * When deleting category, The “Category” dropdown only appears when selecting the “Move all blogs and its sub-categories to” option.
  * Notifications: Admins can manage notification channels.
  * Members - Inactive Mailing: Admin can stop the ongoing / pending mailing process.
  * Security Upgrade: Upgrade framework from v10.25.2 to 10.48.23 for [CVE-2024-52301](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gv7v-rgg6-548h)
  * Contact: Add “Can access contact page?” permission.
  * Installation: Verify the presences of the GD extension before continuing.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Event

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Apps
      * Add the “React” button on the Event’s feed and Events on Listing page.
    * Web
      * Improve the size of contents/tabs on the event detail page.
      * Pin the Hosts/Similar Events/Guests blocks when users scroll the page.
      * Redirect to the event detail after users duplicate an event
  * Fix bugs.



###### Groups

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * Manage Group: Group administrators can manage invitations.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Apps
      * Update the text size of the Categories and Publish Date fields on the About page.
      * Move to top when clicking on the “Discussions” tab on Group
      * Improve the placeholder text when searching items in the group.
    * Web
      * Photos - Improve the user list when users tag friend on photo on closed/Secret Group.
      * Improve the layout for the photo block on the group.
      * About Group - Add the tooltip for all about fields.
      * Membership Requests - Add the column “Modified User”.
      * Invite Link - Change the warning message when invitee confirms the cancelled invitation
  * Fix bugs.



###### Pages

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Web:
      * About Page - Add the tooltip for all about fields
      * Add the confirm popup when the admins’ page removes/blocks the member.
      * Improve the Upcoming Events block layout on the page.
      * Improve the Photo block layout on the page.
      * Improve the page’s avatar on the event detail page created on the page.
    * Mobile Apps
      * Improve the layout of the Featured/ Sponsor icons on the page.
      * Add the confirmation when the admins’ page removes/blocks the member.
      * Move to the top when clicking on the “Overview” tab on the page.
      * Update the text size of the Categories and Publish Date fields on the About page.
      * Improve the placeholder text when searching items in the page.
    * AdminCP
      * Support pagination on the Manage Claims page.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Stories

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Apps
      * Improve the clickable area for the Back icon on Android app.
      * Add the confirm popup when users leave the Create Story screen with the Back button of the Android device.
    * Web
      * Improve layout for the group actions on Story detail.
      * Create Text Story: Add more/less button for Backgrounds section.
    * AdminCP:
      * Settings: Admin can set default story lifespan.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Site Background

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * AdminCP: Add a success message after editing the collection



###### Comments

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Web
      * Improve the layout when users mention friends in comments.
      * Improve the pointer when clicking on the comment button to open the comment screen. (Android devices)
  * Fix bugs.



###### Feed

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * Optimize performance.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Apps
      * Schedule Post - Not allow the user to select the past time when posting the scheduled post.
      * Change the title of the page when sharing the Video URL.
      * Disable the Post button when the post is empty.
      * Support map view when posting activity posts with a check-in location.
      * Link post - Improve the UX when users input the URL on the post
    * Web
      * Support map view when posting activity posts with a check-in location.
      * Keep the user-chosen value of the Sort Feed among login times.
      * Events - Add the feed’s info for the feed in the Event.
      * Redirect to the location when clicking on the map view.
      * Improve the layout of the new feed after creating and scrolling down on the page/group/profile.
      * Improve the pointer when opening the composer post on Android devices.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Invitations

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.



###### Marketplace

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * Fix bugs



###### EWallet

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.



###### Photos

  * Ban Words: Check and sanitize banned words in all contents.
  * Support users to edit privacy of default albums (Timeline, Profile and Cover Album) of User.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Web

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.17

#### MetaFox 5.1.17

**Release Date** : Feb 12th, 2025

###### Core

  * Notification
    * Add ability to mark individual notification as [Read] or [Unread] instead of all of them
  * AdminCP
    * Support Manage Items page.
    * Support Mass Actions to admin can delete/ approve all items
    * Site Settings - PWA: The App Description and Install Description can be translatable.
    * Deny User: Administrators can either send an email or SMS when denying a user account.
  * Support CLI commands to activate/deactivate an app.
  * Check & refactor the URLs to avoid being matched against standard firewall rules.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * AdminCP
      * Relationship - Remove the redundant setting “Enable Relationships”.
      * App - Installed
        * Support sortable columns
        * Add the Upgrade button to upgrade all apps
        * Support mass actions to activate/deactivate apps.
      * Members - Update phrases on the Search form of Inactive Members 
        * Change the Search field to Display Name field.
        * Change the “Any” role text to “All”.
      * Show the total items on all data grid pages.
    * Mobile Apps
      * Improve the pointer’s behavior on screens having a text field/ area when closing the keyboard.
      * User Profile: add options to Approve or Deny a user account on the user profile page.
    * Frontend Web:
      * Improve Shortcut dialog popup.
      * Remove the horizontal bar on the notification dialog.
      * CK Editor - Remove the action sheet when users input the link to the content field.
      * Improve the filter field on the transaction/invoice page.
      * Improve the Layout when users select the location.
  * Fix bugs



###### Event

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Items page.
  * UI/UX Improvement - Hide the options: “Duplicated Event/Export Event/Add to Calendar (mobile)” on the pending events.
  * Fix bugs



###### Groups

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Items page.
  * Member Request - Group administrators / moderators can enter reason when declining member requests
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Notifications - Add the hyperlink for the “Accept your request to join the group” notification.
    * Mobile App - Manage Group - Adjust the layout on the Manage group on moderator
    * Members - Admin/Moderator Group will not unmute themselves.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Pages

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Items page.
  * Fix bugs



###### Feed

  * Support the “Hide all from <user>” option.
  * Account Settings - Add the Manage Hidden page.
  * Improve feed performance by utilizing resource cache.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Change the “Video URL” shortcut to avoid confusion with media upload (photos and videos).
    * Mobile app - When post with link, allow user to input the characters when the loading icon displays.
    * Frontend Web
      * Improve border photo on feed item
      * Hide some actions on Group when viewing the Group’s post on the NewFeeds
  * Fix bugs.



###### Marketplace

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Items page.

  * UI/UX Improvements

    * Mobile Flatten - When viewing photos on the listing, improve layout of count total on the image.
    * Hide sponsor/feature action on the expired/ closed listing.



###### Videos

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Items page.
  * Users can move videos to different albums when editing videos.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the layout of “Created a new video” notification.
    * Improve the videos’ title uploaded to the composer post on the Manage Videos page.
    * Composer Feeds - Display the Title when sharing the URL video on Feed
  * Fix bugs.



###### Blogs

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Blogs page.
  * Minor UI/UX Improvements.



###### ChatPlus

  * Sanitize banned Words in messages.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile App
      * Improve speed when opening a direct conversation from the group conversation.
    * Frontend Web
      * Improve the player of the video message on the conversation.
      * Improve the position of the action button when hovering over the two photos message.
  * Upgrade lib-jitsi-meet Library for Video calls.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Forums

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Items page.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Change the font size of Thread Title on the feed.
    * Improve layout of the “Created a new thread” notification.
    * Order the post with the newest creation date on the Manage Posts page.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Live Videos

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Blogs page.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile Apps
      * Improve layout of the sticker comment on the living video.
      * Hide the Go Live button when no services are configured.
    * Frontend Web
      * Remove the item border in dark mode.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Music

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Blogs page.
  * Fix bugs



###### Polls

  * AdminCP - Add. Manage Blogs page.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Quizzes

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Items page.
  * Users can play quizzes on activity feeds.
  * UI/UX Improvements - Web - Improve layout for Submit button on the quiz feed.
  * Fix bugs



###### Photos

  * AdminCP - Add Manage Items page.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Advertise

  * Do not allow the admin to edit the Started Time.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve warning/error messages when creating new ad.



###### Newsletter

  * Support multiple languages when creating newsletters.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Story

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Story Archive: Support viewing more stories in the Story Details section
    * Move Editor to Lexical
  * Fix bugs



###### Comment

  * UI/UX Improvement - Improve the animation of comments after clicking on Send button.
  * Fix bugs



###### Subscription

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Package Comparison: enhance the visibility of feature marks
    * Remove some redundant lines on Packages Comparison section.
    * Improve the payment workflow when buying the package has the first free time and recurring manual.



###### Featured Items

  * UI/UX Improvement - Feature User - Prevent the users from continuously clicking on the Feature button.
  * Fix bugs



###### Announcement

  * Fix bugs



###### Status Background

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the pointer behavior after users change the status background.
    * Not display the horizontal scroll bar after switching to the status background.
    * Improve UI of the mentioned user/page/group name on the status background.
  * Fix bugs



###### Chat

  * Fix bugs



###### Friend

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.17.



###### Invitations

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.17.



###### E-Wallet

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.17.



###### Hashtag

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.17.



###### Activity Points

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.17.



###### Search

  * Improve compatibility with Core v5.1.17.



###### Reactions

  * Improve UX when user react on comment
