[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.18

#### MetaFox 5.1.18

Release Date:

##### What’s new

###### Tour Guide (New App)

Excited to show off your platform? So are we! The **Tour Guide** app is here to help you create engaging, interactive walkthroughs that guide your users through the heart of your community. Whether they’re brand new or exploring fresh features, Tour Guide makes every step feel intuitive and exciting. It’s easy to set up, fun to use, and a powerful way to turn first-time visitors into confident, happy members. Let’s show them around!

###### Highlighted Features

  * Site administrators can create a unique tour guide for each page and add multiple steps to guide users through specific elements or workflows.

  * Users can experience the tour guide step-by-step on the selected page.

  * Users can repeat the tour, go back to a previous step, refresh the guide, move forward, or end it at any time.

  * The tour guide is automatically disabled once the user finishes it, ensuring a clean and unobtrusive experience.




![0. FE- tour guide badge.png](/_next/static/media/0. FE- tour guide badge.dc23a5a9.png)

![tour guilde - view 2.png](/_next/static/media/tour guilde - view 2.4c874add.png)

###### Core

  * Compatible with PHP 8.3
  * Optimize performance for API endpoint /settings
  * REST API Generation: scan and fix general issues.
  * Improve the avatar’s resolution when logging in with a social account.
  * Support In-app purchase on mobile apps
  * AdminCP
    * Members: 
      * Admin can export users to CSV file.
      * Super Administrator can designate another user as a Super Administrator.
    * Member Settings: Add a new setting to control token lifetime.
    * Registration Settings:
      * Administrators can configure multiple users for the ‘On Signup New Friend’ settings.
      * Remove the Send Welcome Email setting. Welcome email will be managed on AdminCP > App Settings > Notifications > Types > App Name (User)
    * Add a new setting to configure Email logo
    * Reports: Add settings to control who will receive notifications whenever there are new reports.
    * Build Histories - Remove build bundles immediately after extracting to save disk space.
    * Localization - Add options for admin to set the default country and language.
    * Control Staff access within AdminCP.
    * Storage - The admin can remove storage configurations even if they contain uploaded files.
    * Ban Filters:
      * Add the Active column for the ban filter page (Email/IP Address/ Word).
      * Validate the email’s format before adding it to the banned email list.
    * Regex Rules: Validate the regex rules format before adding to the system.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web
      * Hide the member item viewer when hovering over the member’s name on the Dashboard page.
      * Update user information immediately after editing.
      * Installation Wizard
        * Verify the existence of functions (symlink, link) upon installation.
        * Improve the workflow when process functions (proc_open, proc_close) are missing
      * Limit the page Title meta to 60 characters.
      * Mobile layout - Hide the total badge notification after opening the notification popup.
      * Enhance color border contrast.
      * Hide the title when viewing the type detail on the global search.
      * Support changing languages on the Registration page.
      * Autofocus on the “Email Address or Phone Number” field in the Forgot Password section.
      * Support SEO meta schemas for live videos
    * AdminCP
      * The Backup Wizard should be executed in the background to avoid the timeout issue.
      * Improve queue processing to avoid long-run background jobs from being retried unexpectedly.
      * Dashboard: reflect the statistical chart data by date accordingly.
      * Site Statistic: Support monthly statistics. 
      * Clear the search box after the admin selects a suggested option or go to another page.
      * Support the close button “X” to the “Is Core” dropdown of the App> Installed page.
      * Admin can reassign a category to a different sub-category during the modification process.
    * Mobile App
      * Composer Feed - Hide the URL Video button on the Event/User Profile/ Group/ Page
      * Flatten App - Improve behavior of the Birth Date field after selecting data.
  * Fix bugs



###### Groups

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Update the notification text of new posts in the group.
  * Fix bugs



###### Pages

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * AdminCP:
      * Add a new settings “Automatically follow selected pages on sign-up”.



###### Social Connect

  * Login with Facebook: compatibility with JWT token



###### Invitations

  * Add permissions to manage who can invite others to the site.
  * Support Refresh Invite Code feature.
  * Add the Manage Invite Codes page.
  * Inactivate the invite code if the inviter is deleted from the site.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * AdminCP:
      * Improve the position of Search button.
      * Support mass Delete action and sortable columns in the Manage Invitations page.
      * UI improvement for the checkbox after users use the mass action to resend their invitations.
      * Improve the invitation content when having no personal message.
  * Fix bugs



###### PayPal

  * Support Payment Return Url on Success and Cancelled Payment.



###### EWallet

  * Support Adjust Balance for Admin to control the user balance.
  * Withdraw Request:
    * Send withdrawal request notifications to all users who have Super Admin roles.
    * Redirect to the Withdrawal Requests page after creating the request.
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile 
      * Add the “Fees” and “Amount will be received” rows on the Conversion Request popup.
  * Fix bugs.



###### Marketplace

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve workflow for pending invoices when the listing has expired/changed price.
    * On the listing that has expired/changed price, the PayNow button needs to be shown on the listing.
    * Remake the option “Repayment” to “Pay Now”
    * More options for Status filter on Search form.
    * Not zoom in on the map when clicking on the listing title on the map.
  * Fix bugs



###### Activity Points

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * On Package Transaction page
      * Add “Pay Now” option on the Pending transaction so that user can pay again.
      * Remake column ID to Transaction ID
      * Admin/ users can order data by columns
    * AdminCP - Add Payment Method column and filter to admin can manage package transactions via payment method.
  * Fix bugs



###### Search

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Hide the empty member section on the search result page.
    * Hide empty sections on the search result page.



###### Chat

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Mobile apps - Jump to the original message when tapping it on the reply message.
    * Frontend Web - Hide the total badge notification after opening the message popup.
  * Compatible with MetaFox 5.1.18



###### ChatPlus

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web - Hide the total badge notification after opening the message popup.
    * Disable Chat app when enabling ChatPlus and vice versa.
  * Compatible with MetaFox 5.1.18
  * Fix bugs



###### ChatGPT BOT

  * Support report ChatBot message
  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve chatbot to support creative works
    * Hide all ChatBot conversations when admin turn ChatBot feature off.
  * Compatible with MetaFox 5.1.18



###### Forums

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web - Improve the layout for thread items when searching on the global search/page/group.
    * AdminCP - Open Manage Threads page by default when admin open the Forum app
  * Compatible with MetaFox 5.1.18



###### Photos

  * Mature Images: Support blur image thumbnail when user shares link of mature images on the site.
  * Support Google Image metadata for structured data.
  * Compatible with MetaFox 5.1.18
  * Fix bugs.



###### Videos

  * Support Setting for Mature Videos.
  * Support playback speed for natively uploaded videos.
  * Compatible with MetaFox 5.1.18
  * Fix bugs.



###### Getting Started

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Frontend Web - Change the ordering display the Getting Started pop-up when the system has too many pop-up.
    * AdminCP - Add the Check List on the Welcome page
  * Compatible with MetaFox 5.1.18
  * Fix bugs.



###### Announcement

  * UI/UX Improvements - Display the newest announcement on the first in the Announcements block.
  * Fix bugs



###### Stories

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * The publishing order of stories follows the posting order instead of the processing status.
    * Improve the performance when loading story.
    * Improve mobile layout for “Create Story” button on feed.
  * Fix bugs



###### Newsletter

  * Support multiple languages when creating newsletters.
  * Fix bugs



###### Captcha

  * UI/UX Improvements
    * Improve the UX of Recaptcha V3 when viewing pages that have no captcha rule.
  * Fix bugs



###### And,

  * There are many bug fixes, minor UI/UX Improvements, and updates for compatibility with MetaFox 5.1.18 on other apps, such as **Blog, Quiz, Poll, Event, Music, Site Background** , **Stickers** , **Follow** , **Status Background** , **Friends** , **Reactions** , **Save Items** , **Featured Items** , **Subscriptions** , **Advertise** , **Comment** , **Feed** , **SMS** , **Twilio** , etc.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.19

#### MetaFox 5.1.19

##### **What’s new**

##### New Apps

###### **In-App Purchase**

Unlock a seamless buying experience! The all-new In-App Purchase app lets your users buy subscription packages directly from their mobile device, using the payment methods they trust. No more redirects or complicated flows—just tap, pay, and enjoy. Perfect for boosting conversions and delighting your mobile audience!

###### Key Highlights

  * Purchase subscription packages natively in the app
  * Secure, fast, and user-friendly payment process
  * Supports both iOS and Android



###### **Anti Spam Questions**

Say goodbye to bots and spam signups! The new Anti Spam Questions app empowers you to create custom questions for your registration process. Make it fun, make it challenging, and keep your community safe and authentic. Flexible options let you add images, set answer types, and more.

###### Key Highlights

  * Add custom questions (with images!) to your sign-up flow
  * Flexible answer types and validation
  * Reduce spam and ensure real users join your community



###### **Giphy Integration**

Bring conversations to life! With Giphy now integrated, users can search and share animated GIFs right inside their comments. Express yourself with the perfect reaction, every time.

###### Key Highlights

  * Search and share GIFs in comments
  * Huge library of trending and fun GIFs



##### Core Improvements

  * Improved start up time for Android app
  * New setting to toggle public access to Home Feed
  * Enhanced country member management in AdminCP
  * Dashboard and statistics UX improvements
  * More control over email appearance and member management
  * Many more UI/UX enhancements and performance optimizations
  * And, many bug fixes.

#### MetaFox 5.1.2

Release Date: Jun 14, 2023

###### What’s new

  * New Apps / Features
    * Invitations 5.0.0
    * Data Migration from phpFox V4
  * Improvements:

    * Supports filtering of featured items

    * Improve quality audio/video call
    * Improve performance
  * Bug fixes

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.3

#### MetaFox 5.1.3

**Release Date** : July 12, 2023

##### What’s new

###### New Flatten theme variant - a clean and minimalist approach to the design

The Flatten theme variant introduces a clean and minimalist approach to the design, focusing on simplicity and elegance. The user interface elements are thoughtfully arranged, providing a clutter-free experience that allows users to navigate effortlessly throughout the platform.

![theme-flatten-patten-4-1024x704.png](/_next/static/media/theme-flatten-patten-4-1024x704.609a2b86.png)

With its sleek and streamlined aesthetic, Flatten offers a visually appealing user interface that is both visually captivating and user-friendly.

The Flatten theme variant is fully responsive, ensuring a seamless experience across various devices, including desktops, tablets, and mobile phones. Users who access your social networking platform from a large desktop screen or a small mobile device will enjoy a consistent and optimized user experience.

Additionally, the Flatten theme is free for Admin to customize. Admin users can choose from various customization options via Layout Editor, including personalized background images, color schemes, and font styles, enabling them to create a visually distinctive presence within the social networking community.

###### Powerful Live Layout Editor - Effortlessly modify page layouts and customize styles

Introducing the powerful Layout Editor feature in our social networking software, allowing administrators to effortlessly modify page layouts and customize styles in a visual and intuitive manner. With this feature, admins can take full control over the design and appearance of their social networking platform, creating a unique and tailored experience for their users.

![Screenshot 2023-07-10 at 17.07.05.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-07-10 at 17.07.05.afa05e1b.png)

The Layout Editor provides a user-friendly interface that simplifies the process of customizing page layouts. Administrators can _**easily rearrange and add various blocks**_ , such as static HTML content, profile sections, activity feeds, widgets, navigation menus, and more. Drag-and-drop functionality makes it a breeze to reposition and organize these blocks, enabling admins to create the perfect layout for their platform’s specific needs.

Not only does the Layout Editor offer flexibility in arranging page elements, but it also allows administrators to _**customize the styles and visual attributes of their platform**_. With a comprehensive set of styling options, admins can easily adjust colors, fonts, borders, backgrounds, and other visual elements to match their brand identity or create a visually appealing theme. The _**real-time preview functionality**_ ensures that admins can see their changes instantly, providing a seamless and efficient customization experience.

The visual nature of the Layout Editor eliminates the need for coding or technical expertise, empowering admins with the ability to make significant design modifications without any programming knowledge. This puts the power of customization directly into the hands of administrators, enabling them to create visually stunning and personalized experiences for their users.

Experience the power of the Layout Editor feature in our latest version, and take customization to the next level in your social networking platform. Empower your administrators to unleash their creativity and design visually stunning layouts that captivate and delight users.

###### Seamlessly Update MetaFox in AdminCP

This is the exciting new feature in our upcoming product version — the ability to update the software seamlessly from within the AdminCP. With this convenient and streamlined feature, administrators can easily update their product to the latest version with just a few clicks directly from the intuitive AdminCP interface, eliminating the need for manual update routines. The system will handle the entire **Software Updates** procedure, including database updates and necessary configuration changes, ensuring a smooth transition to the latest version.

By offering an in-built **Software Updates** mechanism within the AdminCP, we aim to simplify the software update experience for our valued users. This feature ensures that administrators can effortlessly keep their products up to date, benefiting from the latest enhancements, bug fixes, security patches, and exciting new features we introduce with each version.

Our goal is to provide a user-friendly and efficient update experience, empowering administrators to stay current with the product’s advancements and continually enjoy its improved performance, functionality, and user experience. The in-built **Software Updates** feature within the AdminCP ensures that updating your product is a hassle-free and time-saving process.

![Screenshot 2023-07-11 at 11.37.43.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-07-11 at 11.37.43.b3f03a17.png)

###### Ads management on Mobile apps

This new feature empowers users to efficiently manage their advertisements directly from their mobile devices.

With the ability to manage ads on mobile app, users gain greater convenience and flexibility in promoting their content and reaching their target audience. Whether it’s promoting a personal brand, a business, or a cause, users can easily create, monitor, and adjust their ad campaigns right from the palm of their hand.

By extending ad management capabilities to mobile apps, our software enables users to stay connected and responsive to their advertising campaigns, even while on the go. Whether users prefer using a desktop or a mobile device, they can now leverage the power of our software’s ad management functionality to maximize the reach and impact of their advertising efforts.

###### Support for Sponsor Feed

The software now includes support for sponsored content in the feed, enabling businesses or influencers to promote their content to a wider audience.

###### Support for Sponsor Blog

Users can now monetize their social networking platform by allowing sponsored blog posts, where companies or individuals can pay to publish their articles or blog posts on the platform.

###### Support for Invite-Only Registration

With this improvement, you can now enable registration on your social networking website only through invitations. This feature provides more control over user registration and can help maintain exclusivity or limit access to a specific audience.

###### Live Video on Page/Group

Users can now create and broadcast live videos directly from their social networking pages or groups. This feature enhances the interactive and real-time nature of your platform, allowing users to engage with their audience through live video content.

###### Performance Enhancements

The new version of the software includes various optimizations and improvements to enhance its overall performance. These performance enhancements may involve areas such as faster loading times, improved response times, reduced server resource usage, optimized database queries, and overall smoother user experience. The focus on performance ensures that your social networking platform operates efficiently and provides a seamless experience for your users.

###### Resolved known issues

Bug fixes are a crucial and essential part of software development as they improve the overall quality and functionality of the product. The new version of the software addresses and fixes various bugs and known issues in previous versions. These bug fixes ensure that the software functions as intended, eliminating any unexpected behaviors or errors that users have encountered. They contribute to a smoother user experience and help maintain the integrity of your social networking software.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.4

#### MetaFox 5.1.4

**Release Date** : Aug 14, 2023

#### What’s new

We’re excited to introduce MetaFox version 5.1.4, packed with new features, enhancements, and bug fixes that aim to elevate your social networking experience. In this release, we’ve focused on improving user engagement, expanding administrative capabilities, enhancing payment workflows, and optimizing overall performance. Let’s delve into the details:

##### **Features and Enhancements**

###### **Support for Sponsor Items**

We’re introducing support for sponsor items across all apps. Now you can seamlessly incorporate sponsor content, enhancing user interaction while opening up new opportunities for collaboration.

![Screenshot 2023-08-14 at 09.39.58.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-14 at 09.39.58.ee0b5e39.png)

###### **Invite Code on Signup**

Streamline the onboarding process with the ability to enter an invite code during signup. This feature enables a smoother user journey and reinforces user connections right from the start.

![Screenshot 2023-08-14 at 10.09.19.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-14 at 10.09.19.a0585c59.png)

###### **Enhanced Member Management with Tab Layout**

We’ve reorganized the layout into multiple tabs in the **Edit Member** page, simplifying member management and providing intuitive access to essential functions.

![Screenshot 2023-08-11 at 09.23.42.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-11 at 09.23.42.1da3a02f.png)

###### **French Language Package**

Introducing a new language option! The addition of the French language package further enhances accessibility and user engagement.

![Screenshot 2023-08-11 at 09.37.23.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-11 at 09.37.23.5ba9f728.png)

###### **Mobile Link Sharing**

Our team has worked diligently to ensure a seamless integration between MetaFox and other apps on your mobile device. Your MetaFox app will be listed in the Share options so users can easily share links from other apps to your MetaFox app, boosting cross-platform interaction. When users come across content on a certain app that they want to share it with your MetaFox, simply tap the Share button within that app, select MetaFox, and watch as the link is effortlessly integrated into your MetaFox. Say goodbye to the hassle of copying and pasting links – now, sharing interesting content with your friends and followers is just a tap away.

![image.png](/_next/static/media/image.c43ff093.png)

###### **Enhanced Custom Fields**

With the release of this update, you now have the ability to add custom fields to your profile with Checkbox, Radio, Date, and Multiple Selection types. This feature elevates your profile customization, allowing users to share specific details about themselves in a more engaging and interactive manner.

![Screenshot 2023-08-14 at 11.14.58.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-14 at 11.14.58.71e7b01c.png)

###### **Apple Pay Support**

Apple Pay supports an advanced payment method for MetaFox, providing you with a seamless and modern payment experience. With Apple Pay integration, making purchases has never been easier or more secure.

**Simple Setup, Effortless Transactions**

Setting up Apple Pay on our product is a breeze. No need to enter card details repeatedly; with just a few clicks, you can authorize payments instantly.

**Swift, Contactless Payments**

With Apple Pay, completing transactions is as simple as holding your device near the supported payment terminal and authenticating with Face ID or Touch ID. Within seconds, your payment is processed, providing a smooth and convenient experience.

**Enhanced Security for Peace of Mind**

Your security is our top priority. When you use Apple Pay, your card information is never shared with merchants. Instead, a unique token is used for each transaction, safeguarding your sensitive data from potential threats. With the added layers of biometric authentication, you can rest assured that only you can authorize payments.

In this version, we have integrated the Apple Pay with the following MetaFox features:

  * Purchase packages of Activity points
  * Purchase Subscription
  * Supported payment processor(s): Stripe



###### **Manage Pending Comments**

Keep your platform’s discussions meaningful by managing pending comments effectively. Admins can seamlessly stay in control of user-generated content of specific user roles by efficiently managing their pending comments, and maintaining the quality and relevance of discussions.

###### **Rewarding User Invitations**

We’re enhancing user engagement by allowing members to earn activity points when they successfully invite others to join the community. Strengthen the bond between users and reward their proactive efforts.

###### **Improved AdminCP Functionalities**

  * Add New Translation Phrases: Customize your platform by easily adding new translation phrases through the AdminCP.
  * Add New Countries, States, and Provinces: Tailor your network to specific regions by adding new countries, states, and provinces.
  * Configure Smart Banner for Mobile: Optimize the mobile experience with configurable smart banners that capture user attention.



###### **Improved Payment Gateway Workflow**

Our payment system has been refined to offer a more intuitive and efficient selection of payment gateways. Enjoy a streamlined payment process that caters to your preferences.

###### **Performance Improvements**

At MetaFox, we’re committed to providing you with an exceptional social networking experience. With version 5.1.4, we’ve gone the extra mile to enhance the performance of our platform, ensuring that your interactions are smooth, responsive, and enjoyable.

##### **Bug Fixes**

We’ve diligently worked to address various bugs and polish existing features, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable user experience.

We’re dedicated to continuously improving MetaFox to meet your needs and exceed your expectations. Thank you for being part of our journey. Explore these new features, engage with your community, and make the most of MetaFox version 5.1.4!

For any inquiries, feedback, or assistance, please don’t hesitate to reach out to our support team.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.5

#### MetaFox 5.1.5

**Release Date** : Sep 19th, 2023

##### What’s new

##### **Features and Enhancements**

###### Monetization with E-Money 

We’re excited to introduce our groundbreaking E-Money feature, designed to enhance your experience on MetaFox while offering you opportunities for financial growth. With E-Money, you can now seamlessly engage with our community and generate income while enjoying a secure and efficient payment system.

  * Supports Admin commission earnings, allowing administrators to earn a commission fee for every transaction that occurs within the community. All payments initiated by users within the community will be routed directly to the payment account configured in the AdminCP. This streamlines payment processing, ensuring that funds are securely and promptly received.



![Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 15.49.50.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 15.49.50.a3cd7502.png)

  * User accounts will reflect the paid amount after deducting the payment commission fee. The actual amount processed will be based on USD (United States Dollar) after being converted using the latest currency conversion rates. This ensures that users have a clear view of their earnings and expenditures. Users can manage their finances effortlessly within the Account Settings section. This includes checking their current balance, reviewing transaction history, sending funds, and monitoring withdrawal requests.



![Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 15.42.14.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 15.42.14.0dc2b75b.png)

  * Admins play a vital role in the E-Money system by managing user withdrawal requests. Upon receiving a withdrawal request, Admins have the authority to approve it. Once approved, the Admin will be redirected to PayPal to complete the payment processing.



![Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 15.48.01.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 15.48.01.e5876fe4.png)

###### Added Security with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) 

  * Protect your account with an additional layer of security using Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via Email and SMS.
  * Before enabling MFA, users need to confirm the password to ensure secure access.



![Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 16.12.16.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 16.12.16.62695d99.png)

###### Login with TikTok and Phone number

  * Streamline the registration process by allowing users to sign up with their phone numbers.
  * On top of social logins with Facebook, Google, and Apple, users can now seamlessly log in to your MetaFox account using your TikTok credentials, connecting you to a wider audience effortlessly.



![Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 15.39.37.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-09-18 at 15.39.37.897662ac.png)

###### Birthday Reminders 

  * Never miss a friend’s birthday with our new reminder feature, ensuring you celebrate those special days together.



![image \(1\).png](/_next/static/media/image \(1\).57138304.png)

###### Brute-Force Protection for Login and MFA 

  * Rest easy knowing that your account is guarded against brute-force attacks with our robust protection mechanisms for both login and MFA.



###### Performance Improvements for APIs 

  * Enjoy faster and more responsive API interactions with significant performance enhancements.



###### Friend Suggestions Based on Location 

  * Discover new connections in your area with location-based friend suggestions, making it easier to connect with people nearby.



###### Mention Friends, Pages, and Groups in Comments 

  * Users can foster engagement and connection by mentioning friends, pages, and groups in their comments now.



###### Related Groups Suggestions 

  * Find public groups that match your interests by exploring related groups your friends have joined or those in the same categories.



###### Trending Hashtags on Mobile 

  * Users can stay updated with the latest trends by accessing trending hashtags on your mobile app.



###### Multiple Languages for Categories 

  * Admin can define categories of Photos, Pages, Groups, Event, Forum, Marketplace, Blog, and Music for supported languages on the community.



###### Profile Avatar with uploaded photos 

  * Users can update their profile easily by selecting uploaded photos as their avatar.



###### UI/UX Improvements

  * Enhanced layout in Dark Mode when mentioning Pages, Users, or Groups.
  * Streamlined flow for page owners that they can only mention page members, other pages, and other public groups when creating posts.
  * Users can change language more conveniently with _**Language**_ selection under the dropdown _**Account**_ menu.
  * Validate phone number before sending invites via SMS.
  * Numerous minor UI/UX enhancements.



###### Support Apple Pay and Google Pay on Mobile app 

  * Conveniently make payments using Apple Pay and Google Pay within our mobile app, providing you with secure and efficient payment options.



###### Background Fetch API on Mobile app

  * Experience improved app performance and seamless data synchronization with the Background Fetch API on mobile, ensuring your content is always up to date.



##### **Bug Fixes** :

We’ve addressed various bugs and issues to provide you with a smoother and more reliable MetaFox experience. 

At MetaFox, we are committed to delivering a high-quality and reliable platform for our users. We want to thank you for your feedback and for helping us identify and resolve these issues. Your input is invaluable as we continue to refine and improve the MetaFox experience.

If you encounter any further issues or have suggestions for improvement, please don’t hesitate to reach out to our support team. We’re here to assist you and ensure that your time on MetaFox is as enjoyable and trouble-free as possible.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.6

#### MetaFox 5.1.6

We’re excited to introduce MetaFox Version 5.1.6, packed with new features, enhancements, and bug fixes to elevate your social community experience. Let’s look into what’s new in this new version:

##### **Core Updates**

###### **Enhanced Server Compatibility**

MetaFox now smoothly operates on servers that do not support `allow_url_fopen`, ensuring a wider range of server compatibility.

###### **File Type Verification**

To enhance security, we’ve implemented a robust file type verification system. This feature checks file types before uploading, adding an extra layer of protection.

###### **HEIC File Support**

You can now upload HEIC files, expanding your options for sharing and enjoying high-quality images.

###### **Invite Code Registration**

Registering an account is now more flexible. Users can verify their accounts using invite codes, making the registration process simpler and tailored to various devices.

###### **Custom Field Translations**

Editing custom fields is more user-friendly. You can conveniently add translations to labels and descriptions without navigating to the Localization Phrases, streamlining the customization process.

###### **Relative Timestamps**

MetaFox now supports translating relative timestamps, improving the localization of time-based information.

###### **Find Missing Language Phrases**

You can now filter missing phrases in specific language packs, ensuring a more comprehensive and accurate translation experience.

###### **Framework Update**

We’ve updated the backbone framework to Laravel 10.x, bringing you the latest innovations in web development.

###### **PHP 8.2 Compatibility**

MetaFox is now fully compatible with PHP 8.2, ensuring optimal performance and security.

###### **Bug Fixes**

We’ve addressed various bugs to enhance your MetaFox experience and ensure a smoother user journey.

##### **New App Updates:**

With MetaFox 5.1.6, we’re also launching new app updates that integrate seamlessly with the core features:

###### **Activity Point Conversion**

Whether you’ve earned activity points through contributions, interactions, or community involvement, now you can transform those points into tangible value within your E-Wallet. The conversion rates as well as conversion fee are configured by administrators in the Admin Control Panel (AdminCP), ensuring fairness and transparency. We believe that this feature provides a valuable incentive for user engagement.

![Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 16.50.32.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 16.50.32.8fc46d7b.png)

![Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 16.40.43.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 16.40.43.efb4ee4d.png)

![Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 16.41.15.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 16.41.15.a9febffb.png)

###### **E-Wallet Usability**

In the previous version, we introduced fundamental features to lay the foundation for the E-Wallet. These core functionalities include:

  * **E-Wallet Balance Management** to keep track of users’ earnings and balances, ensuring transparency and control.

  * **Transaction History** for tracking user’s earnings with ease.

  * Managing user **withdrawal requests**

  * **Admin earnings** with transaction/withdrawal fee




Now, E-Wallet is no longer just a balance. It’s your gateway to a more enriching and interconnected experience within the MetaFox community. With E-Wallet Usability, we’ve opened up a world of possibilities:

  * **Purchase Listing Items and Activity Point packages** : You can now use the funds in your E-Wallet to acquire listing items on the MetaFox community.

  * **Unlock Subscriptions** : Use your E-Wallet balance to pay for one-time/monthly subscriptions quickly.




![Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 17.20.08.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 17.20.08.a3f2e2a6.png)

![Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 17.06.23.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 17.06.23.9082dbe4.png)

![Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 17.08.20.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-11-03 at 17.08.20.4ac93d2b.png)

###### **Multilingual Announcements**

Announcements can now be translated into multiple languages, ensuring effective communication with your diverse user base.

###### Minor UI/UX Improvements

We’ve made subtle yet impactful user interface and user experience enhancements to create a more enjoyable and efficient platform.

###### **Core Compatibility**

These app updates are fully compatible with MetaFox Version 5.1.6, ensuring a seamless and cohesive user experience.

###### **Bug Fixes**

We’ve diligently addressed any bugs in the new app updates to guarantee smooth and reliable performance.

Upgrade to MetaFox Version 5.1.6 to experience these new features, improved compatibility, and a more user-friendly environment.

Thank you for being part of the MetaFox community, and we look forward to providing you with even more exciting updates in the future.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.7

#### MetaFox 5.1.7

**MetaFox 5.1.7**

**Core Updates**

  * Support Manage Transactions and Orders in AdminCP

  * Prevent users from using usernames with Unicode characters

  * Installation Wizard:

    * Set the minimum version of MySQL database to 5.7.
    * Can download the most recent compatible version rather than the bundled app version.
  * AdminCP

    * Prevent the local storage from being edited to avoid unexpected issues due to misconfiguration.
    * Support initializing permissions for inherited custom roles when installing new app.
    * Support admin to remove the folder /public/install from ACP.
    * Support defining custom fields for specific user roles.
  * Integrate with Twitter API to support fetching preview from link.

  * Verify Account

  * Support to reverify the user after updating the email/phone number.

  * Can verify accounts with generated code instead of verification link.

  * Add a success message when users verify their account successfully

  * Sign Up: Update the warning message when users input invalid data into the ‘Username’ field.

  * Support list items that belong to sub categories when searching for parent category.

  * Users don’t have to input all but at least a currency when creating the listing/package

  * Sync the dark mode/light mode among browsers after signing in

  * Bug Fixes




**New App Updates**

  * **All apps** \- Updates for compatibility with MetaFox Core 5.1.7

  * Events - Update phrases on the Ongoing tab when having no events.

  * Friends - Remove the unnecessary setting “Friend Requests Total”

  * Groups - Hide all group items (blogs, events, discussions, etc.) if the group app is disabled

  * Pages

    * Support rich text editor in for Page description
    * Hide all page items (blogs, events, discussions, etc.) if the page app is disabled
  * Stories

    * Able to create Video Story
    * Support crop and rotate the photo on the ‘Create Story’ page.
    * Allow users to pause or view previous/next stories when using the arrow and space buttons.
  * Feed - Add more details on the feed items of profile updates when they are shared.

  * Paypal - Add instructions for configuring the merchant ID

  * Marketplace - Add the Reset button to the Bought/Sold Invoices page

  * Subscription

    * Support multiple languages for Cancel Reasons.
    * Add the Reset button to the Manage Transactions and Manage Packages pages.
  * E-Wallet - Add “Manage Transactions” page

  * Activity Points - Add Reset button on the Search form in Transactions History and Package Transactions pages

  * Photos - Support view the album detail of a page/group in the current browser tab instead of opening a new one.

  * Photos - UI/UX Improvements, such as

  * Updating phrases when there are no photos/albums

  * Highlighting location on the photo/video detail.

  * Improve the workflow when users view the photo detail and refresh the page.

  * Add border separators between photos on a status post with many photos.

  * Status Background - Improve UI of the background box layout in mobile app

  * Stickers - Improve UI/UX such as

  * Update background layout of the Recent sticker tab in mobile app.

  * Reset the sticker button after users close the keyboard section (mobile app).

  * Allow users to reorder stickers when adding/editing.

  * Videos - UI/UX Improvements, such as

  * Update phrases on the My Video page when there are no videos

  * Improve the layout for the feed of new/shared video

  * Support play video with Shared URL in the app

  * Music - Support progress bar when uploading songs

  * Polls - Improve UI on Poll Details and Create new Poll pages

  * And, many bug fixes

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.8

#### MetaFox 5.1.8

**Release Date: Mar 5, 2024**

###### **Core Updates**

  * Support the new Rich-text Editor

  * Enable Rich-text Editor for Profile - About Me

  * Localization

  * Countries - Support manage cities

  * Phrases - Replace “Group” column with the “Original Text” column.

  * Layout Editor Mode:

  * Able to add Google Adsense block

  * Support Editor Mode on the Registration page

  * Update link for the Help icon

  * Minor UI/UX Improvements:

  * Display the loading screen based on chosen light/dark mode.

  * Support display menu icons of static pages on mobile apps

  * Add the Close button at the right of the search field when users fill data to this field on the State/City screen

  * Improve phrases of Reports

  * Improve the button color of Sign in with Google or TikTok if it is the unique option

  * Mobile apps - Display calender picker when tapping on the calendar icon

  * Extend the forgot password session lifetime to 5 minutes and improve the error message to avoid confusion

  * Users:

  * Admin can log out all users

  * User can log out his/her account on other devices

  * Remove the custom gender to avoid discrimination

  * Registration Settings: Improve the workflow of the “Force Users to Upload Profile Image” setting

  * Disable the Registration option for custom fields of specific roles

  * Support parse email addresses in the text content

  * Appearances

  * Can configure icon color of side menu items of the mobile apps.

  * Can open link-type menus with context menu (right-click menu)

  * Fix bugs




###### **App Updates**

  * All apps

  * Improve phrases

  * Manage Categories - Can view list of subcategories by clicking on the number of subcategories

  * Events - Include group events when listing events that users are interested in, attending or invited to.

  * Follow - Add the ‘Follow User’ option on the Following/Follower sub-tab on the profile page

  * Photos

  * Support edit photo after selecting a photo

  * Add permission settings to allow users to add mature images with warnings

  * Album Details - Not reload when deleting photo of the album

  * Videos

  * Improve video resolution

  * Reposition the Fullscreen option on iPad

  * Able to share Rumble Video Platform

  * Pages

  * Support custom fields

  * Enable the Like button on the shared-page feed items

  * Newsletters - Admin can select multiple roles, genders and locations for a newletter

  * Chat - Support push notifications on Web/Mobile app when users receive a new message

  * ChatPlus

  * Add the “Jump to this message” action on the pinned messages

  * Can jump to the original message when clicking on the reply message or searched message

  * Users can copy/paste and drag/drop multiple files (photo/video/…) into the conversation

  * Stories

  * Users can mute/unmute on the Video Story on web

  * Add friend suggestions for the Instagram-type story

  * Advertise - Improve the layout in the Manage Ads page

  * Comment - Add the “View Post” button on the Comment screen of mobile apps

  * Feed

  * Add the permission setting “Can save media posts?” in the ACP

  * Change permission setting “Can pin activity feed?” to “Can pin posts on Profile User/Page/Group?”

  * Invite - Admin can manage invitations of all users in AdminCP

  * Reactions - Admin can manage existing reactions in AdminCP

  * EWallet - Improve layout on mobile apps

  * Hashtags - Support multiple languages

  * Activity Points - Add permission setting to allow users to create point conversion requests

  * Status Background - Support multiple language for the Collection title

  * And, many bug fixes of apps

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.1.9

#### MetaFox 5.1.9

**Release Date: Apr 12, 2024**

##### **Core Updates**

###### UI/UX Improvements

  * Enhance the typing experience with the new Rich Text Editor.
  * Hide the placeholder when users fill in saved data in the Username field on the Login page.
  * Enhance the profile popup position when hovering over the User/Page/Group profile.
  * Enhance the visibility of the Feedback column in the Canceled Members page in AdminCP.
  * Improve the color consistency of the pagination controls on some pages (Point Settings, Phrases).
  * Support general player button control for video
  * Improve the Turn Off Two-factor Authentication popup.
  * Improve the Display Name column when searching Members in AdminCP.
  * Enhance the layout of the Registration form with less than 5 fields.
  * Enhance wording on the Global Search box.
  * Improve the comment box on the feed item on mobile
  * In User Profile, scroll back to the top of the profile page instead of opening the user story page when clicking on a sticky avatar icon.



###### Localization

  * Show the original translation key when enabling the Active Translation setting.
  * Replace the “User Group” with the “Role” in phrases.



###### Mobile apps

  * Display the Previous Sign-In screen instead of the Sign-In screen if the user has previously logged in.
  * Update React Native Firebase library to the latest.
  * Support the “Profile Menu Settings” page



###### AdminCP

  * Members - Show confirm popup when clicking on the Logout All Users button
  * Appearances - Themes: Support modifying variant thumbnails.
  * Appearances - Should not reload the page after editing the theme variant
  * Custom Fields - Use the toggle button instead of text (Yes/No) at Active column
  * Custom Fields - Optimize the column width in the Manage Custom Fields page**.**
  * Add a warning to remind for Migration from legacy FCM APIs
  * Edit text color: Automatically change the color code when the admin points to another place in the Color Picker



###### Others

  * Layout Editor - Only display newly added block within the layout editor after saving.
  * Firebase - Migrate from legacy FCM APIs to HTTP v1
  * Forgot Password: Enhance the security of the workflow by limiting the maximum number of attempts to get the verification code.
  * Custom Fields - Enhance the workflow of role-specific fields by supporting multiple roles and displaying them on registration accordingly.
  * Email - Support predefined variables to enhance the customizability of the email greetings.
  * Account Setting - Hide settings of inactive Apps in Account Settings > Privacy Settings > Your Profile Settings & Sharing Items
  * Pagination - Support “Go To Page” option so users can quickly navigate through paginated items.
  * Rich-text Editor - Support adding link to an image on Rich-text-editor
  * Notification - Support deleting all notifications on the frontend web



##### **App Updates**

###### Pages

  * Support Schedule post
  * Improve the layout of the Edit Page Info page
  * Claim Page: Improve wording of the success message when the user resubmits a claim request
  * Improve wording of the privacy when users edit the post on the page



###### Groups

  * Support custom fields for groups.
  * Support Schedule post
  * Enhance the logic of ordering Similar Groups by adding the factor of group member count.
  * Group administrators can disable Discussions, Members and Photos tabs.
  * UI/UX Improvement for the Edit Page Info group



###### Events:

  * Support Schedule post
  * Compatibility with Core v5.1.9



###### Stories

  * Improve the font text when typing the text on the story on mobile apps
  * Process videos asynchronously while creating media stories.
  * Support the “Friends Only” setting in AdminCP to restrict all stories to users’ friends only
  * Allow users to mute/unmute on the Video Story
  * UI/UX improvement on the Create story page.
  * Users can close the Privacy Settings with the gear button on the Mobile layout
  * Support context menu when users click on their profile who have already created stories.



###### Comments

  * Add settings for Reply Order and Reply Detail View
  * UI/UX Improvement on the Comment screen
  * Users can comment with text and stickers at the same time.
  * Validate fields belonging the “Comment Hash Check” setting.



###### Marketplace

  * UI/UX Improvement for the listing section on the view on map page after users scroll down the menu app.
  * UI/UX Improvement for Label in Sponsor Settings section
  * When users input the decimal amount for prices, automatically rebound to the second decimal place.
  * UI/UX Improvement for the Back button of the browser on the “View on Map” page.



###### Reactions

  * Support creating new or deleting reactions in AdminCP.
  * In Manage Reactions, automatically split the characters of the Reaction Label field when it has reached the limit
  * Add a setting that the admin can change the reaction icon
  * UI/UX Improvement for font color of the warning message once the reactions are activated more than 6
  * Limit the reaction list on the tooltip when hovering over the total reactions.
  * Don’t reload the page after removing the reaction.



###### Friends

  * Remove the unnecessary description of the setting “Maximum Length for Friend List Title”



###### Newsletters

  * UI/UX Improvement on the ‘View Newsletter’ form



###### Advertise

  * When users input the decimal amount, the system should automatically rebound to the second decimal.
  * Add Description For Image Tooltip



###### Feed

  * UI/UX Improvement when sharing a post with a long location
  * Support Editing the schedule post on mobile
  * On shared posts, redirect to the original post detail when clicking on the original post’s time



###### Subscriptions

  * When users input the decimal amount, the system automatically rebound to the second decimal place.



###### E-Wallet

  * UI/UX Improvement on scroll bar when viewing the Transactions page.



###### Announcement

  * Update announcement Intro as optional.



###### Activity Points

  * When users input the decimal amount, the system automatically rebounds to the second decimal place.



###### Photos

  * Support editing videos after uploading them to the album photo
  * Support view next / previous photo with pagination
  * UI/UX Improvement with viewing the photo detail page (not the popup).



###### Status Background

  * UI/UX Improvement for the select background box when users have selected a background and opened this box again.



###### Stickers

  * Improve wording on the Manage Stickers page.



###### Videos

  * UI/UX Improvement for the comment section on the video detail on mobile apps.
  * Support new user role permission to control upload file/ share URLs in AdminCP
  * Remove “Untitled” title for video posted in Feed
  * UI/UX Improvement with viewing the video detail page(not the popup).



###### Live Videos

  * UI/UX Improvement for the notification when users start a live video on the page/group.
  * UI/UX Improvement when sharing to Story
  * Support view live video as popup mode and page mode



###### Saved Items

  * Add the “Owner” label when viewing the members list.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.2.0

#### MetaFox 5.2.0

**Release Date: Sep 17th, 2025**

###### **What’s new**

**Core**

  * Upgrade to Laravel 12 - Enhanced performance and security with the latest Laravel framework

  * Compatible with PHP 8.4 - Support for the newest PHP version ensuring optimal performance and security

  * Compatible with PostgreSQL 17 - Extended database compatibility for enterprise deployments

  * React Native 0.77 Support - Mobile apps now support Android 15 with the latest React Native framework

  * API Versioning Support - Better API management and backward compatibility for developers

  * Image Quality Control - New setting that allows users to toggle between viewing original uploaded images and resampled versions for better performance

  * Contact Form Enhancement - Added Terms of Service confirmation checkbox to contact forms for better compliance

  * CSV User Import - Administrators can now import users from CSV files with sample file download support




**AdminCP Improvements**

  * Message Queue Timeout Setting - Configure queue timeout settings for better performance management

  * Password Reset Link Expiration - Configurable expiration time for password reset links

  * Member Management Enhancements:

  * Filter members by Banned User role

  * Improved workflow for reassigning super administrators

  * Enhanced custom field handling with better error messages

  * Upgrade Wizard Improvements - Better handling of incompatible apps during upgrade process

  * Performance Optimization - Faster language package setup during upgrades




**UI/UX Improvements**

  * Registration Enhancement - Users are automatically logged in after completing email verification

  * Social Login Integration - Added signup buttons for social accounts on the registration form

  * SEO Improvements - Customized SEO metadata now takes precedence over system-generated content

  * Enhanced Search Functionality - Search results now include descriptions across all apps

  * Dark Mode Improvements - Better layout and color consistency in dark mode

  * Mobile Layout Enhancements - Improved video layout for directly uploaded content




**Photos**

  * Album Management - Enhanced photo album creation and editing experience

  * Search Improvements - Better photo search functionality, including description-based searches




**Social Connect**

  * Enhanced Social Login - Improved Facebook and Google login experience

  * Avatar Handling - Better avatar resolution when logging in with social accounts

  * Mobile Stability - Fixed crashes when logging in with social accounts on Android




**Comments**

  * GIF Support Enhancement - Improved description handling for comments containing Giphy content

  * Edit History - Enhanced edit history descriptions for better content tracking




**Events**

  * UI Improvements - Better event title display in Upcoming Events blocks

  * Group Integration - Enhanced event invitation system for group members




**Groups**

  * Menu Settings - Ability to deactivate default menus for better customization

  * Landing Page Control - Improved UX for menus set as landing pages

  * Role Management - Better role label display in dark mode




**Pages**

  * Menu Customization - Enhanced menu settings with the ability to deactivate default options



**Music**

  * Mobile Enhancements - Fixed repeat/shuffle functionality on mobile layouts

  * Playlist Management - Improved album and playlist editing experience




**Videos**

  * Mobile Layout - Enhanced video display layout for mobile applications



**Subscriptions**

  * Translation Support - Multi-language support for subscription packages

  * Role Management - Improved user role handling during subscription changes

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.2.1

#### MetaFox 5.2.1

**Release Date: Dec 23rd, 2025**

##### **What’s new**

###### **Core**

  * Sponsorship prompts now support item_name parameter for better conversions.
  * AdminCP: more explicit Service Keys guidance to reduce setup confusion.
  * Mail: unsubscribe link added to email footer for compliance.
  * Statistics chart selections now stay cached for faster admin reviews.



###### **ChatPlus**

  * Message migration from Chat to ChatPlus.
  * Upgraded Rocket.Chat engine to 7.x for stability and performance.
  * Mobile support updated for iPhone 17/17 Pro/17 Pro Max.
  * Web: shows message limit warnings before sending to avoid loss of content.



###### **Social Registration**

  * Added opt-in step for Terms of Service and notifications before account creation, improving consent flow.



###### **Mobile experience**

  * Web/Mobile push notification setting screens.
  * Support Google Play’s 16 KB page sizes.



###### **Media & sharing**

  * Fixed TikTok video sharing errors.



###### **Reliability highlights**

  * Fixed Sort Feed on mobile app.
  * Fixed group invitation links now open with the correct URL and pending requests stay pending until reviewed .
  * Localization fixes for deactivating unused countries and currencies in AdminCP.
  * Other minor fixes and improvements.

[Release Notes](/release-notes/ "Release Notes")MetaFox 5.2.2

#### MetaFox 5.2.2

**Release Date: Mar 11th, 2026**

##### **What’s new**

###### **Core**

  * Improved Installation UI - A refreshed and more intuitive installation interface for a smoother setup experience.
  * Age Verification on Signup - Administrators can now enable age verification during the registration process to ensure compliance with age-related policies.
  * Dark Mode Enhancements - Updated scroll bar colors in Dark Mode for better visual consistency.
  * Guest Display Mode - Fixed the “Enforce Display Mode” setting to correctly apply to guest users.
  * Changing notification channels in AdminCP now works correctly for all notification types.
  * Health Check - the “Reachable URLs” check no longer reports false failures.
  * The Terms of Use page is now accessible from the registration page.



###### **Feed**

  * The “View More” link now correctly appears when post text is too long.
  * Users can now share Facebook and Rumble videos without errors.
  * Fixed timeline timestamps on activity posts to match the website display.



###### **Music**

  * Fixed the “Music Max Upload Size (bytes)” setting not being applied correctly.
  * Users can now add songs from a playlist detail page even when they do not have permission to edit the playlist.



###### **Videos**

  * URL-based videos are now displayed correctly.
  * Fixed an issue on Android where the comment bar overlapped the phone’s navigation buttons.



###### **Stories**

  * Fixed a crash that occurred when users reacted to stories.
  * Fixed screen flickering when the app transitions to the next story.
  * Fixed the Edit Video feature for stories on Android devices.
  * Improved the layout when users crop a video story on Android.



###### **Events**

  * Users can now export and add upcoming events to their calendar correctly.



###### **ChatGPT BOT**

  * Fixed an issue preventing users from sending messages to the chatbot.



###### **Social Connect**

  * An appropriate error message is now shown when users cancel social login.
  * Fixed an issue where iOS users were unable to log in with Facebook.



###### **Saved Items**

  * Fixed incorrect user attribution when an item is added to a collection.



###### **Forums**

  * Users can no longer create threads in forums where they do not have the required permission.



###### **Live Videos**

  * Fixed an issue preventing iOS users from starting a live video.



###### **ChatPlus**

  * Compatible with MetaFox 5.2.2
  * Fix bugs



###### **And,**

  * There are other minor fixes, UI/UX improvements, and compatibility updates across other apps.



[MetaFox 5.2.1](/release-notes/metafox-521/ "MetaFox 5.2.1")

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Configure App Settings](/set-up-community/configure-app-settings/ "Configure App Settings")Configure Chat with Pusher

#### Configure Chat with Pusher

This article will guide you step by step to configure Chat app.

Chat app is using Pusher (<https://pusher.com/>) to push messages in a realtime manner. We assume that you have registered an account on Pusher and choose the appropriate Pusher plan. Now, let’s log into your Pusher account and create a **Channel** app.

On the **Create your Channels app** form, please input the fields of **Name of your app** and **Select Cluster**

You should choose the cluster based on your target users for the best performance.

![Screen Shot 2023-04-10 at 14.45.27.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-04-10 at 14.45.27.5f4e06fd.png)

Once app is created, you can go to App detail page > **App Keys** to get Pusher keys.

![Screen Shot 2023-04-10 at 14.45.27.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-04-10 at 14.45.27.5f4e06fd.png)

Now, you can go to AdminCP of your MetaFox site > **App Settings > Chat** to configure Chat with Pusher

![Screen Shot 2023-04-10 at 15.10.14.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-04-10 at 15.10.14.1a294b0c.png)

Lastly, to apply Chat config.

That’s it! You have completed the configuration for Chat with Pusher. 

NOTE: Please make sure that MetaFox Crons have been configured properly in order for Chat to work. Refer to the here.

Now, you can go the frontend to check how Chat work.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Configure App Settings](/set-up-community/configure-app-settings/ "Configure App Settings")Set up SMS with Twilio

#### Set up SMS with Twilio

In this article, we will guide you to set up SMS with [Twilio](https://www.twilio.com/) service provider. Assume that you have completed the registration on Twilio web.

After logging into the Twilio service page with your account, you can get the details of **Account SID** and **Auth Token**. Save these values to configure in MetaFox site

![twilio_acc_SID_and_auth_token.png](/_next/static/media/twilio_acc_SID_and_auth_token.0a0b7041.png)

Let’s log into your MetaFox site with Admin user. Then go to **AdminCP** > **Settings** > **SMS** > **Settings**. Make sure that the **Send SMS Method** is enabled with **twilio** option as below screenshot

![Screenshot 2024-03-18 at 14.45.10.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-18 at 14.45.10.4ee74bae.png)

Let’s move to the **Services** and edit the Twilio provider, you will see three inputs you need to fill in (Account SID, Auth Token, From Number). The first two fields you can get it from your Twilio home page above.

Fill in the phone number you acquired from Twilio service into the “From Number” field. Twilio provided a detailed guideline for acquiring their phone number; kindly visit the link <https://help.twilio.com/articles/223135247-How-to-Search-for-and-Buy-a-Twilio-Phone-Number-from-Console> for more details.

![Screenshot 2024-03-18 at 14.47.34.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-18 at 14.47.34.a25fe02b.png)

Then click the **Save Changes** button to apply the configuration.

_**Congratulation. You just completed the setup for SMS with Twilio.**_

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Configure App Settings](/set-up-community/configure-app-settings/ "Configure App Settings")Set up Video Sharing with URL

#### Set up Video Sharing with URL

MetaFox supports sharing video URLs of many popular Video providers such as Youtube, Facebook, Vimeo. This guide will guide you how to set up Video Sharing with a URL 

###### Youtube

Here is step-by-step guide to enable video sharing with Youtube on MetaFox

Assume that you can and obtain the API key.

In Google Cloud Console, go to APIs & Services > Enable APIs & Services section, search, and enable **YouTube Data API v3** service.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 09.11.21.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 09.11.21.85bd4ad2.png)

Now, you can go to AdminCP of MetaFox site > **Settings** > **Service Keys**

Configure the Google API key obtained in the previous step to the **Youtube Data API Key** setting. And click the **Save Changes** button to apply the config.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 09.15.32.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 09.15.32.0b62fe60.png)

###### Facebook Videos

In this section, we are going to set up for video sharing with Facebook Videos

Assume that you can and obtain the Facebook **App ID** and **Secret Key**.

In the Facebook App Dashboard, go to App Reviews and submit requests for the **OEmbed Read** feature. You will follow the Facebook guide to get the approval for this permission.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 09.24.48.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 09.24.48.1603e79c.png)

Now, you can go to AdminCP of MetaFox site > **Settings** > **Service Keys**

Configure the **Facebook App ID** and **Facebook App Secret** settings with details obtained in the previous step. And click the **Save Changes** button to apply the config.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 09.26.22.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 09.26.22.55f2d142.png)

###### _That’s all. The setup for video sharing is done. You now can share videos with URLs of videos of these providers on your MetaFox site as of now._

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Configure App Settings](/set-up-community/configure-app-settings/ "Configure App Settings")Set up video upload functionality

#### Set up video upload functionality

The video upload feature in our product allows administrators to enhance their users’ experience by enabling them to upload videos from their local machines.

To provide flexibility and compatibility, we offer two options for video processing: **[FFMPEG](https://www.ffmpeg.org/)** and **[Mux](https://www.mux.com/)**. This guide will walk you through the step-by-step process of configuring and setting up these video processing options to ensure seamless and efficient video uploads.

##### Configure video upload with FFMPEG

###### Install FFMPEG on your server

Some hosting providers support FFMPEG by default. Thus, please check with your hosting provider for the FFMPEG Path

If FFMPEG isn’t available, you have to begin by installing FFMPEG on your server or hosting environment. You can download the latest version of FFMPEG from their [official website](https://www.ffmpeg.org/) or use package managers specific to your operating system.

If you aren’t familiar with FFMPEG setup, please get in touch with your hosting provider or system admin for assistance to install this tool.

###### Configure FFMPEG Path

Once FFMPEG is installed, ensure that the system recognizes its path. Now, we will configure FFMPEG service on MetaFox site

Let’s log into your MetaFox with the Admin user and go to **AdminCP Dashboard** > **App Settings** > **Videos**

Click on the **Services** menu on the header bar, then click on the **FFMPEG** item as the screenshot.

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.21.09.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.21.09.81cca570.png)

Configure 2 settings with the proper paths of FFMPEG and FFPROBE you got in step 1. Note that the FFPROBE will be installed automatically along with FFMPEG.

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.25.01.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.25.01.a0615085.png)

Then save changes.

You can go to the Settings section by clicking on the **Settings** top menu. Choose the FFMPEG service for video upload and save changes as below screenshot

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.28.20.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.28.20.0aa10099.png)

You will need to make sure that has been set up for uploaded videos to process.

##### Configure video upload with Mux Integration

###### Create a Mux Account and configure Mux

If you haven’t already, sign up for a Mux account at <https://mux.com/>. Mux provides powerful video processing capabilities, including adaptive streaming and analytics.

After registering Mux account successfully, you will need to set up Mux to get Access Token (**Client ID** and **Client Secret** ) and Webhook Secret

**Set up Access Token**

Once registered, log in to your Mux dashboard.

Navigate to “Settings”: In your Mux dashboard, locate and click on the “Settings” option, typically found in the top-right corner of the page.

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.54.59.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.54.59.ddf42208.png)

Choose the Access Tokens menu or within the “Settings” section, select “Access Tokens.” Here, you can manage your API tokens.

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.57.59.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.57.59.29802e5e.png)

Click on the “Create New Token” button to generate a new Access Token. Provide a descriptive name for the token, and you can also assign permissions to control API access as below. Then click “Create” to generate the Access Token.

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 17.00.39.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 17.00.39.6dbb2c0f.png)

Once the Access Token is generated, copy it immediately and store it securely in a safe location. This Access Token is essential for authenticating requests of your MetaFox site to the Mux API.

**Setting Up Mux Webhook**

In your Mux dashboard, go to the “Settings” section.

Within the “Settings” section, select “Webhooks.” This is where you’ll set up and manage your Webhooks.

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 17.03.26.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 17.03.26.2a6ea988.png)

Click on the “Create New Webhook” button to set up a new webhook. You’ll need to provide specific details about the webhook.

Enter the URL where you want to receive the webhook notifications in the “URL to notify” field. Please fill the URL  _**<https://yourdomain.com/api/v1/video/callback/mux>**_ . You need to replace the _**yourdomain.com**_ part the URL with the proper domain of your MetaFox site

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 17.12.38.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 17.12.38.47414374.png)

After configuring the webhook details, click “Create Webhook.”.

Then you can click on the **Show Signing Secret** of the created webhook item to get the detailed signing secret. Copy and store it for later usage

You have set up your Mux account successfully. Now we can move to the next step to configure the Mux service on your MetaFox site.

###### Configure Mux service on MetaFox

Go to **AdminCP Dashboard** > **App Settings** > **Video** > **Services**. Then choose **Mux Video** item as below

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.43.46.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.43.46.80d5213a.png)

Fill in the settings with the proper values you have when setting up your Mux account. Then save changes.

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.39.34.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.39.34.5650c922.png)

Go to the **Settings** section by clicking on the Settings top menu. Choose the Mux service for video upload and save changes as below screenshot.

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.47.07.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.47.07.563394b4.png)

Congratulations! You have successfully set up the video upload functionality using either FFMPEG or Mux. 

Now, you will see that the Upload option is enabled for users when creating a video

![Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.31.00.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-02 at 16.31.00.a3ca25e2.png)

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Configure Appearances, Layout and Themes](/set-up-community/configure-appearances-layout-and-themes/ "Configure Appearances, Layout and Themes")Add Google Adsense Block

#### Add Google Adsense Block

In this article, we are going to guide you how to add a Google Adsense blocks onto MetaFox site.

Firstly, you will need a Google Adsense account. Refer to this [article](https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/7402253?hl=en) for more details.

Log into your MetaFox site with the Admin user. On the Frontend, let’s .

Choose the **Edit Site Content** option if you want to add Google Adsense block into all pages. Or choose the **Edit Page Content** option if you want to add into the current page.

In the Page Layout, click the Plus icon to add the block in certain section you want.

![Screenshot 2024-03-29 at 10.08.16.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-29 at 10.08.16.e752437d.png)

Then search for the Google Adsense block as below

![Screenshot 2024-03-29 at 09.57.56.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-29 at 09.57.56.6a1b7362.png)

Add the Google Adsense snippet code into the Ins element textbox. Note that the snippet code includes 2 different sections for the header and the body. You will put the code section for the body here. For the code section of the header, you can refer to the article.

Then click **Save Changes** button.

![Screenshot 2024-03-29 at 10.05.20.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-29 at 10.05.20.6abb8721.png)

Now, the Google Adsense block has been added. You can publish the layout and .

![Screenshot 2024-03-29 at 10.11.31.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-29 at 10.11.31.337a1fbd.png)

_**Congratulation. You can add the Google Adsense block into the MetaFox site**_

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Configure Appearances, Layout and Themes](/set-up-community/configure-appearances-layout-and-themes/ "Configure Appearances, Layout and Themes")Configure site logo favicon and site assets

#### Configure site logo favicon and site assets

This tutorial will show you how to change your site’s appearance.

##### Configure the site logo and favicon

This assumes you are already logged in as the **Admin user** and are now in the **AdminCP**.

  * From **Apprearences** > **Assets** Input the keyword **Logo** or **favicon** into the field **Search**



![Assets.png](/_next/static/media/Assets.34668d80.png)

  * You will see two items to edit your logo: **light and dark modes**.



![image logo.png](/_next/static/media/image logo.1ad8e49c.png)

  * From the **Options** section, click on the **Gear** and choose **Edit**. Then upload the new logo and **Save Changes**.



![upload image.png](/_next/static/media/upload image.8bb12b4f.png)

Tips: Don’t forget to clear the cache to display your new logo properly.

##### Build site to apply changes

Under **AdminCP** > **Appearances** , you go to **Themes** > **Rebuild Site**. Then, click on **Rebuild Site** button. It may take a few minutes for the build process to complete and update the frontend (web).

**Now, you can go ahead to change many other assets.**
