[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")Set Up Marketplace

The Marketplace app enables members of your community to buy and sell items directly on the platform, creating a convenient peer-to-peer commerce experience. It provides powerful tools for users to discover listings and for sellers to manage their products, while administrators can control permissions and marketplace settings from the Admin Control Panel.

With Marketplace enabled, users can easily browse and search for items through pages such as All Listings, My Listings, Friends’ Listings, Expired Listings, and Pending Listings. Featured and popular listings are highlighted on the Marketplace home page to help users quickly discover trending items. Users can also apply multiple filters and sorting options to find listings more efficiently. When they decide to purchase, they can complete transactions using available payment gateways, activity points, or funds stored in their E-Wallet, and track their purchases through the Bought Invoices page.

For sellers, the Marketplace provides flexible listing management. Sellers can create listings with detailed descriptions, images, attachments, and location information. Each listing can support multiple prices in different currencies, and sellers can control privacy settings or automatically mark items as Sold after a successful purchase. Sellers can manage all their listings from the My Listings page, invite friends to view their items, track recent listing views in the History page, and manage sales through the Sold Invoices page.

From the AdminCP, administrators have full control over how the Marketplace operates. They can configure role-based permissions, manage and organize categories, set a default category for listings, define the number of days before listing owners receive expiration notifications, and determine how long listings remain active before they expire.

In the following sections, you will learn how to configure the Marketplace app and adjust these settings to best fit your community’s needs.

  * [Configure permissions for roles on Marketplace](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/configure-marketplace-permissions/)
  * [Manage categories](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/manage-marketplace-categories/)
  * [Configure default category](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/configure-default-category/)
  * [Define expiration notifications](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/define-expiration-notifications/)
  * [Define listing expiration](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/define-listing-expiration/)

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set Up Marketplace](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/ "Set Up Marketplace")Configure default category for Marketplace

#### Configure Default Category for Marketplace

To set a default category for new listings in the Marketplace app, you can configure this setting from the Admin Control Panel (AdminCP). This ensures that when users create new listings, they will be automatically assigned to the default category unless they choose a different one. Follow these steps to configure the default category for the Marketplace:

  1. Sign in to AdminCP with an administrator account.
  2. Navigate to: App Settings > Marketplace > Categories
  3. In the Categories view, locate the category you want to set as the default category for new listings.
  4. Click on the Option icon > Mark as Default menu of that category in the list.



Done! You have successfully set a default category for new listings in the Marketplace app. When users create new listings, they will be automatically assigned to this default category unless they select a different one during the listing creation process.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set Up Marketplace](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/ "Set Up Marketplace")Configure Permissions for Roles on Marketplace

#### Configure Permissions for Roles on Marketplace

To control which user roles have access to specific features of the Marketplace app, you can configure permissions from the Admin Control Panel (AdminCP). This allows you to manage who can create listings, view certain pages, or perform administrative actions within the Marketplace. Follow these steps to set up permissions for different roles:

  1. Sign in to AdminCP with an administrator account.
  2. Navigate to: App Settings > Marketplace > Permissions
  3. In the Permissions view, select certain user role to list the corresponding permissions for Marketplace features.
  4. After configuring the permissions for the selected role, click **Save** to apply the changes.
  5. Repeat steps 3-4 for each user role you want to configure permissions for.
  6. Clear site caches to ensure that the new permissions take effect on the frontend.



Done! You have successfully configured permissions for different roles on the Marketplace app. Users will now have access to Marketplace features based on the permissions you set for their respective roles.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set Up Marketplace](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/ "Set Up Marketplace")Define Expiration Notifications for Marketplace Listings

#### Define Expiration Notifications for Marketplace Listings

To set the number of days before listing owners receive expiration notifications for their Marketplace listings, you can configure this setting from the Admin Control Panel (AdminCP). This allows you to notify sellers in advance when their listings are approaching expiration, giving them the opportunity to renew or update their listings as needed. Follow these steps to define expiration notifications for Marketplace listings:

  1. Sign in to AdminCP with an administrator account.
  2. Navigate to: App Settings > Marketplace > Settings
  3. In the Settings view, locate the field labeled **Days to Notify Expiring Listing**.
  4. Enter the desired number of days before expiration that you want the system to send notifications to listing owners.
  5. Click **Save** to apply the changes.
  6. Clear site caches to ensure that the new notification settings take effect on the frontend.



Done! You have successfully defined expiration notifications for Marketplace listings. Listing owners will now receive notifications based on the number of days you specified before their listings expire, allowing them to take appropriate action to maintain their listings in the Marketplace.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set Up Marketplace](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/ "Set Up Marketplace")Define listing expiration for Marketplace

#### Define Listing Expiration for Marketplace

Administrators can set the number of days before listings in the Marketplace app expire. This allows you to manage the lifecycle of listings and ensure that outdated or inactive listings are removed from the Marketplace after a certain period. Follow these steps to define listing expiration for Marketplace:

  1. Sign in to AdminCP with an administrator account.
  2. Navigate to: App Settings > Marketplace > Settings
  3. In the Settings view, locate the field labeled **Days to Expire**.
  4. Enter the desired number of days before listings expire in the Marketplace.
  5. Click **Save** to apply the changes.
  6. Clear site caches to ensure that the new expiration settings take effect on the frontend.



Done! You have successfully defined listing expiration for the Marketplace app. Listings will now expire based on the number of days you specified, helping to keep the Marketplace up-to-date and relevant for users.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set Up Marketplace](/set-up-community/set-up-marketplace/ "Set Up Marketplace")Manage Marketplace Categories

#### Manage Marketplace Categories

To organize listings effectively in the Marketplace app, you can create and manage categories from the Admin Control Panel (AdminCP). Categories help users find relevant listings more easily and allow sellers to classify their items appropriately. Follow these steps to manage categories for the Marketplace:

  1. Sign in to AdminCP with an administrator account.
  2. Navigate to: App Settings > Marketplace > Categories
  3. In the Categories view, you can see a list of existing categories. To create a new category, click the **Add New Category** button.
  4. Fill in the required information for the new category, such as the category name and description. You can also set a parent category if you want to create a subcategory.
  5. After entering the details, click **Save** to create the new category.
  6. To edit an existing category, click on the Option icon > Edit menu of that category in the list, make the necessary changes, and then click **Save**.
  7. To delete a category, click on the Option icon > Delete menu of that category in the list, and confirm the deletion when prompted.



Done! You have successfully managed the categories for the Marketplace app. Users will now see the updated category structure when browsing listings, and sellers can classify their items under the appropriate categories.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Menus](/set-up-community/set-up-menus/manage-menu-items/ "Set up Menus")Manage and Order Profile Menu Items

#### Manage and Order Profile Menu Items

This article describes how to reorder menu items that appear on a user’s profile page using the Admin Control Panel (AdminCP). Follow these steps to control the sequence and visibility of profile menu entries.

  1. Sign in to AdminCP with an administrator account.
  2. Go to: Appearances → Menus.
  3. In the Menus view, open the filter for **Type** and select **Profile Menu**.
  4. From the filtered list, locate and select the menu labeled `user.user.profileMenu` — this is the menu that controls items on the user profile page.
  5. Click on `user.user.profileMenu` item to open the menu item list.
  6. Reorder items using drag-and-drop handles or the provided up/down controls to set the desired sequence.
  7. When the order is correct, click **Save** or **Save Changes** to persist the new order.
  8. Clear site caches so the frontend reflects the update.
  9. Verify the new order by visiting a user’s profile page on the frontend.



Done! You have successfully reordered the profile menu items. Users will now see the updated menu sequence when they visit their profile pages.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")Set up payment gateways

#### Set up payment gateways

Payment Gateway feature is a Core component of online transactions used in many Monetization features of MetaFox apps, such as Subscriptions, Activity Points, Marketplace, etc. Its main functionality is to securely and efficiently facilitate the transfer of payment information between a web browser/device and merchant’s payment processor/bank. The Core Payment Gateway feature is supported by many phpFox payment gateway extensions such as [Paypal](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/paypal-payment-gateway/), [Apple Pay](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/apple-pay-payment-gateway/), [Google Pay](https://appstore.phpfox.com/apps/google-pay-payment-gateway/). It has been designed to be easily extendable with many other payment gateways via 3rd-party apps.

This section will walk you through the process of setting up various payment gateways on your MetaFox platform. Our platform offers flexibility by supporting multiple payment gateways, allowing you to provide your users with convenient and secure payment options for their transactions, such as purchasing marketplace items, subscription plans, etc.

  * [Set up Apple Pay](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/set-up-apple-pay/)
  * [Set up Google Pay](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/set-up-google-pay/)
  * [Set up NOWPayments gateway](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/set-up-nowpayments-gateway/)
  * [Set up payment processor](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/set-up-payment-processor/)
  * [Set up payment with E-Wallet](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/set-up-payment-with-e-wallet/)
  * [Set up Paypal gateway](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/set-up-paypal-gateway/)

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up payment gateways](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/ "Set up payment gateways")Set up Apple Pay

#### Set up Apple Pay

This guide aims to assist you in seamlessly integrating Apple Pay as a payment method on your MetaFox platform. With Apple Pay, your users can make secure transactions using their Apple devices, enhancing their payment experience.

Assume that you have installed the **Apple Pay** app on your MetaFox successfully. You may want to refer the for app if needed.

Let’s go to **AdminCP** > **App Settings** > **Payment**. You will see the Apple Pay item listed as below

![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.52.25.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.52.25.ba6c8505.png)

Edit the Apple Pay and choose a payment processor you want to use with Apple Pay. You will need to make sure that the chosen Payment Processor has been set up properly. You can refer to the guide for more detail.

Then, Check the Active checkbox and save changes to complete the set up for Apple Pay.

![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.53.29.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.53.29.4db20235.png)

Congratulations. You have done the setup for Apple Pay on MetaFox site!

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up payment gateways](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/ "Set up payment gateways")Set up Google Pay

#### Set up Google Pay

This guide aims to assist you in seamlessly integrating Google Pay as a payment method on your MetaFox platform. With Google Pay, your users can make secure transactions using their Android devices, enhancing their payment experience.

Assume that you have installed the **Google Pay** app on your MetaFox successfully. You may want to refer the for app if needed.

Let’s go to **AdminCP** > **App Settings** > **Payment**. You will see the Google Pay item listed as below

![Screenshot 2025-04-23 at 10.40.02.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2025-04-23 at 10.40.02.2baa7ef3.png)

Edit the Google Pay and choose a payment processor you want to use with Google Pay. You will need to make sure that the chosen Payment Processor has been set up properly. You can refer to the guide for more detail.

Then, Check the Active checkbox and save changes to complete the set up for Google Pay.

![Screenshot 2025-04-23 at 10.41.34.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2025-04-23 at 10.41.34.bb04333e.png)

Congratulations. You have done the setup for Google Pay on MetaFox site!

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up payment gateways](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/ "Set up payment gateways")Set up NOWPayments gateway

#### Set up NOWPayments gateway

This guide will walk you through the process of integrating NOWPayments gateway as a payment method, enabling smooth and secure transactions.

###### Prerequisites

Before proceeding, you will also need to create a [NOWPayments](https://nowpayments.io) (<https://nowpayments.io>) account and install the NOWPayments app on your MetaFox site.

###### Configure NOWPayments in MetaFox AdminCP

Log into your site with Admin user and go to **AdminCP** > **App Settings > Payment > Gateways.** Then Edit the NOWPayments option.

On the Edit form, configure fields as below

![nowpayments - guide 2.jpg](/_next/static/media/nowpayments - guide 2.e3a1c7a7.jpg)

  1. **Title:** the gateway title shown to end-users. This can be freely configured according to your preferences.
  2. **API Key:** must be configured after generating API credentials on NOWPayments. Please visit the following URLs to obtain your API key
     * Production: <https://account.nowpayments.io/store-settings#keys>
     * Sandbox: <https://account-sandbox.nowpayments.io/store-settings#keys>
  3. **IPN Secret:** must be configured to verify IPN callbacks sent by the gateway, preventing frauds. The IPN secret is available after configuring Instant Payment Notifications on NOWPayments. 
     * Production: <https://account.nowpayments.io/store-settings#notifications>
     * Sandbox: <https://account-sandbox.nowpayments.io/store-settings#notifications>
     * The IPN handler should be pointed to [_https://YOUR_DOMAIN/api/v1/nowpayments/notify_](https://your_domain/api/v1/nowpayments/notify)
  4. **Active:** Check to enable the gateway to allow end-users to make payments using NOWPayments.
  5. **Test Mode:** Check to enable test mode (sandbox) to fully test the workflow without affecting real balances.
     * Ensure that you have configured the correct API and IPN credentials according to your preferences.



###### REFERENCES

  * Integration Guide: <https://nowpayments.io/blog/integration-guide>
  * API Key: <https://nowpayments.io/help/dashboard/how-to-create-an-api-key>
  * IPN: <https://nowpayments.io/help/what-is/what-is-ipn>
  * Test Mode (sandbox): <https://nowpayments.io/blog/how-to-use-the-sandbox-a-guide>

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up payment gateways](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/ "Set up payment gateways")Set up payment processor

#### Set up payment processor

This guide aims to assist you in setting up Stripe as the payment processor for Apple Pay on your MetaFox platform. Stripe offers a robust payment processing solution that integrates seamlessly with Apple Pay, providing a streamlined transaction experience for your users.

###### Benefits of Stripe Payment Processor

  * Secure payment processing with industry-standard security features.



###### Prerequisites

Before proceeding, you will also need to create an active Stripe Account. You will need to create and verify an active Stripe account to enable payment processing.

##### Set up Stripe account

Once you have an active Stripe account, you will need to:

  * [Enable Apple Pay for Stripe](https://support.stripe.com/questions/enable-apple-pay-on-your-stripe-account) if you intend to use Stripe with Apple Pay



![Screenshot 2025-04-23 at 10.05.32.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2025-04-23 at 10.05.32.955d38f0.png)

  * Enable Google Pay for Stripe if you intend to use Stripe with Google Pay



![Screenshot 2025-04-23 at 10.05.53.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2025-04-23 at 10.05.53.deae649d.png)

  * [Get the **Public Key** and **Secret Key**](https://support.stripe.com/questions/locate-api-keys-in-the-dashboard)
    * Save these keys to configure payment processor on MetaFox site later.
  * [Add a webhook](https://stripe.com/docs/webhooks#add-a-webhook-endpoint) with as below:
    * Use the Endpoint URL  _**<https://yourdomain.com/api/v1/payment-processor/callback/stripe>**_ . You need to replace the _**yourdomain.com**_ with the actual domain of your MetaFox site.
    * Enable following Stripe events: Payment Intent, Customer, Invoice.
    * Retrieve your webhook’s secret from **Stripe Dashboard’s** \- **Webhooks settings** , select webhook, and obtain the secret to configure on the MetaFox site later.



Now, you have done setup your Stripe account. Let’s configure payment processor to integrate with your Stripe account

##### Configure Stripe payment processor on MetaFox

Log into AdminCP and go to **App Settings** > **Payment**. Then edit the Apple Pay.

![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.53.29.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.53.29.4db20235.png)

In the Edit popup, you can click on the **Click here to setup Payment Processor** link to go to the Manage Processors page. This page will list all supported payment processors on MetaFox. 

Click on the **Edit** option of the Stripe item as below

![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.51.48.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.51.48.ae8819a5.png)

Fill in all settings of Public Key, Secret Key and Webhook Secret that you got in the previous step. Make sure that the **Active** checkbox is checked also.

![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.52.04.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.52.04.1132a076.png)

Then, save changes.

Congratulation! You have completed the setup of the payment processor for Stripe.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up payment gateways](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/ "Set up payment gateways")Set up payment with E-Wallet

#### Set up payment with E-Wallet

In MetaFox, users can make payments with money in their E-Wallet to purchase listing items, subscription plan, activity points. This guide will guide you how to enable payment option with E-Wallet on your MetaFox site

Let’s log into the AdminCP Dashboard. Then go the App Settings > Payments and activate E-Wallet option as the below screenshot

![Screenshot 2023-11-07 at 11.49.35.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-11-07 at 11.49.35.c40b091d.png)

The setup is done. Now you will see the E-Wall option showing up when making payments as below.

![Screenshot 2023-11-07 at 11.54.11.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-11-07 at 11.54.11.0bf322e7.png)

Note that if your site supports multiple currencies and want to allow users to purchase with currencies different from USD, you will need to set up and enable Exchange Rates in **App Settings** > **E-Wallet** > **Exchange Rates** page.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up payment gateways](/set-up-community/set-up-payment-gateways/ "Set up payment gateways")Set up Paypal gateway

#### Set up Paypal gateway

This guide will walk you through the process of integrating PayPal as a payment method, enabling smooth and secure transactions.

###### Prerequisites

Before proceeding, you will also need to create a PayPal Business Account.

##### Creating a PayPal Business Account

###### Registering for a PayPal Business Account

  1. Visit the [PayPal website](https://www.paypal.com/).
  2. Sign up for a PayPal Business Account using your email address.
  3. Follow the prompts to provide necessary information and verify your account.



You will have to follow PayPal’s verification process, which may include linking your bank account and confirming your identity.

##### Get Paypal Client ID and Client Secret

PayPal integrations use a client ID and client secret to authenticate API calls:

  * A client ID identifies an app. 
  * A client secret authenticates a client ID so you will need to keep this secret safe.



Here’s how to get your client ID and client secret:

  1. Select [Log in to Dashboard](https://developer.paypal.com/dashboard/) and log in or sign up.
  2. Select **Apps & Credentials**.
  3. New accounts come with a Default Application in the REST API apps section. To create a new project, select **Create App** with the type of **Merchant**.
  4. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** to configure in MetaFox site in the next step



![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.15.09.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.15.09.8b5e8061.png)

After creating app successfully, in the App Details page, you can add Webhook with URL **<https://yourdomain.com/api/v1/paypal/notify>** (replace _yourdomain.com_ with your actual domain) and check **All Events** option as shown below screenshot.

![Screenshot 2023-10-05 at 11.14.48.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-10-05 at 11.14.48.e1ab2f57.png)

Click **Save** button on the Add Webhook popup to complete the setup at Paypal’s end. You can get the **Webhook ID** as below. You need to save this value to configure in MetaFox site later.

![Screenshot 2023-12-01 at 10.19.34.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-12-01 at 10.19.34.e7de4a43.png)

##### Configuring PayPal Integration in MetaFox

Log in to the AdminCP of your MetaFox platform using your admin credentials and go to App Settings > Payments. Then click on Edit option of Paypal item as below

![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.17.30.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 16.17.30.ada07c75.png)

On the Edit Gateway popup you can fill in 2 settings of Client ID, Client Secret and Webhook ID that you got above. Then Save changes.

![Screenshot 2023-12-01 at 10.24.35.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-12-01 at 10.24.35.9d060745.png)

Please note that Paypal gateway willl display as an option for users to make payment only when:

  * The gateway is enabled.
  * The currency used for the transaction is supported by PayPal. PayPal supports a wide range of currencies, but it’s important to ensure that the currency you intend to use is compatible with PayPal’s services. Please refer to PayPal’s official documentation for the most up-to-date list of supported currencies [here](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/reports/reference/paypal-supported-currencies/).



##### Enabling Sandbox Mode

To testing payments, you can set up Paypal with Sandbox mode as below

  1. In Paypal Developer Dasboard, switch to the Sandbox mode and then create Paypal app
  2. Configure corresponding Client ID and Client Secret of the Sandbox app for Paypal gateway
  3. Enable Test Mode setting

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")Set up Social Connect

#### Set up Social Connect

Social Connect is a safe, fast, and easy way to log in by using existing accounts from Facebook, Google, etc. With Social Connect, saving time to sign up and securing passwords will make your website more friendly, professional, and interactive. Social Connect helps you reduce customer care and password recovery cost and achieve greater customer satisfaction by eliminating the frustration associated with user forgetting login credentials (usernames and passwords).

In this section, we will guide you to set up Social Login with Facebook, Google, and Apple

  * [Set up Facebook Login](/set-up-community/set-up-social-connect/set-up-facebook-login/)

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Social Connect](/set-up-community/set-up-social-connect/ "Set up Social Connect")Set up Facebook Login

#### Set up Facebook Login

Since Facebook is one of the largest and most popular social network sites for the publicity, many people would like to use their Facebook accounts to join to other networks. By using Facebook Connect app, your users can join your community conveniently by logging in with their Facebook account.

This guide will instruct you to set up the Facebook login for your site using Facebook Connect.

##### Create a Facebook Application

  * Go to [Facebook Developers page](https://developers.facebook.com/) and Login to your Facebook account.
  * From header menu, select **My App ,** then **Create app**



![image2021-7-12_22-3-34.png](/_next/static/media/image2021-7-12_22-3-34.1383cba9.png)

Enter the **Display Name** and **Contact Email** for your app and click on **Create App ID** to create your app. You might need to enter the captcha to verify.  
![Screenshot\(1\).png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot\(1\).0af301a0.png)

Choose **Settings** from the left menu >> **Basic** content will appear on the right.  
![app id and secret.png](/_next/static/media/app id and secret.031e9ff1.png)

On **Setting** content, you will see **App ID**. Click on **Show** button to reveal **App Secret**. Now you already have both **App ID & App Secret** to use with Facebook Connect app. However, you need to configure your Facebook app a bit more to make it fully work.

Choose **Settings** from the left menu and select **Basic**. Enter your **website URL** , **App Domains,** **Contact email** and hit **Save changes**   
![Screen Shot 2023-04-28 at 10.01.25.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-04-28 at 10.01.25.32db0548.png)

Scrolling down, select **Add Platform** and choose **Website** from the list on the popup.  
![Screenshot\(4\).png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot\(4\).d49dc1dc.png)

New Website field shows up below after select Website platform. **Enter your Site URL** in this field then **Save changes**  
![Screenshot\(5\).png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot\(5\).3dadd0ad.png)

On the top panel, switch to **Live** for **App Mode** to make your app work with normal user.  
![Screen Shot 2023-04-28 at 09.40.24.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-04-28 at 09.40.24.9a0a53e2.png)

From **Product** > click on **Add product,** choose **Facebook login**

![image2021-7-12_21-55-28.png](/_next/static/media/image2021-7-12_21-55-28.020ceda2.png)

On the next page, select **Settings** under the **Facebook login,** set settings as shown in the below screenshot

In **Products** > Choose **Settings** under **Facebook Login** (You might need to add Facebook Login section before proceeding).

Choose the settings as instructed in the below image.

![Screen Shot 2023-04-28 at 09.48.24.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-04-28 at 09.48.24.92a43384.png)

Input your Site Domains into **Allowed Domains for the JavaScript SDK** field.

##### Request required permissions for Facebook Login

Facebook Login requires 2 permissions with access level of **Advanced Access** : **public_profile** and **email**

At this step, you can go to the App Review > Permissions and Features, search 2 permissions of public_profile and email then request for Advanced access as the below

![Screenshot 2023-09-25 at 14.23.15.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-09-25 at 14.23.15.dde2cdfa.png)

You will need to follow Facebook guide and provide necessary info if needed to complete the permission requests.

Now you finish setup your Facebook app. Go back to **Dashboard** and note down **App ID & App Secret** of your Facebook app. We need these 2 information for next step.

##### Set up Facebook App on MetaFox site

Let’s log into your MetaFox site with Admin user and go to **AdminCP** , go to **App Settings** > **Social Connect** > **Facebook**

From here you can see following settings:

![Screen Shot 2023-04-28 at 09.54.54.png](/_next/static/media/Screen Shot 2023-04-28 at 09.54.54.6a7927f6.png)

  * **Enable Facebook Login** : Enable/disable login via the Facebook account. We choose to Enable in this case to enable Facebook login.
  * **Client ID** : Enter here your **App ID** of the Facebook app.
  * **Client** **Secret** : Enter here **App Secret** of the Facebook app.  
Select **Save Changes** to save the settings. You have successfully setup for Facebook login.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Social Connect](/set-up-community/set-up-social-connect/ "Set up Social Connect")Set up Login with Google

#### Set up Login with Google

The “Login with Google” feature offers a convenient way for users to access your platform using their Google credentials. To enable this feature, you’ll need to obtain a Client ID and Client Secret from the Google API Console. This article serves as a comprehensive guide to help you navigate the process step by step.

**Create a Project in Google API Console**

Log in to the Google API Console: Go to the [Google API Console](https://console.developers.google.com/), sign in with your Google account. Then create and select your new project.

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 09.54.41.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 09.54.41.335ae8e0.png)

**Create Credentials**

Navigate to “Credentials”: From the sidebar, select “Credentials.” Click on the “Create Credentials” button and choose “OAuth client ID.”

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 09.59.10.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 09.59.10.9cadac09.png)

Select “Web application” as the application type.

Configure **Authorized Redirect URIs** and **Authoriszed Javascript Origins** : Enter the redirect URIs where users will be sent after granting permissions. This is usually the URL of your MetaFox site as the screenshot but with your proper domain

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.02.49.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.02.49.c9ed8de9.png)

![Screenshot 2024-05-30 at 11.10.56.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-05-30 at 11.10.56.c9ec7b8f.png)

**Step 4: Obtain Client ID and Client Secret**

Access Your Credentials: Under “Credentials,” you’ll find a list of your credentials. Locate the newly created OAuth client ID and click on it. Find Client ID and Client Secret: Here, you’ll find your Client ID and Client Secret.

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.05.25.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.05.25.49c62e52.png)

These are essential for integrating the “Login with Google” feature into your application.

**Integrate Client ID and Client Secret in MetaFox site**

Log into AdminCP of your MetaFox site. Then go to **App Settings** > **Social Connect** . Select **Google** menu on the top and configure the obtained Client ID and Client Secret. 

Don’t forget to enable the “Enable Google Login” checkbox

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 09.45.01.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 09.45.01.9b18aac9.png)

Congratulation! The setup for Login with Google was done now. The Google Login button will be displayed on the Login and Signup form.

  * Configure Login with Tiktok on MetaFox



[Question? Give us feedback →](https://clients.phpfox.com/submitticket.php?step=2&deptid=1)

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Social Connect](/set-up-community/set-up-social-connect/ "Set up Social Connect")Set up Login with Tiktok

#### Set up Login with Tiktok

In this article, we are going to guide you to set up Login with Tiktok on MetaFox site with following steps:

  * Obtain Ticket API Key and Secret Key
  * Configure Login with Tiktok on MetaFox



###### Obtain Ticket API Client Key and Secret Key

You will need to have Tiktok Developer account to get API Client Key and Client Secret key. If you haven’t got one yet, please register your account at Tiktok Developer page (<https://developers.tiktok.com/>).

Now, log into Tiktok Developer with your credentials. Then go to the **Manage Apps** section at <https://developers.tiktok.com/apps/>

![Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 11.39.43.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 11.39.43.26990d49.png)

Click **Connect An App** button and follow the guide to create your app to use for Login with Tiktok.

![Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 11.40.04.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 11.40.04.31158045.png)

At this step, you will need to fill all required details of your app and submit for review to get approval.

![Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 11.40.24.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 11.40.24.abd091e4.png)

Once the app is created successfully and approved, you can obtain the **Client Key** and **Client Secret** in the App Details page. We will configure these values in MetaFox to enable Login with Tiktok then.

Now, we will add 2 products within Tiktok App: **Login Kit** and **Scopes**

![image_2024-05-06_14_29_51.png](/_next/static/media/image_2024-05-06_14_29_51.a5c4064d.png)

![image_2024-05-06_14_29_21.png](/_next/static/media/image_2024-05-06_14_29_21.3db7915d.png)

Then, configure the _**Web Redirect URI**_ of Login Kit and the _**user.info.basic**_ of Scopes as the screenshot

![image_2024-05-06_14_27_23.png](/_next/static/media/image_2024-05-06_14_27_23.557a3747.png)

###### Configure Login with Tiktok on MetaFox

Now, let’s log into AdminCP Dashboard and go to **App Settings** > **Social Connect** > **Tiktok** page.

In this page, you can configure Client Key and Client Secret key that you have obtained in the previous step. And use your site URL as the **Redirect URL** as the below screenshot

![Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 11.54.48.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 11.54.48.6d030bcb.png)

Click Save Changes button to complete the setup for Login with Tiktok. The Login option with Tiktok is now available on the Signup form as below

![Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 12.00.57.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-10-04 at 12.00.57.96ee850e.png)

#### Set up Storage

MetaFox supports many popular storage systems to contain user files. In this section, you’ll discover how to configure and optimize your media storage spaces for photos, videos, and music. Tailoring your storage settings ensures efficient organization, easy access, and a seamless media experience within your platform.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Storage](/set-up-community/set-up-storage/ "Set up Storage")Configure max file size by type

#### Configure max file size by type

This article will guide you to configure maximum upload file size limits by file types.

##### Steps

  * Go to AdminCP > Settings > Storages > Settings page. You will see settings to configure maximum upload file size limits by file types.

  * Fill in the maximum file size limits for each file type (photo, video, music) in the corresponding fields. Then save the changes.




Done! You have successfully configured maximum upload file size limits by file types. Users will not be able to upload files that exceed the configured limits for each file type.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Storage](/set-up-community/set-up-storage/ "Set up Storage")Set up different storage system for user files

#### Set up different storage system for user files

Assume that you are having some external storage systems, such as Amazon S3 and Digital Ocean Spaces, etc along with local storage of server disk. MetaFox supports to set up different storages for file types (musics, videos, photos, etc.). For example, you can set up to store videos on Amazon S3, music on Digital Ocean Spaces while others are stored on the local server. The detailed guide on how to set up storage systems, such as Amazon S3, etc. will be in other topics.

In this article, we assume that the configurations of Storages have been set up properly and this article will walk you through step-by-step guide to configure those storages to store corresponding user files.

Let’s log into AdminCP. Then go to **Settings** > **Storage** . Then choose the **Storages** menu as below

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.53.21.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.53.21.bd470e0a.png)

In the storage files, you will see the list of many item types and default local storage will be used for them

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.55.09.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.55.09.86d003d3.png)

Now, we will configure to store video files on the Amazon S3 which has been set up with configuration **s3.** Then save it.

**![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.56.54.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 10.56.54.5819e29c.png)**

Done. You just completed the configuration to store videos on Amazon S3. As of now, new videos uploaded will be stored on the Amazon S3.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Storage](/set-up-community/set-up-storage/ "Set up Storage")Set up Storage with Amazon S3

#### Set up Storage with Amazon S3

Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service) offers secure and scalable cloud storage solutions for your media files, ensuring reliability and accessibility. Follow these steps to seamlessly integrate Amazon S3 storage into MetaFox

**Set Up Amazon S3 Bucket**

You can refer to the [Amazon S3 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html) for a detailed guide on this service. Generally, setting up an Amazon S3 bucket includes following steps:

  * Log into [Amazon Web Services (AWS) Console](https://aws.amazon.com/) with your AWS account using your credentials. From the AWS Management Console, navigate to the Amazon S3 service.
  * Click the “Create bucket” button to initiate the bucket creation process.
  * Choose a unique bucket name and select the region closest to your target audience.
  * Set bucket properties, such as logging, versioning, and tags, based on your requirements.
  * Turn **Block all public access** setting off
  * Define bucket-level permissions using Access Control List (ACL). Decide who can read and write data to the bucket.
  * Create a bucket policy to control access on a granular level. Assign permissions to users, groups, or even specific IP addresses.



**Set Up User Credentials**

Navigate to AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) and create a new user with permissions to access the above Amazon S3 bucket. Please refer to [Amazon IAM User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/introduction.html) if needed.

  * Once user is created, obtain the **access key** and **secret** for the user. Ensure that these credentials are securely stored. We will use them to configure in MetaFox site then.



**Configure S3 on MetaFox**

Let’s log into AdminCP of your MetaFox site. Then go to **Settings** > **Storage** > **Configurations**

There are some storage configurations in this page.

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 11.33.30.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 11.33.30.51eb5282.png)

You can edit the existing S3 configuration or create a new configuration of S3 storage if needed.

![Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 11.34.39.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-08-31 at 11.34.39.15e0c041.png)

You will need to fill in the Edit/Create form at least all required fields (**Access Key** , **Secret Key** , **Bucket** and **Region**) that you have obtained above. Then click the **Save Changes** button.

Congratulation! You just completed the setup for Amazon S3 on MetaFox site. You can

[Set up different storage system for user files](/set-up-community/set-up-storage/set-up-different-storage-system-for-user-files/ "Set up different storage system for user files")[Configure User Settings](/set-up-community/configure-user-settings/ "Configure User Settings")

[Question? Give us feedback →](https://clients.phpfox.com/submitticket.php?step=2&deptid=1)

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Subscription](/set-up-community/set-up-subscription/ "Set up Subscription")Create Subscription packages

#### Create Subscription packages

This guide will walk you through step by step to set up subscription packages on MetaFox site. Assume that the Subscription app has been installed successfully on your MetaFox site.

Let’s log into your MetaFox site with the Admin user. Then go to **AdminCP** > **App Settings** > **Subscription** . Click on the **Create New Package** link.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 15.48.04.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 15.48.04.20a36107.png)

In the **Create New Package** form, you will need to fill in details of the Subscription package as below:

  * **Title** : The name of your Subscription package
  * **Description** : Explanation about the subscription package
  * **User Role on Success** : Select a certain role that users will be assigned to when using this Subscription package.
  * **Available For User Roles** : select roles whose users can see and purchase this new subscription package
  * **Enable on Registration** : Check to allow this subscription package on the Registration form
  * **Active** : Check to make this subscription package active. Inactive packages won’t be displayed to users.
  * **Package that this package can be upgraded to** : (optional) Choose other subscription packages that the user using this subscription package can be upgraded to
  * **Free package** : Check if this subscription package is free
    * **Price** : If package isn’t free, configure its prices with available currencies
  * **Recurring package** : Check if this subscription package is a recurring plan.
    * **Renew type** : Automatically or Manually
    * **Recurring period**
    * **Recurring price**
    * **Number of days to notify users** before subscription expiry



Once all details have been filled in, click the **Create** button to complete the Create procedure for the Subscription package.

You will see your new subscription package in the **AdminCP** > **App Settings** > **Subscription** > **Manage Packages** page.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 16.08.32.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 16.08.32.27109500.png)

You can go ahead to create all necessary Subscription packages of your community.

###### Enable Subscription packages for users to purchase

After adding subscription packages, you will need to enable Subscription package on frontend by enabling the **Enable Subscription package** setting in **AdminCP** > **App Settings** > **Subscription** > **Settings**

Then, your active subscription packages will be displayed to user on the frontend as below

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 16.20.01.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 16.20.01.e32634e8.png)

That’s all. You just completed the setup for Subscription packages.

#### Enable Subscription on Registration

In this article, we will guide you enabling subscription on Registration so your users can choose their appropriate Subscription package during registration.

Let’s log into your MetaFox site with the Admin user. Then go to **AdminCP** > **App Settings** > **Subscription** > **Settings**

Enable the **Is a Subscription required in Registration?** setting to require members to select a subscription package when they register.

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 16.21.57.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 16.21.57.d4b453c1.png)

All Subscription packages enabled for Registration and available for **Guest User** role will be listed on the Registration form

![Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 16.31.41.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2024-03-12 at 16.31.41.2068d368.png)

That’s it. You can enable Subscription packages on the Registration form now.

[Set Up Community](/set-up-community/ "Set Up Community")[Set up Subscription](/set-up-community/set-up-subscription/ "Set up Subscription")How Subscription works

#### How Subscription works

This article will help you understand the key settings that affect subscriptions as well as common use cases.

##### Settings that affect workflow

###### Site Settings

The following site settings control the subscription workflow behavior:

###### Default Downgraded User Role

When a subscription expires or is canceled (either by the user or admin), if the package does not have “Default Package For Canceled or Expired Subscription” configured, the user will be reassigned to this role.

###### Enable Subscription Packages

Admin must enable this setting to use the subscription feature.

###### Is a Subscription required in Registration?

Forces users to select a package when creating an account. If the user selects a paid package, they must pay the invoice or choose another package (which can be free or paid). Users can only access your site features once the subscription is activated.

###### Extra Days For Subscriptions Before They Expire Completely

Number of extra days added to an invoice before it is marked as expired.

###### Package Settings

The following package-level settings control individual subscription behavior:

###### User Role On Success

The user role that will be assigned when the subscription is activated.

###### Packages that this package can be upgraded to

Packages that users will see when their subscription is activated on the current package.

###### Default Package For Canceled or Expired Subscription

When a user subscription expires or is canceled (by user or admin), the system will check this setting first to downgrade to this package. This means creating a new activated subscription on the downgraded package. The downgraded package is typically the default free package.

###### Available For User Roles

Roles that can see this package.

##### Common Use Cases

###### Requiring Package Selection During Registration

When admins want users to select a package during account creation:

  1. Enable the site setting “Is a Subscription required in Registration?” at:

     * Navigate to: [AdminCP > App Settings > Subscription > Settings](https://your_domain/admincp/app/subscription/setting)
  2. When creating packages, you need to:

     * Enable the setting “Enable on Registration?”
     * Select the “Guest User” role to allow users without accounts to see the package
  3. **Recommendation** : If you set up a default free package that allows users to try before buying other packages, you should have an intermediate role. This role will be the default role after users create their account. Please update the “Role on Registration” setting with the intermediate role at <https://your_domain/admincp/user/setting/registration>.

This setup avoids deadlock situations. For example:

     * Both free and paid packages have “Guest User” as the visible role
     * Free package upgrades account to “Register User”
     * Paid package upgrades user role to “VIP”
     * If a user selects a paid package during account creation, they cannot see the free package because the free package’s visible role does not include “Register User”
     * This creates a deadlock where they cannot go back to select the free package

If you have any questions, please create a ticket at <https://clients.phpfox.com>.

[Software Migration](/software-migration/ "Software Migration")Migrate data from phpFox V4

#### Migrate data from phpFox V4

This article will guide you to migrate your community from phpFox V4 to MetaFox. The migration process includes 2 parts: Export data on phpFox V4 site and then Import data on the MetaFox.

##### Export data on phpFox V4 site

Log into the AdminCP of your phpFox V4 site

Go to AdminCP > Apps > Find More, then search and install the **MetaFox Exporter** app from phpFox Store (<https://store.phpfox.com/apps/metafox-exporter/>)

![Screenshot 2023-05-17 at 16.55.49.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-05-17 at 16.55.49.4bfbb78f.png)

Go to AdminCP > Apps > Installed > MetaFox Exporter, and click the **Export** button to start exporting data on your phpFox V4 site.

![Screenshot 2023-05-17 at 16.34.30.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-05-17 at 16.34.30.d9681b23.png)

A phpFox cron job will handle the Export process. Once the exported file is ready, you can click the **Download Zip** button to download the zip file to your local machine. We will upload this zip file on the MetaFox site to import data.

It may take up to a few hours to complete the Export process

##### Import data on MetaFox

We assume that you could install the MetaFox site successfully. We can go ahead to import data into the MetaFox site.

###### Import data

Log into the MetaFox site and go to AdminCP > Maintenance > Import Data, click on the **Upload Data** link on the top menu

![Screenshot 2023-05-17 at 17.20.34.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-05-17 at 17.20.34.ebfd043a.png)

Click on the **Attach** button and choose the zip file that you have downloaded in the **Export data on phpFox V4 site** step. Then, click on the **Upload** button.

A MetaFox cron job will handle the Import process. You can check the status of Import process in the Browse tab. It may take up to a few hours to complete the Export process

![Screenshot 2023-05-17 at 17.27.46.png](/_next/static/media/Screenshot 2023-05-17 at 17.27.46.8ea565d1.png)

###### Migrate user files

Now, we will migrate user files (such as photos, music, videos, etc.) from phpFox V4 to MetaFox. You can copy the following folders from the server hosting phpFox V4 to the server hosting MetaFox:

  * Folder path on server hosting phpFox V4 -> Folder path on server hosting MetaFox
  * PF.Base/file/pic -> storage/app/public/file/pic
  * PF.Base/file/attachment -> storage/app/public/file/attachment
  * PF.Base/file/video -> storage/app/public/file/video
  * PF.Base/file/music -> storage/app/public/file/music
  * PF.Site/Apps/core-comments/assets/images/stickers -> storage/app/public/PF.Site/Apps/core-comments/assets/images/stickers
  * PF.Site/Apps/p-status-background/assets/images -> storage/app/public/PF.Site/Apps/p-status-background/assets/images



For files stored on external storage systems, such as Amazon S3, Digital Ocean Space, etc. , they will work on the MetaFox site seamlessly as the external storage configurations will be migrated to MetaFox automatically. There are no additional steps to migrate them.

###### Update for searching

We will need to reindex migrated data for global searching. Let’s go to AdminCP > Maintenance > Reindexing page. And click on the ReIndex button. Please note that it will take a while for migrated data to be searched.

**Congratulations. You have completed the Migration from phpFox V4 to MetaFox.**

Introduction

#### Welcome to phpFox User Manual

Welcome to the comprehensive user manual for phpFox, your complete social networking platform solution.

##### What is phpFox?

phpFox is a powerful and flexible social networking platform that allows you to create and manage your own social community. With phpFox, you can build engaging online communities with features like:

  * **User Profiles** \- Customizable user profiles with photos, videos, and personal information
  * **Activity Feeds** \- Real-time updates and social interactions
  * **Groups & Events** \- Create and manage communities and gatherings
  * **Marketplace** \- Buy and sell items within your community
  * **Mobile Ready** \- Responsive design that works on all devices



##### Getting Started

###### [📦 InstallationLearn how to install and set up phpFox on your server](/getting-started/install-metafox)### [🚀 Quick StartGet up and running with phpFox in minutes](/getting-started/essential-steps-after-installing-metafox)### [📚 User GuideComprehensive guide to using phpFox features](/set-up-community)

##### Key Features

###### For Users

  * Create and customize your profile
  * Share photos, videos, and updates
  * Connect with friends and family
  * Join groups and participate in discussions
  * Attend and create events



###### For Administrators

  * Complete admin control panel
  * User management and moderation tools
  * Theme and layout customization
  * Plugin and app marketplace
  * Analytics and reporting



##### Need Help?

  * Check out our [Getting Started Guide](/getting-started/install-metafox/)
  * Browse the [User Guide](/set-up-community/) for detailed instructions
  * Explore [Advanced Features](/advanced-setups/) for power users

This documentation is organized into several sections:

  * **Getting Started** \- Installation and initial setup
  * **User Guide** \- Day-to-day usage and features
  * **Advanced** \- Customization and advanced configurations
